seg.6a61d0d1cb9e.src: Chimmili for Nagula Chavithi ⟦1⟧(Sesame Jaggery Balls)⟦/1⟧
seg.6a61d0d1cb9e.t: ناگولا چوٿي لاءِ چمّيلي ⟦1⟧(تر ۽ ڳڙ جا لڏو)⟦/1⟧
seg.6a61d0d1cb9e.back: Chimmili for Nagula Chavithi ⟦1⟧(sesame and jaggery laddoos)⟦/1⟧

seg.4fea7db714b7.src: Chimmili is a small Telugu sweet of roasted sesame and jaggery, ground coarsely and rolled into balls. It is one of the offerings made on Nagula Chavithi in Karthika masam, along with chalimidi and the milk poured at the snake anthill (putta). Sesame and jaggery sweets like it are made again at Sankranti.
seg.4fea7db714b7.t: چمّيلي تيلگو ماڻهن جي هڪ ننڍي مٺائي آهي، جيڪا ڀُڳل ترن ۽ ڳڙ کي ٿلهو پيهي گول ڪري ٺاهي ويندي آهي. ڪارتيڪا ماسم ۾ ناگولا چوٿيءَ تي جيڪي شيون چاڙهيون وينديون آهن، اهو انهن مان هڪ آهي، چلميدي ۽ نانگ جي ٻِر (پُتّا) تي هاريل کير سان گڏ. اهڙيون تر ۽ ڳڙ جون مٺايون سنڪرانتيءَ تي وري ٺهنديون آهن.
seg.4fea7db714b7.back: Chimmili is a small sweet of Telugu people, made by coarsely grinding roasted sesame and jaggery and rolling it round. It is one of the things offered on Nagula Chavithi in Karthika Masam, together with Chalimidi and milk poured on the snake's anthill (putta). Such sesame and jaggery sweets are made again at Sankranti.

seg.6e104d560e56.src: Roasted sesame gives it a nutty, toasty taste, and cane jaggery a caramel sweetness. The texture is soft and a little crumbly, and each ball is gone in two bites. This recipe makes about 12.
seg.6e104d560e56.t: ڀُڳل ترن مان ان ۾ ميوي جهڙو، سيڪيل ذائقو اچي ٿو، ۽ ڪمند جي ڳڙ مان ڪيريمل جهڙي مٺاڻ. هي نرم ۽ ٿورو ڀُرندڙ هوندو آهي، ۽ هر لڏو ٻن گرهن ۾ ختم. هن ترڪيب سان لڳ ڀڳ 12 ٺهن ٿيون.
seg.6e104d560e56.back: From the roasted sesame it gets a nutty, toasted flavour, and from the sugarcane jaggery a caramel-like sweetness. It is soft and slightly crumbly, and each laddoo finished in two bites. This recipe makes about 12.

seg.9e72f273d4f2.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the roasted sesame to cool.
seg.9e72f273d4f2.t: ڪل وقت ۾ ڀُڳل ترن کي ٿڌو ٿيڻ جا 5 منٽ شامل آهن.
seg.9e72f273d4f2.back: The total time includes 5 minutes for the roasted sesame to cool.

seg.2097a0e593c6.src: Make chimmili at home: roast sesame till it crackles, grind coarsely, pulse with grated cane jaggery and cardamom, shape into balls.
seg.2097a0e593c6.t: گهر ۾ چمّيلي ٺاهيو: تر ايستائين ڀُڃيو جو تِڙڪڻ لڳن، ٿلها پيهيو، ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جي ڳڙ ۽ الائچيءَ سان ٿورو ٿورو پيهيو، ۽ گول لڏو ٺاهيو.
seg.2097a0e593c6.back: Make chimmili at home: roast the sesame until it starts to crackle, grind coarsely, grind a little at a time with grated sugarcane jaggery and cardamom, and make round laddoos.

seg.ac56800c5ad4.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; soft jaggery binds best⟦/1⟧
seg.ac56800c5ad4.t: ¾ ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧هلڪو دٻائي ماپيو؛ نرم ڳڙ بهتر جُڙي ٿو⟦/1⟧
seg.ac56800c5ad4.back: ¾ cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧measure lightly pressed; soft jaggery binds better⟦/1⟧

seg.39c46fb56757.src: 1 tsp ghee, for greasing your palms
seg.39c46fb56757.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو گيهه، تريون چِڪڻيون ڪرڻ لاءِ
seg.39c46fb56757.back: 1 small spoon ghee, to grease the palms

seg.ed775cba4fcf.src: Grate the jaggery and measure out the sesame before you start; once the sesame is roasted, the rest moves quickly.
seg.ed775cba4fcf.t: شروع ڪرڻ کان اڳ ڳڙ ڪدوڪش ڪريو ۽ تر ماپي رکو؛ تر ڀُڄي وڃن ته باقي ڪم جلدي ٿئي ٿو.
seg.ed775cba4fcf.back: Before starting, grate the jaggery and keep the sesame measured; once the sesame is roasted the rest of the work goes quickly.

seg.cfb9d281b47f.src: Heat a heavy kadai or pan on low heat for a minute. Add the sesame; no oil or ghee is needed.
seg.cfb9d281b47f.t: ڳري ڪڙهائي يا پين کي هلڪي باهه تي هڪ منٽ گرم ڪريو. تر وجهو؛ تيل يا گيهه جي ضرورت ناهي.
seg.cfb9d281b47f.back: Heat a heavy kadai or pan on low flame for a minute. Add the sesame; no need for oil or ghee.

seg.89a51ce5355c.src: Dry-roast the sesame on a low flame till it crackles and turns light golden. Stir all the time; the seeds start to pop and smell nutty after 4–6 minutes. Do not let them turn brown.
seg.89a51ce5355c.t: ترن کي هلڪي باهه تي سُڪو ڀُڃيو، جيستائين تِڙڪڻ لڳن ۽ هلڪا سونهري ٿين. سڄو وقت هلائيندا رهو؛ 4–6 منٽن کان پوءِ داڻا ٽپڻ لڳندا ۽ ميوي جهڙي خوشبو ايندي. ناسي ٿيڻ نه ڏيو.
seg.89a51ce5355c.back: Dry-roast the sesame on low flame until they start to crackle and become light golden. Keep stirring the whole time; after 4–6 minutes the seeds will start to jump and a nutty aroma will come. Do not let them turn brown.

seg.999792547560.src: Tip the sesame onto a wide plate straight away so it stops browning. Cool it for about 5 minutes, until it is just warm to the touch.
seg.999792547560.t: ترن کي هڪدم ويڪري ٿالهيءَ ۾ لاهي ڇڏيو ته وڌيڪ ناسي نه ٿين. لڳ ڀڳ 5 منٽ ٿڌو ڪريو، جيستائين هٿ لائڻ تي بس ٿورا گرم لڳن.
seg.999792547560.back: Immediately take the sesame off into a wide plate so they do not brown more. Cool about 5 minutes, until they feel just slightly warm to the touch.

seg.77b614ea2f92.src: Grind the sesame coarsely in short pulses. Use the small jar of the mixer and pulse 3–4 times, a second or two at a time; stop while you can still see broken seeds.
seg.77b614ea2f92.t: ترن کي ننڍن جهٽڪن ۾ ٿلهو پيهيو. مڪسر جو ننڍو جار وٺو ۽ 3–4 دفعا، هر دفعي هڪ ٻه سيڪنڊ هلايو؛ جڏهن اڃا ٽٽل داڻا نظر اچن ته بند ڪريو.
seg.77b614ea2f92.back: Grind the sesame coarsely in short pulses. Take the small jar of the mixer and run it 3–4 times, a second or two each time; stop when broken seeds are still visible.

seg.175aeced5810.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom; pulse till it comes together. This takes 4–6 more short pulses; scrape down the sides once. A pinch pressed between your fingers should hold its shape.
seg.175aeced5810.t: ڳڙ ۽ الائچي وجهو؛ ايستائين پيهيو جو گڏجي وڃي. ان ۾ 4–6 ٻيا ننڍا جهٽڪا لڳن ٿا؛ هڪ دفعو پاسن کان لاهي هيٺ ڪريو. آڱرين ۾ دٻايل چپٽي پنهنجي شڪل رکي ته تيار آهي.
seg.175aeced5810.back: Add the jaggery and cardamom; grind until it comes together. It takes 4–6 more short pulses; once scrape down from the sides. When a pinch pressed in the fingers keeps its shape, it is ready.

seg.6f94cb46b9ab.src: If the mixture is too dry to hold, add 1–2 tsp more grated jaggery and pulse once or twice again.
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.t: جيڪڏهن مصالحو ايترو سُڪو هجي جو نه جُڙي، ته 1–2 ننڍا چمچا ٻيو ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ وجهي هڪ ٻه دفعا ٻيهر پيهيو.
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.back: If the mixture is so dry that it does not bind, add 1–2 small spoons more grated jaggery and grind again once or twice.

seg.226f137c9449.src: Tip the mixture into a bowl and grease your palms lightly with ghee.
seg.226f137c9449.t: مصالحو هڪ پيالي ۾ لاهيو ۽ تريون هلڪو گيهه سان چِڪڻيون ڪريو.
seg.226f137c9449.back: Take the mixture out into a bowl and grease the palms lightly with ghee.

seg.ff3eb71729c2.src: Shape into small balls. Take a heaped tablespoon at a time, press it firmly in your fist, then roll it smooth. Work quickly while the mixture is still warm, as it turns crumbly when it cools.
seg.ff3eb71729c2.t: ننڍا گول لڏو ٺاهيو. هڪ دفعي هڪ ڀريل وڏو چمچو وٺو، مُٺ ۾ زور سان دٻايو، پوءِ ڦيرائي سنئون ڪريو. جلدي ڪريو جيستائين مصالحو گرم آهي، ڇو ته ٿڌو ٿيڻ تي ڀُرڻ لڳي ٿو.
seg.ff3eb71729c2.back: Make small round laddoos. Take one heaped big spoon at a time, press firmly in the fist, then roll to smooth. Work quickly while the mixture is warm, because on cooling it starts to crumble.

seg.ee9e027268aa.src: Leave the balls on a plate until they cool completely, about 15 minutes, then store them in an airtight jar.
seg.ee9e027268aa.t: لڏن کي ٿالهيءَ تي پوري طرح ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو، لڳ ڀڳ 15 منٽ، پوءِ هوا بند جار ۾ رکو.
seg.ee9e027268aa.back: Let the laddoos cool completely on the plate, about 15 minutes, then keep in an airtight jar.

seg.7fe633314020.src: Roast on a low flame and keep stirring; sesame goes from golden to burnt quickly, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.
seg.7fe633314020.t: هلڪي باهه تي ڀُڃيو ۽ هلائيندا رهو؛ تر جلدي سونهري مان سڙي وڃن ٿا، ۽ سڙيل تر ڪڙا لڳن ٿا.
seg.7fe633314020.back: Roast on low flame and keep stirring; sesame go quickly from golden to burnt, and burnt sesame taste bitter.

seg.d50b37351252.src: Grind in short pulses only; long runs turn sesame into an oily paste.
seg.d50b37351252.t: رڳو ننڍن جهٽڪن ۾ پيهيو؛ گهڻي دير هلائڻ سان تر تيل واري پيسٽ ٿي وڃن ٿا.
seg.d50b37351252.back: Grind only in short pulses; running long turns the sesame into an oily paste.

seg.75f5428655c4.src: Shape while the mixture is warm. If it turns crumbly, pulse it once more with a teaspoon of grated jaggery.
seg.75f5428655c4.t: مصالحو گرم هجي تڏهن شڪل ڏيو. جيڪڏهن ڀُرڻ لڳي، ته هڪ ننڍو چمچو ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ وجهي هڪ دفعو ٻيهر پيهيو.
seg.75f5428655c4.back: Shape while the mixture is warm. If it starts to crumble, add one small spoon of grated jaggery and grind once again.

seg.1d42a24453d2.src: Soft jaggery binds best. If yours is hard, grate it finely so it blends in evenly.
seg.1d42a24453d2.t: نرم ڳڙ بهتر جُڙي ٿو. جيڪڏهن توهان جو سخت آهي، ته ان کي سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو ته جيئن هڪجيترو ملي وڃي.
seg.1d42a24453d2.back: Soft jaggery binds better. If yours is hard, grate it finely so that it mixes evenly.

seg.5a7ed16f4810.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker chimmili with a smoky sweetness.
seg.5a7ed16f4810.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ: اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهو، چمّيلي وڌيڪ گهري رنگ جي ٿيندي ۽ مٺاڻ ۾ ٿورو دونهين جهڙو ذائقو.
seg.5a7ed16f4810.back: Palm jaggery: add the same amount of grated palm jaggery, the chimmili will be of darker colour and a slightly smoky taste in the sweetness.

seg.569a63f3cd17.src: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): roast and grind it the same way for darker, stronger-tasting balls.
seg.569a63f3cd17.t: ڪارا تر (نلّا نووولو): انهن کي به ساڳيءَ طرح ڀُڃيو ۽ پيهيو، لڏو گهرا ۽ تيز ذائقي وارا ٿيندا.
seg.569a63f3cd17.back: Black sesame (Nalla Nuvvulu): roast and grind them the same way too, the laddoos will be darker and of stronger flavour.

seg.da0d1a9b6378.src: Peanut or coconut: pulse in 2 tbsp roasted peanuts or grated dry coconut with the jaggery.
seg.da0d1a9b6378.t: مونگ پَلي يا ناريل: ڳڙ سان گڏ 2 وڏا چمچا ڀُڳل مونگ پَلي يا ڪدوڪش ٿيل سُڪو ناريل پيهيو.
seg.da0d1a9b6378.back: Peanut or coconut: grind 2 big spoons of roasted peanuts or grated dry coconut along with the jaggery.

seg.32d41fc0994e.src: Without a mixer: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu) until the mixture holds, then shape.
seg.32d41fc0994e.t: مڪسر کان سواءِ: گرم تر ۽ ڳڙ کي پٿر جي اُکريءَ (رولو) ۾ گڏ ڪُٽيو جيستائين جُڙي وڃن، پوءِ شڪل ڏيو.
seg.32d41fc0994e.back: Without a mixer: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu) until they bind, then shape.

seg.2fa9aaef4425.src: On Nagula Chavithi morning, offer chimmili with milk at the snake anthill (putta) or in your puja, then share them as prasadam. They also go well with evening tea.
seg.2fa9aaef4425.t: ناگولا چوٿيءَ جي صبح، چمّيلي کير سان گڏ نانگ جي ٻِر (پُتّا) تي يا پنهنجي پوڄا ۾ چاڙهيو، پوءِ پرساد طور ورهايو. شام جي چانهه سان به سٺيون لڳن ٿيون.
seg.2fa9aaef4425.back: On the morning of Nagula Chavithi, offer chimmili with milk on the snake's anthill (putta) or in your own puja, then distribute as prasad. They also go well with evening tea.

seg.bd50831bbb3f.src: Keeps a week in an airtight jar. Store the jar at room temperature, in a dry place.
seg.bd50831bbb3f.t: هوا بند جار ۾ هڪ هفتو هلن ٿيون. جار کي ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي، سُڪي جاءِ تي رکو.
seg.bd50831bbb3f.back: They last one week in an airtight jar. Keep the jar at room temperature, in a dry place.

seg.4023b0de08bd.src: Why is my chimmili not holding together?
seg.4023b0de08bd.back: Why does my chimmili not bind?

seg.7fed90d1ebe0.src: The sesame may be under-ground, or the mixture may have cooled. Pulse it once more with 1–2 tsp extra grated jaggery and shape it while it is still warm.
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.t: ٿي سگهي ٿو تر پورا نه پيٺا هجن، يا مصالحو ٿڌو ٿي ويو هجي. 1–2 ننڍا چمچا وڌيڪ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ وجهي هڪ دفعو ٻيهر پيهيو ۽ گرم هوندي ئي شڪل ڏيو.
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.back: Maybe the sesame were not fully ground, or the mixture has gone cold. Add 1–2 small spoons more grated jaggery, grind once again and shape while still warm.

seg.694d2b416f39.src: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?
seg.694d2b416f39.t: منهنجي چمّيلي ڪڙي ڇو لڳي ٿي؟
seg.694d2b416f39.back: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?

seg.d0ee77d0957e.src: The sesame was roasted too dark. Roast it on a low flame only until it crackles and turns light golden, then tip it onto a plate at once so it stops browning.
seg.d0ee77d0957e.t: تر گهڻا ڀُڄي ويا. انهن کي هلڪي باهه تي رڳو ايستائين ڀُڃيو جو تِڙڪڻ لڳن ۽ هلڪا سونهري ٿين، پوءِ هڪدم ٿالهيءَ ۾ لاهي ڇڏيو ته وڌيڪ ناسي نه ٿين.
seg.d0ee77d0957e.back: The sesame got roasted too much. Roast them on low flame only until they start to crackle and become light golden, then immediately take them off into a plate so they do not brown more.

seg.30d31a37acfa.src: Can I use palm jaggery instead of cane jaggery?
seg.30d31a37acfa.t: ڇا مان ڪمند جي ڳڙ بدران تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهي سگهان ٿو؟
seg.30d31a37acfa.back: Can I add palm jaggery instead of sugarcane jaggery?

seg.77afe99f558c.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The chimmili will be darker, with a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.77afe99f558c.t: ها. اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ (تاٽي بيلّم) وجهو. چمّيلي وڌيڪ گهري رنگ جي ٿيندي، ۽ مٺاڻ وڌيڪ گهري ۽ ٿوري دونهين جهڙي.
seg.77afe99f558c.back: Yes. Add the same amount of grated palm jaggery (Thati Bellam). The chimmili will be of darker colour, and the sweetness deeper and slightly smoky.

seg.bae4fc214e74.src: Nagula Chavithi falls on Friday, 13 November 2026, in Karthika masam, a few days after Deepavali. Chimmili, chalimidi and milk are among the offerings made at the snake anthill (putta) that morning.

seg.4b090c2ce3d3.src: Filter coffee is how many Telugu homes start the day: a strong decoction dripped through a steel filter, topped up with hot milk and frothed between a tumbler and davara. This version is sweetened with grated palm jaggery (thati bellam) in place of sugar.
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.t: ڪيترن ئي تيلگو گهرن ۾ ڏينهن فلٽر ڪافيءَ سان شروع ٿيندو آهي: اسٽيل جي فلٽر مان ٽِمندڙ تيز ڊيڪاڪشن، مٿان گرم کير، ۽ ٽمبلر ۽ دَورا جي وچ ۾ اُلٽائي جهاڳ ڪيل. هن ۾ کنڊ بدران ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ (تاٽي بيلّم) وجهي مٺو ڪيو ويو آهي.
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.back: In many Telugu homes the day starts with filter coffee: strong decoction dripping from a steel filter, hot milk on top, and frothed by pouring back and forth between tumbler and dabara. In this, instead of sugar, it has been sweetened by adding grated palm jaggery (Thati Bellam).

seg.cff6d2079da1.src: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoky caramel sweetness that sits well with the bitterness of the decoction. Once the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it suits a slow morning as much as an evening break.
seg.cff6d2079da1.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ ڪپ کي گهري، ٿوري دونهين جهڙي ڪيريمل مٺاڻ ڏئي ٿو، جيڪا ڊيڪاڪشن جي ڪڙاڻ سان چڱي ٺهي ٿي. ڊيڪاڪشن تيار هجي ته لڳ ڀڳ 5 منٽ لڳن ٿا، ۽ آرام واري صبح توڙي شام جي وقفي ٻنهي لاءِ ٺيڪ آهي.
seg.cff6d2079da1.back: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoky caramel sweetness, which goes well with the bitterness of the decoction. If the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it is fine for both a relaxed morning and an evening break.

seg.814efc526088.src: 5 minutes if your decoction is already made.
seg.814efc526088.t: جيڪڏهن ڊيڪاڪشن اڳ ۾ تيار آهي ته 5 منٽ.
seg.814efc526088.back: 5 minutes if the decoction is already ready.

seg.9ad0a1e24d76.src: Boil the milk, add it to the decoction, then stir in grated palm jaggery off the heat. Froth it between tumbler and davara.
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.t: کير اوٻاريو، ڊيڪاڪشن ۾ وجهو، پوءِ باهه تان لاهي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ ملايو. ٽمبلر ۽ دَورا جي وچ ۾ اُلٽائي جهاڳ ڪريو.
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.back: Boil the milk, add to the decoction, then take off the heat and mix in grated palm jaggery. Froth by pouring back and forth between tumbler and dabara.

seg.927b924ff51d.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧enough decoction for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.t: 2 وڏا چمچا فلٽر ڪافي پائوڊر ⟦1⟧2–3 ڪپن لاءِ ڪافي ڊيڪاڪشن⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.back: 2 big spoons filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧decoction enough for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.8aa60818ccf8.src: ½ cup water, just off the boil
seg.8aa60818ccf8.t: ½ ڪپ پاڻي، اٻرڻ کان هڪدم پوءِ
seg.8aa60818ccf8.back: ½ cup water, just after boiling

seg.95409b9d346e.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧from above; 3 tbsp for a stronger cup⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.t: 2 وڏا چمچا فلٽر ڪافي ڊيڪاڪشن ⟦1⟧مٿئين مان؛ تيز ڪپ لاءِ 3 وڏا چمچا⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.back: 2 big spoons filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧from the top; 3 big spoons for a strong cup⟦/1⟧

seg.7b8c0f7e922a.t: 1–2 ننڍا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧ذائقي موجب⟦/1⟧
seg.7b8c0f7e922a.back: 1–2 small spoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.95d91fecafcb.src: Make the decoction: put 2 tbsp filter coffee powder in the top chamber of a South Indian coffee filter, set the perforated press on it and pour in ½ cup water just off the boil. Cover and leave it to drip for 10–15 minutes.
seg.95d91fecafcb.t: ڊيڪاڪشن ٺاهيو: ڏکڻ هندستاني ڪافي فلٽر جي مٿئين خاني ۾ 2 وڏا چمچا فلٽر ڪافي پائوڊر وجهو، مٿان سوراخن وارو دٻاءُ رکو ۽ اٻرڻ کان هڪدم پوءِ وارو ½ ڪپ پاڻي هاريو. ڍڪي 10–15 منٽ ٽِمڻ ڏيو.
seg.95d91fecafcb.back: Make the decoction: put 2 big spoons of filter coffee powder in the upper compartment of a South Indian coffee filter, place the perforated presser on top and pour ½ cup of water just after boiling. Cover and let it drip 10–15 minutes.

seg.9024c8716b54.src: While it drips, grate the palm jaggery finely so it dissolves in seconds.
seg.9024c8716b54.t: جيستائين ٽِمي، تاڙ جو ڳڙ سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو ته سيڪنڊن ۾ ڳري وڃي.
seg.9024c8716b54.back: While it drips, grate the palm jaggery finely so that it melts in seconds.

seg.24689e3dd311.src: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and set it on medium heat.
seg.24689e3dd311.t: کير ننڍي ديڳڙيءَ ۾ وجهو ۽ وچولي باهه تي رکو.
seg.24689e3dd311.back: Put the milk in a small pot and place on medium flame.

seg.4d8e3042dc81.src: Bring the milk to a boil. As soon as it froths up the sides of the pan, switch off the heat.
seg.4d8e3042dc81.t: کير اوٻاريو. جيئن ئي جهاڳ پين جي پاسن تي چڙهي، باهه بند ڪريو.
seg.4d8e3042dc81.back: Boil the milk. As soon as the froth climbs the sides of the pan, turn off the flame.

seg.a124a0d34983.src: Pour the decoction into a tumbler and add the hot milk. Use 2 tbsp decoction for a mild cup and 3 tbsp for a strong one.
seg.a124a0d34983.t: ڊيڪاڪشن ٽمبلر ۾ وجهو ۽ گرم کير ملايو. هلڪي ڪپ لاءِ 2 وڏا چمچا ڊيڪاڪشن ۽ تيز لاءِ 3 وڏا چمچا.
seg.a124a0d34983.back: Put the decoction in the tumbler and mix in the hot milk. 2 big spoons of decoction for a light cup and 3 big spoons for strong.

seg.85570720618b.src: Let it stand for about a minute, so the milk is just off the boil.
seg.85570720618b.t: لڳ ڀڳ هڪ منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو، ته کير اٻرڻ کان ٿورو هيٺ اچي.
seg.85570720618b.back: Leave it for about a minute, so the milk comes down a little below boiling.

seg.eacea0d7cf43.src: Stir in the palm jaggery off the heat. Keep stirring for 20–30 seconds, until no grains are left at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.eacea0d7cf43.t: باهه تان لاهي تاڙ جو ڳڙ ملايو. 20–30 سيڪنڊ هلائيندا رهو، جيستائين ٽمبلر جي تري ۾ ڪو داڻو نه بچي.
seg.eacea0d7cf43.back: Take off the heat and mix in the palm jaggery. Keep stirring 20–30 seconds, until no grain remains at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.08b600da2ef8.src: Taste, and add a little more jaggery if you like it sweeter.
seg.08b600da2ef8.t: چکي ڏسو، ۽ وڌيڪ مٺو گهرجي ته ٿورو ٻيو ڳڙ وجهو.
seg.08b600da2ef8.back: Taste, and if it needs to be sweeter add a little more jaggery.

seg.878b0d8d7eeb.src: Pour between tumbler and davara to froth. Hold the tumbler high and pour into the davara, then back again, 3–4 times, until a light foam sits on top.
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.t: جهاڳ لاءِ ٽمبلر ۽ دَورا جي وچ ۾ اُلٽايو. ٽمبلر مٿي جهلي دَورا ۾ هاريو، پوءِ واپس، 3–4 دفعا، جيستائين مٿان هلڪي جهاڳ اچي.
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.back: For froth pour back and forth between tumbler and dabara. Holding the tumbler high pour into the dabara, then back, 3–4 times, until a light froth comes on top.

seg.653390b95f57.src: Serve straight away, in the tumbler set inside the davara.
seg.653390b95f57.t: هڪدم پيش ڪريو، دَورا ۾ رکيل ٽمبلر ۾.
seg.653390b95f57.back: Serve immediately, in the tumbler kept in the dabara.

seg.33aca43ebf99.src: Add jaggery after the milk is off the boil so it does not split.
seg.33aca43ebf99.t: کير اٻرڻ کان هيٺ اچي تڏهن ڳڙ وجهو ته ڦاٽي نه.
seg.33aca43ebf99.back: Add the jaggery when the milk comes below boiling so that it does not curdle.

seg.60404da43771.src: Grate the jaggery finely: fine shreds dissolve in seconds, while lumps sink and stay at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.60404da43771.t: ڳڙ سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو: سنهيون پَتيون سيڪنڊن ۾ ڳري وڃن ٿيون، جڏهن ته ڳنڍيون تري ۾ ويهي رهن ٿيون.
seg.60404da43771.back: Grate the jaggery finely: thin flakes melt in seconds, while lumps sit at the bottom.

seg.ca883342300e.src: Palm jaggery has a deep, slightly smoky sweetness, so start with 1 tsp and add more to taste.
seg.ca883342300e.t: تاڙ جي ڳڙ ۾ گهري، ٿوري دونهين جهڙي مٺاڻ آهي، تنهنڪري 1 ننڍي چمچي سان شروع ڪريو ۽ ذائقي موجب وڌايو.
seg.ca883342300e.back: Palm jaggery has a deep, slightly smoky sweetness, so start with 1 small spoon and increase according to taste.

seg.d7c0084f5cc6.src: A steel tumbler and davara keep the coffee hot and make frothing easy; a mug and a jug work too.
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.t: اسٽيل جو ٽمبلر ۽ دَورا ڪافيءَ کي گرم رکن ٿا ۽ جهاڳ ڪرڻ سولو ڪن ٿا؛ مگ ۽ جگ به هلن ٿا.
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.back: The steel tumbler and dabara keep the coffee hot and make frothing easy; mug and jug also work.

seg.1b917ac5fc8c.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ: اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ وجهو، مٺاڻ هلڪي ۽ ڪيريمل جهڙي ٿيندي.
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.back: Sugarcane jaggery: add the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery, the sweetness will be lighter and caramel-like.

seg.0ada954bebfe.src: Palm jaggery tea: make your usual milk tea, switch off the heat, wait a minute, then stir in the palm jaggery the same way.
seg.0ada954bebfe.t: تاڙ جي ڳڙ واري چانهه: پنهنجي معمول جي کير واري چانهه ٺاهيو، باهه بند ڪريو، هڪ منٽ ترسو، پوءِ ساڳيءَ طرح تاڙ جو ڳڙ ملايو.
seg.0ada954bebfe.back: Palm jaggery tea: make your usual milk tea, turn off the flame, wait a minute, then mix in palm jaggery the same way.

seg.6512d133d4c0.src: No coffee filter: dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water and use it in place of the decoction.
seg.6512d133d4c0.t: ڪافي فلٽر ناهي: 1 ننڍو چمچو انسٽنٽ ڪافي 2 وڏن چمچن گرم پاڻيءَ ۾ ڳاريو ۽ ڊيڪاڪشن بدران استعمال ڪريو.
seg.6512d133d4c0.back: No coffee filter: dissolve 1 small spoon instant coffee in 2 big spoons hot water and use it instead of decoction.

seg.e9e80ce83cf6.src: Serve hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.t: اِڊلي، ڊوسا يا اپما جي ناشتي کان پوءِ گرم پيش ڪريو، يا شام جو بسڪيٽن يا مُروڪولو سان.
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.back: Serve hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.

seg.97817ad1f29f.src: Make each cup as you need it; coffee reheated after the jaggery goes in can split. Keep extra decoction covered at room temperature and use it within the day.
seg.97817ad1f29f.t: هر ڪپ ضرورت وقت ٺاهيو؛ ڳڙ پوڻ کان پوءِ ٻيهر گرم ڪيل ڪافي ڦاٽي سگهي ٿي. بچيل ڊيڪاڪشن ڍڪي ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي رکو ۽ ساڳئي ڏينهن استعمال ڪريو.
seg.97817ad1f29f.back: Make each cup when needed; coffee reheated after jaggery is added can curdle. Keep leftover decoction covered at room temperature and use the same day.

seg.ea4f4072538a.src: Why did my coffee curdle when I added palm jaggery?
seg.ea4f4072538a.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهڻ سان منهنجي ڪافي ڇو ڦاٽي پئي؟
seg.ea4f4072538a.back: Why did my coffee curdle on adding palm jaggery?

seg.180a2670ead3.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Take the milk off the heat, let it stand for about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.180a2670ead3.t: اڃا اٻرندڙ کير ۾ ملايل ڳڙ ان کي ڦاڙي سگهي ٿو. کير باهه تان لاهيو، لڳ ڀڳ هڪ منٽ ڇڏيو، پوءِ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ ملايو.
seg.180a2670ead3.back: Jaggery mixed into still-boiling milk can curdle it. Take the milk off the heat, leave about a minute, then mix in the grated jaggery.

seg.2b9449407096.src: Can I use cane jaggery instead of palm jaggery?
seg.2b9449407096.t: ڇا مان تاڙ جي ڳڙ بدران ڪمند جو ڳڙ وجهي سگهان ٿو؟
seg.2b9449407096.back: Can I add sugarcane jaggery instead of palm jaggery?

seg.890ae3e15593.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery. The coffee tastes lighter and more like caramel, while palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky cup.
seg.890ae3e15593.t: ها. اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ وجهو. ڪافي هلڪي ۽ وڌيڪ ڪيريمل جهڙي لڳندي، جڏهن ته تاڙ جو ڳڙ گهرو، ٿورو دونهين جهڙو ڪپ ڏئي ٿو.
seg.890ae3e15593.back: Yes. Add the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery. The coffee will taste lighter and more caramel-like, while palm jaggery gives a deep, slightly smoky cup.

seg.e4c92d1c8a42.src: How much palm jaggery should I add to one cup of coffee?
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.t: هڪ ڪپ ڪافيءَ ۾ ڪيترو تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهجي؟
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.back: How much palm jaggery should be added to one cup of coffee?

seg.43a5dfb10340.src: 1 to 2 tsp of grated palm jaggery for 1 cup of milk and 2 tbsp of decoction. Start with 1 tsp, taste, and add more if you like.
seg.43a5dfb10340.t: 1 ڪپ کير ۽ 2 وڏن چمچن ڊيڪاڪشن لاءِ 1 کان 2 ننڍا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ. 1 ننڍي چمچي سان شروع ڪريو، چکو، ۽ وڻي ته وڌايو.
seg.43a5dfb10340.back: 1 to 2 small spoons of grated palm jaggery for 1 cup milk and 2 big spoons of decoction. Start with 1 small spoon, taste, and increase if you like.

seg.2ba4fb9452bb.src: Can I make palm jaggery coffee without a coffee filter?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.t: ڇا ڪافي فلٽر کان سواءِ تاڙ جي ڳڙ واري ڪافي ٺاهي سگهجي ٿي؟
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.back: Can palm jaggery coffee be made without a coffee filter?

seg.23f63da2d908.src: Yes. Dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water, use it in place of the decoction and follow the same steps.
seg.23f63da2d908.t: ها. 1 ننڍو چمچو انسٽنٽ ڪافي 2 وڏن چمچن گرم پاڻيءَ ۾ ڳاريو، ڊيڪاڪشن بدران استعمال ڪريو ۽ ساڳيا قدم کڻو.
seg.23f63da2d908.back: Yes. Dissolve 1 small spoon instant coffee in 2 big spoons hot water, use it instead of decoction and follow the same steps.

seg.4fce579abe5f.src: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ · Palm Jaggery Coffee Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.4fce579abe5f.t: تاٽي بيلّم ڪافي · تاڙ جي ڳڙ واري ڪافيءَ جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.4fce579abe5f.back: Thati Bellam coffee · palm jaggery coffee recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.08ada9e6791e.src: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ. Palm jaggery coffee (thati bellam coffee), the Andhra way: filter decoction, hot milk and grated palm jaggery stirred in off the heat. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.08ada9e6791e.t: تاٽي بيلّم ڪافي. آنڌرا جي طريقي سان تاڙ جي ڳڙ واري ڪافي (تاٽي بيلّم ڪافي): فلٽر ڊيڪاڪشن، گرم کير ۽ باهه تان لاهي ملايل ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ. قدم بقدم طريقو، ڪم جون ڳالهيون ۽ سوال جواب.
seg.08ada9e6791e.back: Thati Bellam coffee. Palm jaggery coffee in the Andhra way (Thati Bellam coffee): filter decoction, hot milk and grated palm jaggery mixed in off the heat. Step-by-step method, working tips and questions and answers.

seg.8a9f25c7f197.t: تاڙ جي ڳڙ واري ڪافي (تاٽي بيلّم ڪافي) · 1acrefarms

seg.0fc7db27d3fc.src: Palm Jaggery Coffee: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.0fc7db27d3fc.t: تاڙ جي ڳڙ واري ڪافي: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.0fc7db27d3fc.back: Palm jaggery coffee: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6f7677a99e8c.t: 1–2 ننڍا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ

seg.947e0ef7a273.t: بيلّم پرمانّم ⟦1⟧(ڳڙ ۽ چانورن جي کِير، مٺي ڊش)⟦/1⟧
seg.947e0ef7a273.back: Bellam Paramannam ⟦1⟧(kheer of jaggery and rice, a sweet dish)⟦/1⟧

seg.03ffde37c28f.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · بيلّم پرمانّم · ڳڙ واري کِير (مٺي ڊش)

seg.1143d51ba236.src: Paramannam is the rice-and-milk sweet that Telugu homes cook for festivals and pujas: rice simmered slowly in milk until soft and creamy, then sweetened. Bellam paramannam, made with jaggery, is a common naivedyam at Diwali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratham, offered at the puja and then shared at the festive meal.
seg.1143d51ba236.t: پرمانّم چانورن ۽ کير جي اها مٺائي آهي جيڪا تيلگو گهرن ۾ ڏڻن ۽ پوڄائن تي ٺهندي آهي: چانور کير ۾ آهستي آهستي ڪاڙهيا ويندا آهن جيستائين نرم ۽ ملائي جهڙا ٿين، پوءِ مٺا ڪيا ويندا آهن. ڳڙ سان ٺهيل بيلّم پرمانّم ديوالي، سنڪرانتي ۽ ورالڪشمي ورتم تي عام نئويديم آهي، پوڄا ۾ چاڙهيو ويندو آهي ۽ پوءِ ڏڻ جي ماني ۾ ورهايو ويندو آهي.
seg.1143d51ba236.back: Paramannam is the sweet of rice and milk that is made in Telugu homes on festivals and pujas: rice is slowly simmered in milk until soft and creamy, then sweetened. Bellam Paramannam made with jaggery is a common naivedyam on Diwali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratam, it is offered in the puja and then distributed in the festival meal.

seg.360051f42785.src: Cane jaggery turns it a light caramel colour and gives a rounder, toffee-like sweetness. Ghee-fried cashews and a little cardamom finish it. This recipe serves 4.
seg.360051f42785.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ ان کي هلڪو ڪيريمل رنگ ۽ ٽافي جهڙي ڀريل مٺاڻ ڏئي ٿو. گيهه ۾ تريل ڪاجو ۽ ٿوري الائچي ان کي پورو ڪن ٿا. هيءَ ترڪيب 4 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.360051f42785.back: Sugarcane jaggery gives it a light caramel colour and a toffee-like full sweetness. Cashews fried in ghee and a little cardamom complete it. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.04a51f6c83e4.src: Total includes the 5-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.04a51f6c83e4.t: ڪل وقت ۾ ڳڙ وجهڻ کان اڳ جا 5 منٽ آرام شامل آهن.
seg.04a51f6c83e4.back: The total time includes 5 minutes of rest before adding the jaggery.

seg.fd8f49fce13b.src: Cook rice in milk till creamy, rest it 5 minutes, then stir in grated cane jaggery. Finish with ghee-fried cashews and cardamom.
seg.fd8f49fce13b.t: چانور کير ۾ ملائي جهڙا ٿيڻ تائين پچايو، 5 منٽ ڇڏيو، پوءِ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ ملايو. آخر ۾ گيهه ۾ تريل ڪاجو ۽ الائچي وجهو.
seg.fd8f49fce13b.back: Cook the rice in milk until creamy, leave 5 minutes, then mix in grated sugarcane jaggery. At the end add cashews fried in ghee and cardamom.

seg.1c0f194a4451.src: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori or another short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.t: ½ ڪپ چانور ⟦1⟧سونا مسوري يا ٻيا ننڍي داڻي وارا چانور، لڳ ڀڳ 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.back: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori or other small-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.8f34922ee281.src: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; whole milk gives the creamiest result⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.t: 4 ڪپ کير ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 1 ليٽر؛ ٿلهو کير سڀ کان ملائي جهڙو ٿئي ٿو⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.back: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; thick milk becomes the most creamy⟦/1⟧

seg.ee0c3b96837f.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; up to 2 tbsp more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.t: ¾ ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧هلڪو دٻائي ماپيو؛ وڌيڪ مٺو وڻي ته 2 وڏا چمچا ٻيا⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.back: ¾ cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧measure lightly pressed; 2 big spoons more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.fa014766d2bf.src: ½ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 4–5 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.t: ½ ننڍو چمچو الائچي پائوڊر ⟦1⟧يا 4–5 الائچين جا ڪُٽيل داڻا⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.back: ½ small spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 4–5 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.480e0a7d227f.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water until the water runs almost clear, then drain it well.
seg.480e0a7d227f.t: چانورن کي 2–3 پاڻين ۾ ڌوئو جيستائين پاڻي لڳ ڀڳ صاف نڪري، پوءِ چڱيءَ طرح پاڻي ڪڍو.
seg.480e0a7d227f.back: Wash the rice in 2–3 waters until the water comes out almost clear, then drain the water well.

seg.d5b0fc46818a.src: Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed pan and bring it to a boil on medium heat, about 8–10 minutes. Stir now and then so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.d5b0fc46818a.t: کير ڳري تري واري پين ۾ وجهو ۽ وچولي باهه تي اوٻاريو، لڳ ڀڳ 8–10 منٽ. وچ وچ ۾ هلائيندا رهو ته تري ۾ نه چنبڙي.
seg.d5b0fc46818a.back: Put the milk in a heavy-bottomed pan and boil on medium flame, about 8–10 minutes. Keep stirring now and then so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b8f9c8c6758b.src: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and turn the heat to low.
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.t: پاڻي ڪڍيل چانور اٻرندڙ کير ۾ وجهو ۽ باهه هلڪي ڪريو.
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.back: Put the drained rice into the boiling milk and lower the flame.

seg.9ae9baab76d7.src: Cook the washed rice in the milk on a low flame till soft and creamy, about 30 minutes. Stir often, scraping the bottom and sides of the pan each time.
seg.9ae9baab76d7.t: ڌوتل چانورن کي کير ۾ هلڪي باهه تي نرم ۽ ملائي جهڙا ٿيڻ تائين پچايو، لڳ ڀڳ 30 منٽ. گهڻو هلائيندا رهو، هر دفعي پين جي تري ۽ پاسن کي ڪُرڇيندا رهو.
seg.9ae9baab76d7.back: Cook the washed rice in the milk on low flame until soft and creamy, about 30 minutes. Keep stirring a lot, scraping the bottom and sides of the pan each time.

seg.ec1509a08b4c.src: Check the rice: a grain should mash easily between your fingers, and the milk should have thickened slightly. For a creamier paramannam, lightly mash a few grains against the side of the pan.
seg.ec1509a08b4c.t: چانور ڏسو: داڻو آڱرين ۾ آسانيءَ سان چِٿجي وڃي، ۽ کير ٿورو ٿلهو ٿي وڃي. وڌيڪ ملائي جهڙي پرمانّم لاءِ ڪجهه داڻا پين جي پاسي سان هلڪو چِٿيو.
seg.ec1509a08b4c.back: Check the rice: a grain should mash easily in the fingers, and the milk should become slightly thick. For a more creamy paramannam lightly mash some grains against the side of the pan.

seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.src: Switch off and let it rest 5 minutes. This brings the milk below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.t: باهه بند ڪريو ۽ 5 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو. ان سان کير اٻرڻ کان هيٺ اچي ٿو، تنهنڪري ڳڙ ان کي نه ڦاڙيندو.
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.back: Turn off the flame and leave for 5 minutes. With this the milk comes below boiling, so the jaggery will not curdle it.

seg.ca16c98d9b18.src: Stir in the jaggery till it melts, about 1–2 minutes, keeping the pan off the heat.
seg.ca16c98d9b18.t: پين کي باهه کان پري رکي ڳڙ ملايو جيستائين ڳري وڃي، لڳ ڀڳ 1–2 منٽ.
seg.ca16c98d9b18.back: Keeping the pan away from the heat, mix in the jaggery until it melts, about 1–2 minutes.

seg.74412a8cc141.src: Taste, and stir in a little more grated jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.74412a8cc141.t: چکي ڏسو، ۽ وڌيڪ مٺو گهرجي ته ٿورو ٻيو ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ ملايو.
seg.74412a8cc141.back: Taste, and if it needs to be sweeter mix in a little more grated jaggery.

seg.92b56df40ea6.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat.
seg.92b56df40ea6.t: ننڍي پين ۾ وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي گيهه گرم ڪريو.
seg.92b56df40ea6.back: In a small pan heat the ghee on medium-low flame.

seg.1bb1f411e4d0.src: Fry the cashews in ghee; add with the cardamom. Stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up. Pour the nuts and ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and stir.
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.t: ڪاجو گيهه ۾ تريو؛ الائچيءَ سان گڏ وجهو. ڪاجو سونهري ٿيڻ تائين هلائيندا رهو، لڳ ڀڳ 1 منٽ؛ آخري ڪجهه سيڪنڊن ۾ ڪشمش به وجهو، جيستائين اهي ڦُلجي وڃن. ڪاجو ۽ گيهه پرمانّم ۾ هاريو، مٿان الائچي پائوڊر ڇٽيو ۽ هلايو.
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.back: Fry the cashews in ghee; add along with cardamom. Keep stirring until the cashews turn golden, about 1 minute; in the last few seconds also add the raisins, until they puff up. Pour the cashews and ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle cardamom powder on top and stir.

seg.e10b7192c157.src: Serve warm. Paramannam thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, if needed.
seg.e10b7192c157.t: گرم پيش ڪريو. پرمانّم رکڻ سان ٿلهو ٿيندو آهي؛ ضرورت هجي ته باهه کان پري ڪجهه چمچا گرم کير وجهي پتلو ڪريو.
seg.e10b7192c157.back: Serve hot. Paramannam becomes thick on keeping; if needed thin it by adding a few spoons of hot milk away from the heat.

seg.d30196cf6b28.src: Jaggery goes in off the heat so the milk does not split.
seg.d30196cf6b28.t: ڳڙ باهه کان پري وجهو ته کير نه ڦاٽي.
seg.d30196cf6b28.back: Add the jaggery away from the heat so the milk does not curdle.

seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and scrape the bottom each time you stir; milk catches easily during the long simmer.
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.t: ڳري تري وارو پين وٺو ۽ هر دفعي هلائڻ وقت تري کي ڪُرڇيو؛ ڊگهي ڪاڙهڻ ۾ کير آسانيءَ سان چنبڙي ٿو.
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.back: Take a heavy-bottomed pan and scrape the bottom each time while stirring; in long simmering milk sticks easily.

seg.a01441abc0b6.src: Cook the rice until fully soft before the jaggery goes in; the grains do not soften further once it is sweetened.
seg.a01441abc0b6.t: ڳڙ وجهڻ کان اڳ چانور پوري طرح نرم ڪريو؛ مٺو ٿيڻ کان پوءِ داڻا وڌيڪ نرم نٿا ٿين.
seg.a01441abc0b6.back: Make the rice fully soft before adding jaggery; after sweetening the grains do not become softer.

seg.688b80a32383.src: Grate the jaggery finely so it melts in the hot milk without going back on the stove.
seg.688b80a32383.t: ڳڙ سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو ته گرم کير ۾ چُلهه تي واپس رکڻ کان سواءِ ڳري وڃي.
seg.688b80a32383.back: Grate the jaggery finely so that it melts in the hot milk without putting it back on the stove.

seg.7bf8faca62b8.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker colour and a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.7bf8faca62b8.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ: اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهو، رنگ گهرو ۽ مٺاڻ گهري، دونهين جهڙي ٿيندي.
seg.7bf8faca62b8.back: Palm jaggery: add the same amount of grated palm jaggery, the colour will be deep and the sweetness deep, smoky.

seg.6672d2210281.src: Pesarapappu paramannam: dry-roast 2 tbsp split moong dal until light golden, wash it and cook it with the rice.
seg.6672d2210281.t: پيسراپپّو پرمانّم: 2 وڏا چمچا ڌوتل مونگ جي دال هلڪي سونهري ٿيڻ تائين سُڪي ڀُڃيو، ڌوئو ۽ چانورن سان گڏ پچايو.
seg.6672d2210281.back: Pesarapappu Paramannam: dry-roast 2 big spoons of washed moong dal until light golden, wash and cook together with the rice.

seg.cd25d9fb2a56.src: Coconut: fry 2 tbsp thin slivers of dry coconut in the ghee along with the cashews.
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.t: ناريل: ڪاجو سان گڏ گيهه ۾ 2 وڏا چمچا سُڪي ناريل جون سنهيون پَتيون تريو.
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.back: Coconut: fry 2 big spoons of thin flakes of dry coconut in ghee along with the cashews.

seg.988ab75b5ccb.src: Serve warm as naivedyam at the Diwali or Lakshmi puja, then as the sweet at the festive meal. Some like it chilled the next day.
seg.988ab75b5ccb.t: ديوالي يا لڪشمي پوڄا ۾ نئويديم طور گرم پيش ڪريو، پوءِ ڏڻ جي ماني ۾ مٺائي طور. ڪجهه ماڻهن کي ٻئي ڏينهن ٿڌو وڻندو آهي.
seg.988ab75b5ccb.back: Serve hot as naivedyam in Diwali or Lakshmi puja, then as a sweet in the festival meal. Some people like it cold the next day.

seg.4a60d211f14d.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. It sets thick when chilled; stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, before serving.
seg.4a60d211f14d.t: بچيل کي ڍڪي فرج ۾ رکو ۽ 2 ڏينهن اندر کائو. ٿڌو ٿيڻ تي ٿلهو ٿي وڃي ٿو؛ پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ باهه کان پري ٿورو گرم کير ملايو.
seg.4a60d211f14d.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. On cooling it becomes thick; before serving mix in a little hot milk away from the heat.

seg.2949774c7efb.src: Why did my paramannam curdle after adding jaggery?
seg.2949774c7efb.t: ڳڙ وجهڻ کان پوءِ منهنجي پرمانّم ڇو ڦاٽي پئي؟
seg.2949774c7efb.back: Why did my paramannam curdle after adding jaggery?

seg.283626ae50fc.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still on the heat or boiling can make it split. Switch off, let the paramannam rest for about 5 minutes, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.283626ae50fc.t: باهه تي يا اٻرندڙ کير ۾ ملايل ڳڙ ان کي ڦاڙي سگهي ٿو. باهه بند ڪريو، پرمانّم کي لڳ ڀڳ 5 منٽ ڇڏيو، پوءِ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ ملايو.
seg.283626ae50fc.back: Jaggery mixed on the heat or into boiling milk can curdle it. Turn off the flame, leave the paramannam about 5 minutes, then mix in the grated jaggery.

seg.7df6976d1e83.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The paramannam turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7df6976d1e83.t: ها. اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ (تاٽي بيلّم) وجهو. پرمانّم گهري رنگ جي ٿيندي ۽ ذائقو گهرو ۽ ٿورو دونهين جهڙو.
seg.7df6976d1e83.back: Yes. Add the same amount of grated palm jaggery (Thati Bellam). The paramannam will be of darker colour and the taste deep and slightly smoky.

seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.src: Which rice is best for paramannam?
seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.t: پرمانّم لاءِ ڪهڙا چانور سڀ کان سٺا آهن؟
seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.back: Which rice is best for paramannam?

seg.ead18bc39c32.src: A short-grain rice such as sona masoori cooks soft and creamy in milk. Long-grain basmati keeps its grains separate and gives a thinner paramannam.
seg.ead18bc39c32.t: سونا مسوري جهڙا ننڍي داڻي وارا چانور کير ۾ نرم ۽ ملائي جهڙا پچن ٿا. ڊگهي داڻي وارا باسمتي داڻا الڳ رکن ٿا ۽ پرمانّم پتلي ٿئي ٿي.
seg.ead18bc39c32.back: Small-grain rice like Sona Masoori cooks soft and creamy in milk. Long-grain basmati keeps the grains separate and the paramannam becomes thin.

seg.2baf5cc4ec36.src: How do I fix paramannam that has become too thick?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.t: گهڻي ٿلهي ٿي ويل پرمانّم ڪيئن ٺيڪ ڪجي؟
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.back: How to fix paramannam that has become too thick?

seg.9ffeabf346fa.src: Stir in a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, until it loosens. It thickens as it cools, so stop when it is a little thinner than you want.
seg.9ffeabf346fa.t: باهه کان پري ڪجهه چمچا گرم کير ملايو جيستائين پتلي ٿئي. ٿڌي ٿيڻ سان ٿلهي ٿئي ٿي، تنهنڪري جڏهن توهان جي گهرج کان ٿوري پتلي هجي تڏهن بس ڪريو.
seg.9ffeabf346fa.back: Away from the heat mix in a few spoons of hot milk until it becomes thin. It becomes thick on cooling, so stop when it is a little thinner than you want.

seg.8b09026bfd65.src: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. Bellam paramannam for Diwali: rice slow-cooked in milk and sweetened with cane jaggery off the heat, finished with ghee-fried cashews. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 4.
seg.8b09026bfd65.t: بيلّم پرمانّم. ديوالي لاءِ بيلّم پرمانّم: کير ۾ آهستي پچايل چانور، باهه کان پري ڪمند جي ڳڙ سان مٺا ڪيل، ۽ مٿان گيهه ۾ تريل ڪاجو. قدم بقدم طريقو، ڪم جون ڳالهيون ۽ سوال جواب. 4 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.8b09026bfd65.back: Bellam Paramannam. Bellam Paramannam for Diwali: rice cooked slowly in milk, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery away from the heat, and cashews fried in ghee on top. Step-by-step method, working tips and questions and answers. For 4 people.

seg.07511b65bfa7.back: Bellam Paramannam (kheer of jaggery and rice, a sweet dish) · 1acrefarms

seg.cf8cab3618d9.src: Bellam Paramannam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.cf8cab3618d9.t: بيلّم پرمانّم: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.cf8cab3618d9.back: Bellam Paramannam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.5fbc274b0656.src: Pasupu paalu is warm milk simmered with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then sweetened with jaggery. It is an everyday cup in many Telugu homes, made on cool evenings and often through Karthika masam, the month of Somavaram (Monday) pujas and evening lamps.
seg.5fbc274b0656.t: پسوپو پالو گرم کير آهي جنهن کي ٿوري هيڊ ۽ چپٽي ڪاري مرچ سان ڪاڙهيو ويندو آهي، پوءِ ڳڙ سان مٺو ڪيو ويندو آهي. ڪيترن ئي تيلگو گهرن ۾ هي روز جو ڪپ آهي، ٿڌين شامن تي ٺهندو آهي ۽ گهڻو ڪري ڪارتيڪا ماسم ۾، جيڪو سوماورم (سومر) جي پوڄائن ۽ شام جي ڏيئن جو مهينو آهي.
seg.5fbc274b0656.back: Pasupu Palu is hot milk that is simmered with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then sweetened with jaggery. In many Telugu homes this is a daily cup, made on cold evenings and mostly in Karthika Masam, which is the month of Somavaram (Monday) pujas and evening lamps.

seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.src: The turmeric turns the milk golden and gives it an earthy, slightly bitter edge, the pepper adds a little heat, and the jaggery rounds it off with a caramel sweetness. This recipe makes one cup in about 5 minutes.
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.t: هيڊ کير کي سونهري ڪري ٿي ۽ ان کي مٽيءَ جهڙو، ٿورو ڪڙو ذائقو ڏئي ٿي، ڪاري مرچ ٿوري تيزي ڏئي ٿي، ۽ ڳڙ ڪيريمل جهڙي مٺاڻ سان پورو ڪري ٿو. هن ترڪيب سان لڳ ڀڳ 5 منٽن ۾ هڪ ڪپ ٺهي ٿو.
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.back: Turmeric makes the milk golden and gives it an earthy, slightly bitter taste, black pepper gives a little sharpness, and jaggery completes it with caramel-like sweetness. With this recipe one cup is made in about 5 minutes.

seg.8e4df121a859.src: Simmer milk with turmeric and a pinch of pepper, switch off, then stir in a spoon of jaggery.
seg.8e4df121a859.t: کير کي هيڊ ۽ چپٽي ڪاري مرچ سان ڪاڙهيو، باهه بند ڪريو، پوءِ هڪ چمچو ڳڙ ملايو.
seg.8e4df121a859.back: Simmer the milk with turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, turn off the flame, then mix in a spoon of jaggery.

seg.33cd5776caaf.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Turmeric Powder or Hill Turmeric Powder⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.t: ¼ ننڍو چمچو هيڊ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧هيڊ پائوڊر يا پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.back: ¼ small spoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧turmeric powder or hill turmeric powder⟦/1⟧

seg.f1056c625241.src: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powdered or crushed⟦/1⟧
seg.f1056c625241.back: Pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧ground or crushed⟦/1⟧

seg.bc417c4b3691.src: 1 tsp grated palm or cane jaggery ⟦1⟧or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ يا ڪمند جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧يا ذائقي موجب⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.back: 1 small spoon grated palm or sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.1a51e1f06af0.src: Sweeten it with ⟦1⟧Palm Jaggery⟦/1⟧ or ⟦2⟧Cane Jaggery⟦/2⟧.
seg.1a51e1f06af0.t: ان کي ⟦1⟧تاڙ جي ڳڙ⟦/1⟧ يا ⟦2⟧ڪمند جي ڳڙ⟦/2⟧ سان مٺو ڪريو.
seg.1a51e1f06af0.back: Sweeten it with ⟦1⟧palm jaggery⟦/1⟧ or ⟦2⟧sugarcane jaggery⟦/2⟧.

seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.src: Pour the milk into a small steel saucepan.
seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.t: کير ننڍي اسٽيل جي ديڳڙيءَ ۾ وجهو.
seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.back: Put the milk in a small steel pot.

seg.94d57531a741.src: Add the turmeric and pepper (and the cardamom, if using) and stir until no specks of turmeric float on top. They mix in more evenly before the milk is heated.
seg.94d57531a741.t: هيڊ ۽ ڪاري مرچ وجهو (۽ الائچي، جيڪڏهن وجهو ٿا) ۽ ايستائين هلايو جو مٿان هيڊ جو ڪو ذرو نه تري. کير گرم ڪرڻ کان اڳ اهي وڌيڪ هڪجيترا ملن ٿا.
seg.94d57531a741.back: Add turmeric and black pepper (and cardamom, if you add it) and stir until no particle of turmeric floats on top. Before heating the milk they mix more evenly.

seg.9da3932c6508.src: Set the pan on medium-low heat. Warm the milk with the turmeric and pepper; simmer 2 minutes. Once small bubbles appear around the edge, turn the heat to low and let it bubble gently.
seg.9da3932c6508.t: پين کي وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي رکو. کير کي هيڊ ۽ ڪاري مرچ سان گرم ڪريو؛ 2 منٽ ڪاڙهيو. جڏهن ڪنارن تي ننڍا بلبلا اچن، باهه هلڪي ڪريو ۽ آهستي ٽهڪڻ ڏيو.
seg.9da3932c6508.back: Place the pan on medium-low flame. Heat the milk with turmeric and black pepper; simmer 2 minutes. When small bubbles come at the edges, lower the flame and let it bubble slowly.

seg.c66cb9336ef5.src: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the pan, as milk rises fast once it boils. If it starts to climb, lift the pan off the heat for a few seconds.
seg.c66cb9336ef5.t: وچ وچ ۾ هلايو ۽ پين تي نظر رکو، ڇو ته اٻرڻ تي کير جلدي چڙهي ٿو. جيڪڏهن چڙهڻ لڳي، ته پين کي ڪجهه سيڪنڊن لاءِ باهه تان لاهيو.
seg.c66cb9336ef5.back: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the pan, because on boiling milk rises quickly. If it starts to rise, take the pan off the heat for a few seconds.

seg.b567bc0c93c9.src: It is ready when the milk is an even golden yellow and the raw smell of turmeric has gone.
seg.b567bc0c93c9.t: جڏهن کير هڪجيترو سونهري پيلو ٿئي ۽ هيڊ جي ڪچي بوءِ ختم ٿي وڃي، تڏهن تيار آهي.
seg.b567bc0c93c9.back: When the milk becomes evenly golden yellow and the raw smell of turmeric is gone, it is ready.

seg.6e16c50d7c2a.src: Switch off and wait a minute. The milk drops just below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.t: باهه بند ڪريو ۽ هڪ منٽ ترسو. کير اٻرڻ کان ٿورو هيٺ اچي ٿو، تنهنڪري ڳڙ ان کي نه ڦاڙيندو.
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.back: Turn off the flame and wait a minute. The milk comes a little below boiling, so the jaggery will not curdle it.

seg.aa0d1bcf6802.src: For a smooth cup, pour the milk through a fine sieve into a tumbler or mug.
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.t: سنئين ڪپ لاءِ، کير سنهي ڇاڻيءَ مان ٽمبلر يا مگ ۾ ڇاڻيو.
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.back: For a smooth cup, strain the milk through a fine strainer into the tumbler or mug.

seg.862cac523844.src: Stir in the jaggery and serve warm. Stir for 20–30 seconds, until it dissolves, and taste for sweetness.
seg.862cac523844.t: ڳڙ ملايو ۽ گرم پيش ڪريو. 20–30 سيڪنڊ هلايو جيستائين ڳري وڃي، ۽ مٺاڻ چکي ڏسو.
seg.862cac523844.back: Mix in the jaggery and serve hot. Stir 20–30 seconds until it melts, and taste the sweetness.

seg.1d9b9ec736a8.src: Strain through a fine sieve if you like it smooth.
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.t: سنئون وڻي ته سنهي ڇاڻيءَ مان ڇاڻيو.
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.back: If you like it smooth, strain through a fine strainer.

seg.018366193ef3.src: Add the jaggery only after switching off; jaggery stirred into boiling milk can split it.
seg.018366193ef3.t: ڳڙ رڳو باهه بند ڪرڻ کان پوءِ وجهو؛ اٻرندڙ کير ۾ ملايل ڳڙ ان کي ڦاڙي سگهي ٿو.
seg.018366193ef3.back: Add the jaggery only after turning off the flame; jaggery mixed into boiling milk can curdle it.

seg.0e783ba83473.src: Use a steel pan and spoon; turmeric stains plastic and wood.
seg.0e783ba83473.t: اسٽيل جو پين ۽ چمچو وٺو؛ هيڊ پلاسٽڪ ۽ ڪاٺ تي داغ ڇڏي ٿي.
seg.0e783ba83473.back: Take a steel pan and spoon; turmeric leaves stains on plastic and wood.

seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.src: Making more? Use the same amounts for each cup of milk.
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.t: وڌيڪ ٺاهڻو آهي؟ کير جي هر ڪپ لاءِ ساڳيون ماپون وٺو.
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.back: Need to make more? Take the same measures for each cup of milk.

seg.485f68415013.src: Hill turmeric: use Hill Turmeric Powder (konda pasupu) in place of turmeric powder, in the same amount.
seg.485f68415013.t: پهاڙي هيڊ: هيڊ پائوڊر بدران اوترو ئي پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر (ڪونڊا پسوپو) وجهو.
seg.485f68415013.back: Hill turmeric: instead of turmeric powder add the same amount of hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu).

seg.01ec7a142032.src: Palm or cane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness; cane jaggery a lighter, caramel one.
seg.01ec7a142032.t: تاڙ يا ڪمند جو ڳڙ: تاڙ جو ڳڙ گهري، ٿوري دونهين جهڙي مٺاڻ ڏئي ٿو؛ ڪمند جو ڳڙ هلڪي، ڪيريمل جهڙي.
seg.01ec7a142032.back: Palm or sugarcane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deep, slightly smoky sweetness; sugarcane jaggery light, caramel-like.

seg.15b67235d087.src: Milder cup: leave out the pepper and add a pinch of cardamom powder instead.
seg.15b67235d087.t: هلڪو ڪپ: ڪاري مرچ ڇڏي ڏيو ۽ بدران چپٽي الائچي پائوڊر وجهو.
seg.15b67235d087.back: Light cup: leave out the black pepper and add a pinch of cardamom powder instead.

seg.d80219c8a51f.src: Serve warm in a tumbler or mug, on a cool evening or after the Karthika Somavaram puja.
seg.d80219c8a51f.t: ٽمبلر يا مگ ۾ گرم پيش ڪريو، ٿڌيءَ شام تي يا ڪارتيڪا سوماورم جي پوڄا کان پوءِ.
seg.d80219c8a51f.back: Serve hot in a tumbler or mug, on a cold evening or after the Karthika Somavaram puja.

seg.ac04ffd1d51a.src: Make it as you need it and drink it warm. Reheating after the jaggery is in can split the milk.
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.t: ضرورت وقت ٺاهيو ۽ گرم پيئو. ڳڙ پوڻ کان پوءِ ٻيهر گرم ڪرڻ سان کير ڦاٽي سگهي ٿو.
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.back: Make when needed and drink hot. Reheating after jaggery is added can curdle the milk.

seg.c758e61dd102.src: Why did my pasupu paalu curdle?
seg.c758e61dd102.t: منهنجو پسوپو پالو ڇو ڦاٽي پيو؟
seg.c758e61dd102.back: Why did my Pasupu Palu curdle?

seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Switch off the heat, wait about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.t: اڃا اٻرندڙ کير ۾ ملايل ڳڙ ان کي ڦاڙي سگهي ٿو. باهه بند ڪريو، لڳ ڀڳ هڪ منٽ ترسو، پوءِ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ ملايو.
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.back: Jaggery mixed into still-boiling milk can curdle it. Turn off the flame, wait about a minute, then mix in the grated jaggery.

seg.df4dbdd3102b.src: How much turmeric should I use for one cup of milk?
seg.df4dbdd3102b.t: هڪ ڪپ کير لاءِ ڪيتري هيڊ وجهجي؟
seg.df4dbdd3102b.back: How much turmeric should be added for one cup of milk?

seg.3ec50124bdd7.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder for 1 cup (about 240 ml) of milk. More than that makes the taste sharp and earthy.
seg.3ec50124bdd7.t: 1 ڪپ (لڳ ڀڳ 240 ml) کير لاءِ ¼ ننڍو چمچو هيڊ پائوڊر. ان کان وڌيڪ سان ذائقو تيز ۽ مٽيءَ جهڙو ٿئي ٿو.
seg.3ec50124bdd7.back: ¼ small spoon turmeric powder for 1 cup (about 240 ml) milk. With more than that the taste becomes sharp and earthy.

seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.src: Can I skip the black pepper?
seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.t: ڇا ڪاري مرچ ڇڏي سگهجي ٿي؟
seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.back: Can the black pepper be left out?

seg.166b3a44e11d.src: Yes. The pepper adds a little heat to the taste; leave it out, or use a pinch of cardamom instead, for a milder cup.
seg.166b3a44e11d.t: ها. ڪاري مرچ ذائقي ۾ ٿوري تيزي ڏئي ٿي؛ هلڪي ڪپ لاءِ ان کي ڇڏي ڏيو، يا بدران چپٽي الائچي وجهو.
seg.166b3a44e11d.back: Yes. Black pepper gives a little sharpness in the taste; for a light cup leave it out, or add a pinch of cardamom instead.

seg.2184adfd31b0.src: Should I use palm jaggery or cane jaggery?
seg.2184adfd31b0.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهجي يا ڪمند جو ڳڙ؟
seg.2184adfd31b0.back: Should palm jaggery be added or sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ef65c3a9d015.src: Either works, 1 tsp grated per cup. Palm jaggery tastes deeper and slightly smoky; cane jaggery is lighter and more like caramel.
seg.ef65c3a9d015.t: ٻئي هلن ٿا، هر ڪپ ۾ 1 ننڍو چمچو ڪدوڪش ٿيل. تاڙ جو ڳڙ گهرو ۽ ٿورو دونهين جهڙو لڳي ٿو؛ ڪمند جو ڳڙ هلڪو ۽ وڌيڪ ڪيريمل جهڙو.
seg.ef65c3a9d015.back: Both work, 1 small spoon grated in each cup. Palm jaggery tastes deep and slightly smoky; sugarcane jaggery light and more caramel-like.

seg.b0c2f2f3f9c9.src: 1 tsp grated palm or cane jaggery
seg.b0c2f2f3f9c9.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ يا ڪمند جو ڳڙ
seg.b0c2f2f3f9c9.back: 1 small spoon grated palm or sugarcane jaggery

seg.c388948b1966.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ يا تاڙ جو ڳڙ

seg.d8082aa0cdf1.src: Cane jaggery or palm jaggery: which to use
seg.d8082aa0cdf1.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ يا تاڙ جو ڳڙ: ڪهڙو استعمال ڪجي
seg.d8082aa0cdf1.back: Sugarcane jaggery or palm jaggery: which to use

seg.5094f960d9a4.src: Bellam in a Telugu kitchen usually means one of two things: cheruku bellam, made from sugarcane juice, or thati bellam, made from the sap of the palmyra palm. FSSAI treats them as two separate products, each with its own standard.
seg.5094f960d9a4.t: تيلگو رڌڻي ۾ بيلّم جو مطلب عام طور ٻن مان هڪ شيءِ آهي: چيروڪو بيلّم، جيڪو ڪمند جي رس مان ٺهي ٿو، يا تاٽي بيلّم، جيڪو تاڙ جي وڻ جي رس مان ٺهي ٿو. FSSAI انهن کي ٻه الڳ شيون سمجهي ٿو، هر هڪ جو پنهنجو معيار آهي.
seg.5094f960d9a4.back: In the Telugu kitchen Bellam usually means one of two things: Cheruku Bellam, which is made from sugarcane juice, or Thati Bellam, which is made from the sap of the palm tree. FSSAI considers them two separate things, each with its own standard.

seg.13fd9611c493.src: They can look alike in a lump, but they taste different and suit different dishes. Here is how to tell them apart, which to use where, and how to keep them. There is a full Telugu section further down.
seg.13fd9611c493.t: ڳنڍيءَ ۾ ٻئي هڪجهڙا لڳي سگهن ٿا، پر انهن جو ذائقو الڳ آهي ۽ الڳ کاڌن ۾ ٺهن ٿا. هتي ڏسو ته انهن کي ڪيئن سڃاڻجي، ڪهڙو ڪٿي وجهجي، ۽ ڪيئن سانڍجي. هيٺ هڪ پورو تيلگو حصو به آهي.
seg.13fd9611c493.back: In a lump both can look alike, but their taste is different and they go in different dishes. See here how to recognise them, which to put where, and how to store. Below there is also a full Telugu section.

seg.124d6789cba2.src: ⟦1⟧Our two jaggeries⟦/1⟧Left: cane jaggery from the Chittoor and Anakapalli cane belts. Right: palm jaggery from the Godavari delta. Both packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.124d6789cba2.t: ⟦1⟧اسان جا ٻه ڳڙ⟦/1⟧کاٻي: چتور ۽ اناڪاپلي جي ڪمند وارن علائقن جو ڪمند جو ڳڙ. ساڄي: گوداوري ڊيلٽا جو تاڙ جو ڳڙ. ٻئي نرسارائوپيٽ ۾ پيڪ ڪيل.
seg.124d6789cba2.back: ⟦1⟧Our two jaggeries⟦/1⟧Left: sugarcane jaggery from the sugarcane areas of Chittoor and Anakapalli. Right: palm jaggery from the Godavari delta. Both packed in Narasaraopet.

seg.70c115199d4c.src: Cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) is boiled-down sugarcane juice with a mellow, caramel sweetness: the one for payasam, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (thati bellam) is boiled-down palmyra sap, darker and deeper in taste: a favourite in filter coffee and tea. You can swap one for the other gram for gram; start with a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight jar.
seg.70c115199d4c.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ (چيروڪو بيلّم) ڪاڙهي گهٽ ڪيل ڪمند جو رس آهي، نرم ڪيريمل جهڙي مٺاڻ سان: پايسم، پونگل ۽ چمّيلي لاءِ اهو ئي. تاڙ جو ڳڙ (تاٽي بيلّم) ڪاڙهي گهٽ ڪيل تاڙ جو رس آهي، رنگ ۽ ذائقي ۾ وڌيڪ گهرو: فلٽر ڪافي ۽ چانهه ۾ گهڻو پسند ٿئي ٿو. هڪ جي جاءِ تي ٻيو گرام جي بدلي گرام وجهي سگهو ٿا؛ تاڙ جو ڳڙ ٿورو گهٽ سان شروع ڪريو. ٻنهي کي هوا بند جار ۾ رکو.
seg.70c115199d4c.back: Sugarcane jaggery (Cheruku Bellam) is sugarcane juice boiled down, with a soft caramel-like sweetness: that is the one for payasam, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (Thati Bellam) is palm sap boiled down, deeper in colour and taste: it is much liked in filter coffee and tea. You can put one in place of the other gram for gram; start with a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight jar.

seg.b8fab46efd97.src: Sap of the palmyra palm (thati neera)
seg.b8fab46efd97.t: تاڙ جي وڻ جو رس (تاٽي نيرا)
seg.b8fab46efd97.back: Sap of the palm tree (Thati Neera)

seg.31c1fb788209.src: Boiling the juice down until it sets
seg.31c1fb788209.t: رس کي ڪاڙهي ڄمڻ تائين گهٽ ڪري
seg.31c1fb788209.back: By boiling the juice down until it sets

seg.4903e7667bf9.src: Boiling the sap down until it sets
seg.4903e7667bf9.t: رس کي ڪاڙهي ڄمڻ تائين گهٽ ڪري
seg.4903e7667bf9.back: By boiling the juice down until it sets

seg.4dcd7b425d23.src: "Cane jaggery or cane gur": moisture up to 7%
seg.4dcd7b425d23.t: "ڪمند جو ڳڙ يا ڪمند گُڙ": نمي 7% تائين
seg.4dcd7b425d23.back: "Sugarcane jaggery or sugarcane gur": moisture up to 7%

seg.6d7569f44445.src: "Gur or jaggery" from palmyra, date or coconut palm: moisture up to 10%
seg.6d7569f44445.t: تاڙ، کجور يا ناريل جي وڻ مان "گُڙ يا ڳڙ": نمي 10% تائين
seg.6d7569f44445.back: "Gur or jaggery" from palm, date or coconut tree: moisture up to 10%

seg.4bbda4137991.t: وڌيڪ گهري، ٿوري دونهين جهڙي مٺاڻ

seg.82f772f29b90.src: Payasam, pongal, paramannam, chimmili, chikki, laddu
seg.82f772f29b90.t: پايسم، پونگل، پرمانّم، چمّيلي، چِڪي، لڏو
seg.82f772f29b90.back: Payasam, pongal, paramannam, chimmili, chikki, laddoo

seg.db3bddd4a4fc.src: Cane jaggery is made wherever sugarcane grows: the juice is pressed out of the cane and boiled down in open pans. In Andhra Pradesh, Anakapalli has the second largest jaggery market in India.
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ اتي ٺهي ٿو جتي ڪمند پوکجي ٿو: ڪمند مان رس نچوڙي کليل ڪڙاهن ۾ ڪاڙهي گهٽ ڪيو ويندو آهي. آنڌرا پرديش ۾، اناڪاپلي ۾ ڀارت جي ٻي نمبر وڏي ڳڙ منڊي آهي.
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.back: Sugarcane jaggery is made where sugarcane is grown: juice is squeezed from the sugarcane and boiled down in open pans. In Andhra Pradesh, Anakapalli has India's second-largest jaggery market.

seg.31988f9e86fc.src: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palmyra palm, thati chettu in Telugu. The sap is called neera, or thati neera, and it is boiled down until it sets.
seg.31988f9e86fc.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ تاڙ جي وڻ جي رس مان ٺهي ٿو، جنهن کي تيلگو ۾ تاٽي چيٽو چوندا آهن. رس کي نيرا، يا تاٽي نيرا، چيو ويندو آهي، ۽ ان کي ڄمڻ تائين ڪاڙهيو ويندو آهي.
seg.31988f9e86fc.back: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palm tree, which in Telugu is called Thati Chettu. The sap is called Neera, or Thati Neera, and it is boiled until it sets.

seg.7231a4f0bd69.src: Payasam, sweet pongal and ⟦1⟧bellam paramannam⟦/1⟧: cane jaggery.
seg.7231a4f0bd69.t: پايسم، مٺو پونگل ۽ ⟦1⟧بيلّم پرمانّم⟦/1⟧: ڪمند جو ڳڙ.
seg.7231a4f0bd69.back: Payasam, sweet pongal and ⟦1⟧Bellam Paramannam⟦/1⟧: sugarcane jaggery.

seg.2b10b5036017.src: Filter coffee and tea: palm jaggery. Its deeper taste stands up to the decoction; try our ⟦1⟧palm jaggery coffee⟦/1⟧.
seg.2b10b5036017.t: فلٽر ڪافي ۽ چانهه: تاڙ جو ڳڙ. ان جو گهرو ذائقو ڊيڪاڪشن آڏو بيهي ٿو؛ اسان جي ⟦1⟧تاڙ جي ڳڙ واري ڪافي⟦/1⟧ آزمايو.
seg.2b10b5036017.back: Filter coffee and tea: palm jaggery. Its deep taste stands up to the decoction; try our ⟦1⟧palm jaggery coffee⟦/1⟧.

seg.39f0609ee4de.src: ⟦1⟧Pasupu paalu⟦/1⟧: either one, as you like it.
seg.39f0609ee4de.t: ⟦1⟧پسوپو پالو⟦/1⟧: ٻنهي مان ڪو به، جيئن وڻي.
seg.39f0609ee4de.back: ⟦1⟧Pasupu Palu⟦/1⟧: either of the two, as you like.

seg.46fffb385af6.src: Use the same weight. Palm jaggery tastes stronger, so start with a little less and add more to taste.
seg.46fffb385af6.t: ساڳيو وزن وٺو. تاڙ جو ڳڙ وڌيڪ تيز لڳي ٿو، تنهنڪري ٿورو گهٽ سان شروع ڪريو ۽ ذائقي موجب وڌايو.
seg.46fffb385af6.back: Take the same weight. Palm jaggery tastes stronger, so start with a little less and increase according to taste.

seg.8a98e07b6f1e.src: In milk, coffee or tea, add either jaggery after the milk is off the boil, so the milk does not split.
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.t: کير، ڪافي يا چانهه ۾، ڪو به ڳڙ کير اٻرڻ کان هيٺ اچڻ کان پوءِ وجهو، ته کير نه ڦاٽي.
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.back: In milk, coffee or tea, add any jaggery after the milk comes below boiling, so the milk does not curdle.

seg.6788faade30c.src: Keep jaggery in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place.
seg.6788faade30c.t: ڳڙ کي هوا بند جار ۾ ٿڌي، سُڪي جاءِ تي رکو.
seg.6788faade30c.back: Keep jaggery in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place.

seg.5ea00ae441ac.src: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery takes in moisture from the air and turns sticky.
seg.5ea00ae441ac.t: سُڪو چمچو يا چاقو استعمال ڪريو. ڳڙ هوا مان نمي جذب ڪري چِڪڻو ٿي وڃي ٿو.
seg.5ea00ae441ac.back: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery absorbs moisture from the air and becomes sticky.

seg.1d7ae0c59b87.src: If it sets hard, grate it.
seg.1d7ae0c59b87.t: جيڪڏهن سخت ٿي وڃي ته ڪدوڪش ڪري وٺو.
seg.1d7ae0c59b87.back: If it becomes hard, grate it.

seg.8be6c65e90d5.src: Use it within the best-before date on the pack.
seg.8be6c65e90d5.t: پيڪ تي لکيل best-before تاريخ اندر استعمال ڪريو.
seg.8be6c65e90d5.back: Use within the best-before date written on the pack.

seg.cc5783126657.src: Is palm jaggery the same as karupatti?
seg.cc5783126657.t: ڇا تاڙ جو ڳڙ ۽ ڪروپٽي ساڳيا آهن؟
seg.cc5783126657.back: Are palm jaggery and karupatti the same?

seg.f7071649dddd.src: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name for jaggery made from palmyra sap. In Telugu it is thati bellam, and in Hindi taad ka gud.
seg.f7071649dddd.t: ها. ڪروپٽي تاڙ جي رس مان ٺهيل ڳڙ جو تامل نالو آهي. تيلگو ۾ ان کي تاٽي بيلّم ۽ هنديءَ ۾ تاڙ ڪا گُڙ چوندا آهن.
seg.f7071649dddd.back: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name of jaggery made from palm sap. In Telugu it is called Thati Bellam and in Hindi Taad ka gur.

seg.a591ce90fac8.src: Is gud the same as jaggery?
seg.a591ce90fac8.back: Are gur and jaggery the same?

seg.9e04d6270c92.src: Yes. Gud, or gur, is the Hindi word for jaggery, and bellam is the Telugu one. On its own it usually means cane jaggery.
seg.9e04d6270c92.t: ها. گُڙ، يا گُر، ڳڙ لاءِ هندي لفظ آهي، ۽ بيلّم تيلگو لفظ. اڪيلو چئجي ته عام طور ان جو مطلب ڪمند جو ڳڙ هوندو آهي.
seg.9e04d6270c92.back: Yes. Gur, or gud, is the Hindi word for jaggery, and Bellam the Telugu word. Said alone it usually means sugarcane jaggery.

seg.e531a25812a8.src: Why has my jaggery gone sticky?
seg.e531a25812a8.t: منهنجو ڳڙ چِڪڻو ڇو ٿي ويو آهي؟
seg.e531a25812a8.back: Why has my jaggery become sticky?

seg.cc79285bfadd.src: It has taken in moisture from the air, which happens faster in humid weather. Move it to an airtight jar and use a dry spoon.
seg.cc79285bfadd.t: ان هوا مان نمي جذب ڪئي آهي، جيڪا آلي موسم ۾ جلدي ٿئي ٿي. ان کي هوا بند جار ۾ رکو ۽ سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو.
seg.cc79285bfadd.back: It has absorbed moisture from the air, which happens quickly in humid weather. Keep it in an airtight jar and use a dry spoon.

seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.src: Can I use palm jaggery in payasam?
seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.t: ڇا پايسم ۾ تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهي سگهجي ٿو؟
seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.back: Can palm jaggery be added to payasam?

seg.8ba95d799ac9.src: Yes. It gives a darker colour and a deeper taste. Add it off the heat, as you would cane jaggery.
seg.8ba95d799ac9.t: ها. ان سان رنگ گهرو ۽ ذائقو وڌيڪ گهرو ٿئي ٿو. ڪمند جي ڳڙ وانگر ان کي به باهه کان پري وجهو.
seg.8ba95d799ac9.back: Yes. With it the colour becomes deep and the taste deeper. Like sugarcane jaggery, add it too away from the heat.
