seg.abda31761e23.back: Simple answers to what buyers ask us, starting with how to check turmeric powder at home.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI جو معيار چوي ٿو ته هيڊ پائوڊر ۾ ملايل رنگ، ليڊ ڪروميٽ سميت، ۽ ٻاهرين نشاستي نه هجڻ گهرجي. ان جي جانچ واري ڪتاب ۾ لکيل آهي ته انسپيڪٽر هيڊ ۾ ڇا ڏسن ٿا: ملايل رنگ جهڙوڪ ميٽانل پيلو، ليڊ جا لوڻ، ۽ چاڪ پائوڊر.
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: The FSSAI standard says that turmeric powder should not have added colour, including lead chromate, and foreign starch. In its testing book it is written what inspectors look for in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: ان مان ڪجهه توهان رڌڻي ۾ جانچي سگهو ٿا، ۽ ڪجهه رڳو ليبارٽري ڳولي سگهي ٿي. هيءَ رهنمائي ٻنهي جي ڳالهه ڪري ٿي، ۽ ٻن مشهور ٽيسٽن جي به جيڪي هيڊ تي ڪم نٿا ڪن. جيڪا به هيڊ خريد ڪريو ان تي آزمايو، اسان جي به.
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of that you can check in the kitchen, and some only a laboratory can find. This guide talks about both, and also about two popular tests that do not work on turmeric. Try it on whatever turmeric you buy, ours too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: هيڊ جي جانچ کان پوءِ پاڻيءَ جا ٻه گلاس. کاٻي: هلڪو پيلو پاڻي ۽ پائوڊر تري ۾ ويٺل. ساڄي: گهرو پيلو پاڻي ۽ پائوڊر مان هيٺ لهندڙ پيلون لڪيرون.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: light yellow water and powder settled at the bottom. Right: dark yellow water and yellow streaks coming down from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧پاڻيءَ واري جانچ⟦/1⟧کاٻي: پائوڊر هيٺ ويهي ويو آهي ۽ پاڻي هلڪو پيلو آهي. ساڄي: پائوڊر لهندي ان مان گهريون پيلون لڪيرون نڪتيون، ۽ پاڻي گهرو پيلو ٿي ويو. ان تي ليبارٽري ٽيسٽ ڪرائڻ لائق آهي.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled down and the water is light yellow. Right: as the powder sank deep yellow streaks came out of it, and the water became dark yellow. It is worth getting a laboratory test done on it.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: پاڻيءَ جي گلاس تي هڪ ننڍو چمچو هيڊ ڇٽيو ۽ هلائڻ کان سواءِ ويهڻ ڏيو. هيڊ هيٺ ٻڏي ٿي ۽ پاڻي هلڪو پيلو رهي ٿو؛ جيڪڏهن پاڻي هڪدم گهرو پيلو ٿئي ته اهو ملايل رنگ ڏانهن اشارو آهي. هيءَ جانچ ليڊ ڪروميٽ يا چاڪ نٿي ڳولي سگهي، تنهنڪري پڪي جواب لاءِ کاڌي جي جانچ واري ليبارٽري ڏانهن وڃو. آئوڊين ٽيسٽ ڇڏي ڏيو: هيڊ ۾ پنهنجو نشاستو هوندو آهي.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle a small spoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it sit without stirring. Turmeric sinks down and the water stays light yellow; if the water immediately turns dark yellow that is a sign pointing to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer go to a food testing laboratory. Skip the iodine test: turmeric has its own starch.

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: جهڙوڪ ميٽانل پيلو، جيڪو ڦڪي هيڊ کي وڌيڪ چمڪدار ڏيکاري سگهي ٿو. FSSAI هيڊ ۾ ملايل رنگ جي اجازت نٿو ڏئي.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: ليڊ ڪروميٽ ۽ ليڊ جا ٻيا لوڻ
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other lead salts

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: ليڊ ڪروميٽ رنگ (پينٽ) ۾ استعمال ٿيندڙ هڪ پيلو رنگ آهي. Stanford جي اڳواڻيءَ ۾ 2019 ۽ 2024 ۾ ڇپيل اڀياسن ان کي ڏکڻ ايشيا جي ڪجهه حصن جي هيڊ ۾ لڌو. FSSAI هيڊ ۾ ان جي بلڪل اجازت نٿو ڏئي.
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow colour used in paint. Studies led by Stanford published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric in some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: هڪ سستو اڇو پائوڊر جيڪو وزن وڌائي ٿو.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: ٻين فصلن جو اٽو يا نشاستو. FSSAI جو معيار ان کي به منع ڪري ٿو.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. The FSSAI standard forbids it too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: هڪ صاف گلاس ڪمري جي گرميءَ واري پاڻيءَ سان ڀريو.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a clean glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: مٿان هڪ سنئون ننڍو چمچو هيڊ پائوڊر ڇٽيو. نه هلايو.
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level small spoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: پهريون منٽ ڏسو جڏهن پائوڊر هيٺ ٻڏي. ان مان هيٺ لهندڙ رنگين لڪيرون ڏسو.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks down. Look for coloured streaks coming down from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 کان 20 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو. پوءِ گلاس کي اڇي ڀت يا ڪاغذ جي ورق سامهون جهليو ۽ ويٺل پائوڊر جي مٿان پاڻي ڏسو.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Light yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.7253b4d90896.t: ملايل رنگ جي ڪا نشاني ناهي.

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: گهريون پيلون لڪيرون، يا منٽن ۾ گهرو پيلو پاڻي
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or dark yellow water within minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: ٿي سگهي ٿو رنگ ملايل هجي. اهو بيچ استعمال ڪرڻ بند ڪريو ۽ ان جي جانچ ڪرايو.
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been added. Stop using that batch and get it checked.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧هي ڇو ڪم ڪري ٿو.⟦/1⟧ هيڊ جو پنهنجو پيلو رنگ، ڪرڪيومن، پاڻيءَ ۾ مشڪل سان ڳري ٿو، تنهنڪري پائوڊر ٻڏي ٿو ۽ پاڻي رڳو ٿورو رنگجي ٿو. ميٽانل پيلي جهڙا رنگ آسانيءَ سان ڳرن ٿا ۽ پاڻي جلدي رنگين ڪن ٿا.
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and the water is only slightly coloured. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧هي ڇا نٿو ڳولي.⟦/1⟧ ليڊ ڪروميٽ ۽ چاڪ به پاڻيءَ ۾ نٿا ڳرن، تنهنڪري انهن سان مليل هيڊ هن جانچ مان پاس ٿي سگهي ٿي. رڳو ليبارٽري ٽيسٽ ئي انهن جي نه هجڻ جو پتو ڏئي سگهي ٿي.
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this does not find.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a laboratory test can show their absence.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: تمام سنهو پائوڊر ڪجهه دير پاڻيءَ کي گدلو رکي سگهي ٿو. گدلو هجڻ ٺيڪ آهي؛ صاف، گهرو پيلو رنگ ئي ڏسڻو آهي.
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for some time. Being cloudy is fine; a clear, deep yellow colour is what to look for.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: جانچ 2: جيڪڏهن سڄي هيڊ خريد ڪريو
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: سُڪل هيڊ جي هڪ ڳنڍي وچ مان ڀڃو. هيڊ اندر تائين پيلي-نارنگي هوندي آهي، تنهنڪري اندر به گهڻو ڪري ٻاهر جهڙو ڏسڻ گهرجي. ڦڪي يا مُنجهيل اندر مٿان چمڪدار پيلي کل جو مطلب ٿي سگهي ٿو ته مٿاڇري تي رنگ ملايو ويو آهي. وڪڻندڙ کان پڇو، يا ان جي جانچ ڪرايو.
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break a dried turmeric finger in the middle. Turmeric is yellow-orange all the way inside, so the inside too should look mostly like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a dull or muddled inside can mean that colour has been added to the surface. Ask the seller, or get it checked.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: آئوڊين نشاستي سان ملي نيرو-ڪارو ٿي وڃي ٿو، ۽ گهڻو ڪري هيڊ ۾ اٽو ڳولڻ لاءِ ٻڌايو ويندو آهي. پر هيڊ ۾ پاڻ نشاستو هوندو آهي، تنهنڪري ٻنهي صورتن ۾ نيرو-ڪارو ٿئي ٿو. انهيءَ ڪري FSSAI جو پنهنجو ڪتاب آئوڊين ٽيسٽ هيڊ کان سواءِ ٻين پيٺل مصالحن لاءِ استعمال ڪري ٿو.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine turns blue-black on meeting starch, and is often told for finding flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself has starch, so in both cases it becomes blue-black. That is why FSSAI's own book uses the iodine test for ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: هيڊ ۾ ليڊ، ميٽانل پيلي ۽ چاڪ لاءِ FSSAI جا ٽيسٽ تيز هائيڊروڪلورڪ يا سلفيورڪ تيزاب استعمال ڪن ٿا. اهي تيزاب چمڙي ۽ اکين کي ساڙين ٿا. اهي ليبارٽريءَ جا آهن، رڌڻي جا نه.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use strong hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong to the laboratory, not the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: پڪي جواب لاءِ: کاڌي جي جانچ واري ليبارٽري
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: food testing laboratory

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL کان منظور ٿيل کاڌي جي جانچ واري ليبارٽري هيڊ ۾ ليڊ ۽ ملايل رنگن جي جانچ ڪري سگهي ٿي. ليبارٽري کان پڇو ته ڪيترو نمونو گهرجي، پائوڊر کي ان جي بند پيڪ ۾ يا صاف بند ٿيلهيءَ ۾ رکو، ۽ پيڪ تي ڇپيل بيچ نمبر لکي رکو. FSSAI پنهنجي ويب سائيٽ تي کاڌي جي جانچ واري منظور ليبارٽرين جي فهرست ڇپي ٿو.
seg.1883beca4d73.back: A NABL-approved food testing laboratory can check turmeric for lead and added colours. Ask the laboratory how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean closed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of approved food testing laboratories on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy
seg.456379c75c24.t: خريد ڪرڻ کان اڳ پيڪ پڙهو

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI لائسنس يا رجسٽريشن نمبر. اهو FSSAI جي FoSCoS ويب سائيٽ تي ڳولي سگهو ٿا.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: جنهن اهو ٺاهيو يا پيڪ ڪيو، ان جو نالو ۽ پتو.
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: Name and address of who made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: وزن، MRP، بيچ يا لاٽ نمبر، ۽ best-before تاريخ.
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Weight, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: اهو ڪٿي پوکيو ويو. الڳ علائقن جي هيڊ جو رنگ الڳ هوندو آهي، تنهنڪري علائقي جو نالو هجڻ سان توهان ساڳيءَ شيءِ جو ساڳيءَ سان ڀيٽ ڪري سگهو ٿا.
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions has different colour, so having the region name lets you compare like with like.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: پيڪ جي زِپ بند رکو، يا پائوڊر کي سُڪي، هوا بند جار ۾ وجهو.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or put the powder in a dry, airtight jar.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو. آلو چمچو ئي هيڊ ۾ ڳنڍيون پوائي ٿو.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. A wet spoon is what causes lumps in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: سڌي اُس کان پري رکو، اُس رنگ کي ڦڪو ڪري ٿي.
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep away from direct sun, sun makes the colour dull.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: ڇا تمام چمڪدار پيلي هيڊ خراب نشاني آهي؟
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: اڪيلي سر نه. رنگ قسم، پوکڻ جي جاءِ ۽ سُڪائڻ ۽ پيهڻ جي طريقي سان بدلجي ٿو، تنهنڪري هيڊ جا رنگ گهڻو الڳ ٿين ٿا. ڏسڻو اهو آهي ته ڇا رنگ پائوڊر مان گهڻي آسانيءَ سان نڪري ٿو، جيئن پاڻيءَ واري جانچ ۾.
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not on its own. Colour changes with variety, place of growing and the way of drying and grinding, so turmeric colours differ a lot. What is to be seen is whether colour comes out of the powder very easily, as in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: ڇا پاڻيءَ واري جانچ ڏيکاري سگهي ٿي ته هيڊ ۾ ليڊ ناهي؟
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: نه. ليڊ ڪروميٽ پاڻيءَ ۾ نٿو ڳري، تنهنڪري پاڻيءَ واري جانچ ان کي ڏسي نٿي سگهي. رڳو ليبارٽري ٽيسٽ ڏسي سگهي ٿي.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a laboratory test can see it.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: نمي سبب. آلو چمچو يا کليل پيڪ پائوڊر کي پاڻي جذب ڪرڻ ڏئي ٿو. ڳنڍيون سُڪي چمچي سان ڀڃو ۽ پيڪ بند رکو.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Because of moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder absorb water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: جيڪڏهن ڪا جانچ غلط لڳي ته ڇا ڪجي؟
seg.87fe2929801d.back: What to do if a check looks wrong?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: اهو بيچ استعمال ڪرڻ بند ڪريو، پيڪ سانڍي رکو، ۽ بيچ نمبر سان وڪڻندڙ سان رابطو ڪريو. توهان FSSAI کي ان جي Food Safety Connect ايپ ذريعي به ٻڌائي سگهو ٿا. جيڪڏهن اسان جي آهي، ته پيڪ ۽ گلاس جي تصوير اسان کي WhatsApp ڪريو.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also tell FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: اهي جانچون اسان جي هيڊ تي به آزمايو. جيڪڏهن ڪجهه به عجيب لڳي، ته پيڪ تي لکيل بيچ نمبر سان تصوير ⟦1⟧اسان کي WhatsApp ڪريو⟦/1⟧.
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Try these checks on our turmeric too. If anything looks strange, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number written on the pack.

seg.f803aad7e26d.src: Turmeric Adulteration Test at Home (Haldi, Pasupu) | 1acrefarms

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: ڪوڊي ڪورا اهو ڪڪڙ جو سالڻ آهي جيڪو آچر جي منجهند آنڌرا جي گهرن ۾ ٺهندو آهي: هڏين سميت ڪڪڙ مرچ ۽ هيڊ ۾ رکي، گهري سونهري بصرن ۽ ٽماٽن جي شوربي ۾ پچايو ويندو آهي، ۽ آخر ۾ گرم مصالحو وڌو ويندو آهي. اهو گرم چانورن سان دسترخوان تي اچي ٿو، ۽ بچيل سالڻ رات جو ڊوسا يا چپاتيءَ سان کائبو آهي.
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi Kura is the chicken curry that is made in Andhra homes on Sunday afternoon: chicken with bones is kept in chilli and turmeric, cooked in a gravy of deep golden onions and tomatoes, and at the end garam masala is added. It comes to the dining spread with hot rice, and the leftover curry is eaten at night with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: هتي تکاڻ اسان جي تيجا مرچ پائوڊر مان اچي ٿي، گنٽور جي اها تمام تکي مرچ جيڪا آنڌرا جي سالڻن کي تکو ذائقو ۽ چمڪندڙ ڳاڙهو رنگ ڏئي ٿي، ۽ مصالحي ۾ اسان جو هيڊ پائوڊر به آهي. هي ترڪيب 4 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي ۽ چڱي تکي آهي؛ صلاحن ۾ ٻڌايل آهي ته تکاڻ ڪيئن گهٽ ڪجي.
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: Here the heat comes from our Teja chilli powder, that very hot chilli of Guntur which gives Andhra curries a hot taste and shining red colour, and in the masala there is also our turmeric powder. This recipe is for 4 people and is quite hot; in the tips it is told how to reduce the heat.

seg.6037465ed8d2.src: Total includes 30 minutes for the marinade.
seg.6037465ed8d2.t: ڪل وقت ۾ مصالحي ۾ رکڻ جا 30 منٽ شامل آهن.
seg.6037465ed8d2.back: The total time includes 30 minutes of keeping in the masala.

seg.9cb820880217.src: Marinate chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook it in a deep-golden onion and tomato gravy. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.
seg.9cb820880217.t: ڪڪڙ کي ڏهي، تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ ۾ رکو، پوءِ گهري سونهري بصرن ۽ ٽماٽن جي شوربي ۾ پچايو. آخر ۾ گرم مصالحو ۽ ساوا ڌاڻا وجهو.
seg.9cb820880217.back: Keep the chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook in a gravy of deep golden onions and tomatoes. At the end add garam masala and green coriander.

seg.d35e8cdc661c.src: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry-cut pieces, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.t: 750 g ڪڪڙ ⟦1⟧هڏين سميت، سالڻ لاءِ ڪٽيل ٽڪرا، ڌوئي چڱيءَ طرح پاڻي ڪڍيل⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.back: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧with bones, pieces cut for curry, washed and water drained well⟦/1⟧

seg.c84970cf7b6f.t: ½ ڪپ ڏهي ⟦1⟧ٿلهو، ڦيڻي سنئون ڪيل⟦/1⟧

seg.9e9cb51b1458.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.t: 2 ننڍا چمچا تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧تمام تکو؛ وچولي تکاڻ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو وجهو⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.back: 2 small spoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat add 1 small spoon⟦/1⟧

seg.9654088d205e.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧plus more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو لوڻ ⟦1⟧آخر ۾ ذائقي موجب ٻيو⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.back: 1 small spoon salt ⟦1⟧more at the end according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.fff6117cc0f5.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual Andhra choice⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.t: 3 وڏا چمچا تيل ⟦1⟧آنڌرا ۾ عام طور مونگ پَليءَ جو تيل⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.back: 3 big spoons oil ⟦1⟧in Andhra usually groundnut oil⟦/1⟧

seg.4a1335d92ae2.t: 2 وڏا بصر ⟦1⟧سنها ڪٽيل، لڳ ڀڳ 2 ڪپ⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.t: 1 ڪپ گرم پاڻي ⟦1⟧پتلي شوربي لاءِ ٿورو وڌيڪ⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for thin gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.t: ⟦1⟧سنّم مرچ پائوڊر⟦/1⟧ سان به سٺو ٿئي ٿو.
seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: It also goes well with ⟦1⟧Sannam chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: ڪڪڙ تي ڏهي، تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ مکيو. 30 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو. جيڪڏهن رڌڻي گرم هجي ته پيالو ڍڪي فرج ۾ رکو.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt onto the chicken. Leave for 30 minutes. If the kitchen is hot, cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: ڳري پين يا ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وچولي باهه تي تيل گرم ڪريو. لونگ، الائچي ۽ دارچيني وجهو ۽ ڪجهه سيڪنڊ تڙڪڻ ڏيو.
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat oil in a heavy pan or kadhai on medium fire. Add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon and let them crackle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: بصر، ساوا مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا وجهو.
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onions, green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: بصرن کي تيل ۾ گهرو سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو. وچولي باهه تي ان ۾ 12–15 منٽ لڳن ٿا؛ گهڻو هلائيندا رهو ته هڪجيترا ڳاڙها ٿين ۽ سڙن نه.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onions in oil until deep golden. On medium fire this takes 12–15 minutes; keep stirring a lot so they become evenly red and do not burn.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ وجهو، پوءِ ٽماٽا، ۽ نرم ٿيڻ تائين پچايو. پيسٽ کي 1 منٽ تريو جيستائين ڪچي بوءِ وڃي، پوءِ ٽماٽن کي 5–6 منٽ چِٿيندي پچايو، جيستائين ڳري وڃن ۽ ڪنارن تي تيل نظر اچي.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook until soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes 5–6 minutes while mashing, until they melt and oil appears at the edges.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Mix in coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: ڪڪڙ وجهو ۽ ڍڪي وچولي باهه تي ايستائين پچايو جو هڏيءَ جي ويجهو ڪو گلابي رنگ نه رهي. پهريان 5 منٽ کليل تريو جيستائين ٽڪرا شفاف نه رهن ۽ اڇا ٿي وڃن، پوءِ گرم پاڻي وجهو، ڍڪيو ۽ لڳ ڀڳ 20 منٽ پچايو، وچ وچ ۾ هلائيندا رهو.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add the chicken and, covered, cook on medium fire until no pink colour remains near the bone. First fry open for 5 minutes until the pieces no longer remain transparent and become white, then add hot water, cover and cook about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: هڪ ٿلهو ٽڪرو ڏسو: ڪڪڙ تڏهن پچيل آهي جڏهن هڏيءَ جي ويجهو ڪو گلابي رنگ نه رهي ۽ رس صاف نڪري. شوربو چکو ۽ ضرورت هجي ته لوڻ وجهو.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Look at a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: گرم مصالحو ۽ ساوا ڌاڻا ملايو. 3 منٽ کليل هلڪي باهه تي پچايو، جيستائين شوربو توهان جي پسند جيترو ٿلهو ٿئي ۽ مٿان تيل جي ڳاڙهي تهه تري اچي.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Mix in garam masala and green coriander. Cook open on low fire for 3 minutes, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red layer of oil floats up on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: باهه بند ڪريو ۽ پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ سالڻ کي 10 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو؛ شوربو ٺهي بيهي ٿو ۽ ذائقو گڏجي ٿو.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Turn off the fire and leave the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy sets and the taste comes together.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: بصرن کي گهرو سونهري ڪريو؛ شوربي جو رنگ ۽ ٿولهه انهن مان ئي اچي ٿي.
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Make the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and thickness come from them alone.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر تمام تکو آهي. وچولي سالڻ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو وجهو، يا ڳاڙهي رنگ ۽ نرم تکاڻ لاءِ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وجهو.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry add 1 small spoon, or for red colour and mild heat add Sannam chilli powder.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: هڏين وارا ٽڪرا وٺو؛ هڏيون شوربي کي گهرائي ڏين ٿيون.
seg.57940a63282d.back: Take pieces with bones; the bones give the gravy depth.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: ڪڪڙ وجهڻ کان اڳ ٽماٽن جي مصالحي مان تيل الڳ ٿيڻ ڏيو، نه ته شوربو ڪچو لڳندو.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Before adding the chicken let the oil separate from the tomato masala, otherwise the gravy will taste raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: ڪوبّري ڪوڊي ڪورا: 3 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل ناريل، 1 وڏو چمچو خشخاش ۽ ٿورو پاڻي گڏ پيهيو، ۽ وڌيڪ ڀريل شوربي لاءِ اها پيسٽ گرم مصالحي سان گڏ ملايو.
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari Kodi Kura: grind together 3 big spoons grated coconut, 1 big spoon poppy seeds and a little water, and for a fuller gravy mix that paste in together with the garam masala.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: پيٺل مصالحو: 1 وڏو چمچو ڌاڻا، 1 ننڍو چمچو سونف، 3 لونگ ۽ دارچينيءَ جو ننڍو ٽڪرو سُڪا ڀُڃيو، پيهيو، ۽ ڌاڻا پائوڊر ۽ گرم مصالحي بدران وجهو.
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 big spoon coriander, 1 small spoon fennel, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and add instead of coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: پريشر ڪُڪر: ڪڪڙ ۽ پاڻي وجهڻ کان پوءِ 2 سيٽيون ڏيو ۽ دٻاءُ پاڻمرادو لهڻ ڏيو.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken and water give 2 whistles and let the pressure drop by itself.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: آچر واري طريقي سان گرم پيش ڪريو، ٻاڦ ۾ پچيل چانورن ۽ هڪ چمچي گيهه سان. چپاتي، ڊوسا يا راگي سنگٽيءَ سان به سٺو لڳي ٿو.
seg.8b4376996905.back: Serve hot the Sunday way, with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: فرج ۾ ڍڪي 2 ڏينهن تائين رکو؛ ٻيهر ايترو گرم ڪريو جو اندر تائين ٻاڦ نڪري. ٻئي ڏينهن سالڻ جو ذائقو وڌيڪ گهرو ٿئي ٿو.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days; reheat so hot that steam comes out right to the inside. On the second day the curry's taste becomes deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: آنڌرا ڪڪڙ جو سالڻ گهٽ تکو ڪيئن ٺاهجي؟
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How to make Andhra chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر 1 ننڍو چمچو ڪريو، يا سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وجهو، جيڪو ساڳيو ڳاڙهو رنگ نرم تکاڻ سان ڏئي ٿو. آخر ۾ هڪ چمچو ڏهي ملائڻ سان به تکاڻ نرم ٿئي ٿي.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Make the Teja chilli powder 1 small spoon, or add Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with mild heat. Mixing in a spoon of curd at the end also softens the heat.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: آنڌرا ڪڪڙ جو سالڻ ايترو تکو ڇو هوندو آهي؟
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: آنڌرا جي رڌ پچاءَ ۾ تيجا جهڙا گنٽور جا مرچ وڌا ويندا آهن، جيڪي ٻين اڪثر علائقن جي سالڻن ۾ پوندڙ مرچ پائوڊر کان گهڻا تکا آهن. تکاڻ هن کاڌي جو حصو آهي.
seg.ada87f188506.back: In Andhra cooking Guntur chillies like Teja are added, which are much hotter than the chilli powder that goes into the curries of most other regions. The heat is part of this food.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: ڪيئن خبر پوي ته ڪڪڙ پوري طرح پچي ويو آهي؟
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How to know that the chicken is fully cooked?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: هڏيءَ جي ويجهو سڀ کان ٿلهي ٽڪري کي ڪٽي ڏسو. ڪڪڙ تڏهن پچيل آهي جڏهن هڏيءَ جي ويجهو ڪو گلابي رنگ نه رهي ۽ رس صاف نڪري.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut and look at the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: ڇا ڏهيءَ کان سواءِ ڪوڊي ڪورا ٺاهي سگهجي ٿي؟
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can Kodi Kura be made without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: ها. ڪڪڙ کي مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر، لوڻ ۽ 1 وڏي چمچي ليمي جي رس ۾ رکو، ۽ شوربي ۾ هڪ ٽماٽو وڌيڪ وجهو.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Keep the chicken in chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 big spoon of lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: آنڌرا ڪوڊي ڪورا · آنڌرا ڪوڊي ڪورا جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: Andhra Kodi Kura · Andhra Kodi Kura recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: آنڌرا ڪوڊي ڪورا. آنڌرا جو آچر وارو ڪڪڙ جو سالڻ: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ۽ هيڊ پائوڊر ۾ رکيل ڪڪڙ، گهري بصر-ٽماٽي شوربي ۾ گرم مصالحي سان پچايل.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: Andhra Kodi Kura. Andhra's Sunday chicken curry: chicken kept in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.

seg.49ffbe38c150.t: آنڌرا ڪوڊي ڪورا (آنڌرا ڪڪڙ جو سالڻ) · 1acrefarms

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: آنڌرا ڪوڊي ڪورا: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Kura: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal
seg.d04209f30de4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · بيلّم پونگلي · ڳڙ واري مٺي پونگل

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: بيلّم پونگلي اها مٺي پونگل آهي جيڪا تيلگو گهرن ۾ سنڪرانتيءَ جي صبح ٺهندي آهي: چانور ۽ ڀُڳل مونگ جي دال تمام نرم پچائي، پوءِ ڳڙ سان مٺي ڪئي ويندي آهي ۽ گيهه سان ڀري ويندي آهي. ڏڻ جي کاڌي کان اڳ ان کي نئويديم طور چاڙهيو ويندو آهي، ۽ ڪيترن ئي مندرن ۽ جمعي جي پوڄائن ۾ اها پرساد به آهي.
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam Pongali is the sweet pongal that is made in Telugu homes on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal are cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and filled with ghee. Before the festival meal it is offered as naivedyam, and in many temples and Friday pujas it is also prasad.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ ان کي هلڪو ناسي رنگ ۽ ٽافي جهڙي ڀريل مٺاڻ ڏئي ٿو، ۽ اسان جي جيڊي پپّو پيڪ جا گيهه ۾ تريل سڄا ڪاجو ڪُرڪُرائپ آڻين ٿا. هي ترڪيب 4 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.17053455adbb.back: Sugarcane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and toffee-like full sweetness, and the whole cashews from our JD Pappu pack fried in ghee bring crunch. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: پچائڻ جو وقت پريشر ڪُڪر لاءِ آهي؛ ديڳڙيءَ ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 15 منٽ وڌيڪ لڳندا.
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is for a pressure cooker; in a pot about 15 minutes more will be needed.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: ڀُڳل مونگ جي دال ۽ چانور تمام نرم ٿيڻ تائين پچايو، ڳاريل ڪمند جو ڳڙ ملايو ۽ چمڪدار ٿيڻ تائين هلڪي باهه تي پچايو. آخر ۾ گيهه ۾ تريل ڪاجو، ڪشمش ۽ الائچي وجهو.
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook roasted moong dal and rice until very soft, mix in melted sugarcane jaggery and cook on low fire until glossy. At the end add cashews fried in ghee, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ ڪپ مونگ جي دال ⟦1⟧ڌوتل پيلي مونگ جي دال (پيسراپپّو)، لڳ ڀڳ 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧washed yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧هلڪو دٻائي ماپيو، لڳ ڀڳ 150 g؛ وڌيڪ مٺو وڻي ته ٿورو ٻيو⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧measured lightly pressed, about 150 g; if you like it sweeter a little more⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧
seg.8dff8f977372.back: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧for melting the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: هڪ چپٽي کائڻ وارو ڪافور (پچا ڪرپورم) ⟦1⟧مرضي؛ تمام ننڍي چپٽي⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: مونگ جي دال هلڪي سونهري ٿيڻ تائين ڀُڃيو، پوءِ چانورن سان گڏ تمام نرم ۽ ڳريل ٿيڻ تائين پچايو. شروعات ۾ دال کي پريشر ڪُڪر يا ڳري تري واري ديڳڙيءَ ۾ هلڪي باهه تي سُڪو ڀُڃيو، هلائيندا رهو، جيستائين ميوي جهڙي خوشبو اچي ۽ هلڪي سونهري ٿئي، لڳ ڀڳ 3–4 منٽ.
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Roast the moong dal until light golden, then cook together with rice until very soft and melted. At the start dry-roast the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low fire, stirring, until a fruit-like aroma comes and it becomes light golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: ڀُڳل دال ۾ چانور وجهو، ٻنهي کي 2–3 دفعا پاڻي بدلائي گڏ ڌوئو، ۽ پاڻي ڪڍي ڇڏيو.
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together changing water 2–3 times, and drain the water.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 ڪپ پاڻي وجهو. وچولي باهه تي 4–5 سيٽيون ڏيو ۽ دٻاءُ پاڻمرادو لهڻ ڏيو، يا ديڳڙيءَ ۾ ڍڪي 25–30 منٽ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو، سُڪي وڃي ته ٿورو گرم پاڻي وجهو.
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups water. On medium fire give 4–5 whistles and let the pressure drop by itself, or in a pot cook covered 25–30 minutes on low fire, adding a little hot water if it dries.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: کولي چانور ۽ دال کي ڏوئيءَ جي پٺيءَ سان هلڪو چِٿيو. اهو نرم ۽ دليي جهڙو هجي، سُڪو نه.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open and lightly mash the rice and dal with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: ڳڙ کي ¼ ڪپ پاڻيءَ ۾ ڳاري چانورن ۾ وجهو. ڳڙ ۽ پاڻي ننڍي پين ۾ هلڪي باهه تي هلائيندي گرم ڪريو، بس ڳرڻ تائين، لڳ ڀڳ 2–3 منٽ؛ اٻارڻ جي ضرورت ناهي.
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and add to the rice. Heat jaggery and water in a small pan on low fire while stirring, just until melted, about 2–3 minutes; no need to boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: هلائيندي هلڪي باهه تي ٿلهو ۽ چمڪدار ٿيڻ تائين پچايو، 5–7 منٽ؛ 2 وڏا چمچا گيهه ملايو. باهه هلڪي رکو ۽ تري تائين هلائيندا رهو، ڇو ته ڳڙ پوڻ کان پوءِ پونگلي جلدي تري ۾ چنبڙي ٿي.
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Stirring, cook on low fire until thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; mix in 2 big spoons ghee. Keep the fire low and keep stirring to the bottom, because after the jaggery goes in the pongali quickly sticks to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: چکي ڏسو، ۽ وڌيڪ مٺي گهرجي ته ٿورو ٻيو ڳاريل ڳڙ ملايو.
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if more sweetness is needed mix in a little more melted jaggery.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: ڪاجو باقي گيهه ۾ تريو؛ الائچيءَ سان گڏ وجهو. باقي 2 وڏا چمچا گيهه ننڍي پين ۾ وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي گرم ڪريو ۽ ڪاجو سونهري ٿيڻ تائين هلائيندا رهو، لڳ ڀڳ 1 منٽ، آخري ڪجهه سيڪنڊن ۾ ڪشمش وجهو جيستائين ڦُلجي وڃي.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry the cashews in the remaining ghee; add along with cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 big spoons ghee in a small pan on medium-low fire and keep stirring the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding raisins in the last few seconds until they puff up.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: ڪاجو، ڪشمش ۽ گيهه پونگليءَ مٿان وجهو، الائچي پائوڊر ۽ ڪافور، جيڪڏهن وجهو ٿا، ڇڻڪيو ۽ چڱيءَ طرح ملايو.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and camphor, if you are adding it, and mix well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: باهه بند ڪريو ۽ گرم پيش ڪريو. پونگلي رکڻ سان ٿلهي ٿيندي آهي؛ ضرورت هجي ته ڪجهه چمچا گرم پاڻي وجهي پتلي ڪريو.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the fire and serve hot. The pongali becomes thick on keeping; if needed thin it by adding a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: چانور ۽ دال پوري طرح نرم پچايو؛ ڳڙ پوڻ کان پوءِ اهي وڌيڪ نرم نٿا ٿين.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; after the jaggery goes in they do not become any softer.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: مونگ جي دال ڀُڃڻ سان پونگليءَ ۾ ميوي جهڙي خوشبو اچي ٿي؛ باهه هلڪي رکو ته سونهري ٿئي، ناسي نه.
seg.c5408f916731.back: Roasting the moong dal brings a fruit-like aroma to the pongali; keep the fire low so it becomes golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: ڳري تري وارو پين وٺو ۽ ڳڙ پوڻ کان پوءِ هلائيندا رهو؛ اهو جلدي چنبڙي سڙي ٿو.
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Take a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring after the jaggery goes in; it quickly sticks and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: پونگليءَ کي باهه تان تڏهن لاهيو جڏهن اڃا ٿوري پتلي هجي؛ ٿڌي ٿيڻ سان ڄمي ٿي.
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the fire when it is still a little thin; it sets on cooling.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ: اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهو، پونگلي وڌيڪ گهري رنگ جي ٿيندي ۽ مٺاڻ گهري، دونهين جهڙي.
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: add the same amount of grated palm jaggery, the pongali will become darker in colour and the sweetness deep, smoke-like.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: چڪيرا پونگلي: ڳڙ بدران ¾ ڪپ کنڊ وجهو، هلڪي رنگ ۽ کنڊ جي مٺاڻ واري لاءِ.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera Pongali: instead of jaggery add ¾ cup sugar, for one with lighter colour and sugar sweetness.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: سنڪرانتيءَ جي صبح نئويديم طور چاڙهيو، پوءِ ڏڻ جي کاڌي سان گرم پيش ڪريو، پليهورا ۽ گاريلو سان گڏ.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: Offer as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve hot with the festival meal, together with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: بچيل پونگلي فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 2 ڏينهن اندر کائو. پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ ٿورو گرم پاڻي ۽ ٿورو گيهه وجهي، هلائيندي گرم ڪريو.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Keep leftover pongali covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Before serving, add a little hot water and a little ghee and heat while stirring.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: پونگلي ۽ چڪيرا پونگليءَ ۾ ڪهڙو فرق آهي؟
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: رڳو پونگلي چوڻ سان اڪثر ڪاري مرچ ۽ زيري واري لوڻياٺي پونگلي مراد هوندي آهي. چڪيرا پونگلي ۽ بيلّم پونگلي مٺيون قسمون آهن، جيڪي کنڊ يا ڳڙ سان ٺهن ٿيون.
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: Saying just pongali often means the salty pongali with black pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are sweet kinds, which are made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: ڇا بيلّم پونگلي پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ ٺاهي سگهجي ٿي؟
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can bellam pongali be made in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: ها. ڀُڳل دال ۽ چانور 3 ڪپ پاڻيءَ سان 4–5 سيٽين تائين پچايو، دٻاءُ پاڻمرادو لهڻ ڏيو، پوءِ ڳاريل ڳڙ وجهو ۽ کليل ڪُڪر ۾ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو.
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop by itself, then add melted jaggery and cook in the open cooker on low fire.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: ٿڌي ٿيڻ کان پوءِ منهنجي پونگلي سخت ڇو ٿي وئي؟
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become hard after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: پونگلي ٿڌي ٿيڻ سان ڄمي ٿي، ۽ ڳڙ پوڻ کان پوءِ گهڻو دير پچائڻ سان وڌيڪ سخت ٿئي ٿي. اڃا ٿوري پتلي هجي تڏهن لاهيو، ۽ بچيل کي گرم پاڻيءَ سان پتلو ڪريو.
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: Pongali sets on cooling, and cooking too long after the jaggery goes in makes it harder. Take it off while still a little thin, and thin the leftover with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: ڇا پونگليءَ ۾ تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهي سگهجي ٿو؟
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can palm jaggery be added to pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: ها. اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ (تاٽي بيلّم) وجهو. پونگلي گهري رنگ جي ٿيندي ۽ ذائقو گهرو ۽ ٿورو دونهين جهڙو.
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Add the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali will be darker in colour and the taste deep and a little smoke-like.

seg.d63c3cc4eeac.t: بيلّم پونگلي · بيلّم پونگليءَ جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: بيلّم پونگلي. سنڪرانتيءَ لاءِ بيلّم پونگلي: نرم پچيل چانور ۽ ڀُڳل مونگ جي دال، ڪمند جي ڳڙ سان مٺي ۽ گيهه ۾ تريل ڪاجو سان. 4 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: Bellam Pongali. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: soft-cooked rice and roasted moong dal, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery and with cashews fried in ghee. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: بيلّم پونگلي: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.28c87ea23a5c.t: 1 ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.t: هڪ چپٽي کائڻ وارو ڪافور (پچا ڪرپورم)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: آنڌرا چيپلا پلوسو ⟦1⟧(آنڌرا املي واري مڇيءَ جو سالڻ)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra tamarind fish curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.eb258fb767e0.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · چيپلا پلوسو · آنڌرا مڇيءَ جو سالڻ

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: چيپلا پلوسو ساحلي آنڌرا جو املي وارو مڇيءَ جو سالڻ آهي، جيڪو گوداوري ضلعن ۾ خاص ڌيان سان ٺهندو آهي: مڇيءَ جا ٿلها ٽڪرا کٽي، ڳاڙهي املي جي شوربي ۾ بصرن، ساون مرچن ۽ ڪڙي پتن سان هلڪي باهه تي پچايا ويندا آهن. هي آچر جي منجهند جو کاڌو آهي، ۽ ڪيترا گهر ان کي مٽيءَ جي ديڳڙيءَ ۾ پچائي ٻئي ڏينهن لاءِ رکندا آهن، جڏهن شوربو مڇيءَ ۾ جذب ٿي ويندو آهي.
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala Pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, which is made with special attention in the Godavari districts: thick pieces of fish are cooked on low fire in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. This is a Sunday afternoon meal, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy gets absorbed into the fish.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: اسان جو هيڊ پائوڊر مصالحي ۾ به پوي ٿو ۽ شوربي ۾ به. سنّم مرچ پائوڊر پلوسو کي گهرو ڳاڙهو رنگ ۽ هڪجيتري تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو جيڪا املي جي کٽاڻ سان توازن رکي ٿي. هي ترڪيب 4 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder goes both in the masala and in the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and an even heat that balances with the sourness of the tamarind. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: تياريءَ ۾ مصالحي ۾ رکڻ جا 15 منٽ شامل آهن. ڪجهه ڪلاڪ رکڻ کان پوءِ سالڻ اڃا وڌيڪ سٺو لڳي ٿو.
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: The preparation includes 15 minutes of keeping in the masala. After keeping a few hours the curry tastes even better.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: مڇيءَ کي لوڻ، هيڊ ۽ مرچ پائوڊر ۾ رکو، بصر ۽ مصالحا تريو، انهن کي املي جي پاڻيءَ ۾ اٻاريو، پوءِ مڇي شوربي ۾ هلائڻ کان سواءِ هلڪي باهه تي آهستي پچايو.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Keep the fish in salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then cook the fish slowly in the gravy on low fire without stirring.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g مڇيءَ جا ٽڪرا ⟦1⟧ٿلهن ٽڪرن ۾ ڪٽيل سخت گوشت واري مڇي: روهو (بوچا)، ڪورامينو (مرل) يا سير مڇي (ونجارم)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish cut in thick pieces: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.33ec1eb3d9cf.back: 1 small spoon salt ⟦1⟧for keeping in the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g املي ⟦1⟧ليمي جيڏو گولو، 2 ڪپ ڪوسي پاڻيءَ ۾ 15 منٽ پسايل⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.48591b048034.t: ¼ ننڍو چمچو ميٿي جا داڻا ⟦1⟧مينٿولو⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ ننڍو چمچو هيڊ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧¼ ننڍو چمچو مصالحي ۾ رکڻ لاءِ، ¼ ننڍو چمچو شوربي لاءِ⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ small spoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ small spoon for keeping in the masala, ¼ small spoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 وڏا چمچا سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧1 ننڍو چمچو مصالحي ۾ رکڻ لاءِ، باقي شوربي لاءِ⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 big spoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 small spoon for keeping in the masala, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو لوڻ ⟦1⟧شوربي لاءِ، يا ذائقي موجب⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 small spoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.t: ⟦1⟧تيجا مرچ پائوڊر⟦/1⟧ سان به سٺو ٿئي ٿو.
seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: It also goes well with ⟦1⟧Teja chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: مڇيءَ جا ٽڪرا پاڻيءَ ۾ ٻه ٽي دفعا آهستي ڌوئو ۽ چڱيءَ طرح پاڻي ڪڍي ڇڏيو.
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain the water well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: مڇيءَ تي لوڻ، هيڊ ۽ 1 ننڍو چمچو مرچ پائوڊر مکيو؛ 15 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو. مصالحي لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو لوڻ ۽ ¼ ننڍو چمچو هيڊ پائوڊر وٺو.
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub salt, turmeric and 1 small spoon chilli powder on the fish; leave for 15 minutes. For the masala take 1 small spoon salt and ¼ small spoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: پسايل املي کي ان جي پاڻيءَ ۾ چڱيءَ طرح نچوڙيو ۽ ڇاڻيو. توهان وٽ لڳ ڀڳ 2 ڪپ پتلو املي جو پاڻي هجڻ گهرجي.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain. You should have about 2 cups thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: ويڪري پين يا مٽيءَ جي ديڳڙيءَ ۾ وچولي باهه تي تيل گرم ڪريو. ميٿي، رائي ۽ زيرو وجهو ۽ تڙڪڻ ڏيو، خيال رکو ته ميٿي ڪاري نه ٿئي.
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: Heat oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium fire. Add fenugreek, mustard and cumin and let them crackle, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn black.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: بصر، مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا تيل ۾ نرم ٿيڻ تائين تريو؛ مصالحن جا پائوڊر وجهو. بصرن کي لڳ ڀڳ 6–8 منٽ تريو جيستائين نرم ۽ هلڪا سونهري ٿين، ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ ۽ ٽماٽو وجهي 2 منٽ پچايو، پوءِ باقي هيڊ پائوڊر، باقي سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ۽ ڌاڻا پائوڊر وجهي 30 سيڪنڊ هلايو.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry onions, chillies and curry leaves in the oil until soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: املي جو پاڻي وجهو ۽ 10 منٽ اٻاريو جيستائين تيل مٿي اچي. شوربي وارو لوڻ وجهو؛ املي جي ڪچي بوءِ ختم ٿي وڃي ۽ شوربو ٿورو ٿلهو ٿئي.
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Add the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until the oil comes up. Add the gravy salt; the raw smell of the tamarind should go away and the gravy become a little thick.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: شوربو چکو. اهو صاف کٽو، لوڻياٺو ۽ تکو هجڻ گهرجي، ڇو ته مڇي ان مان ڪجهه جذب ڪندي.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish will absorb some of it.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: مڇي آهستي وجهو ۽ ڍڪي 10–12 منٽ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو؛ پين کي گهمايو، چمچي سان نه هلايو. ٽڪرا هڪ تهه ۾ رکو، مٿان چمچي سان شوربو وجهو ۽ باهه هلڪي رکو.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Add the fish slowly and cook covered 10–12 minutes on low fire; swirl the pan, do not stir with a spoon. Keep the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over the top and keep the fire low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: هڪ ٽڪرو سڀ کان ٿلهي حصي کان ڏسو: مڇي تڏهن پچيل آهي جڏهن گوشت اندر تائين اڇو ٿي وڃي ۽ آرپار نظر نه اچي، ۽ هڏيءَ کان آسانيءَ سان الڳ ٿي وڃي.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Check one piece at its thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh has turned white all the way inside and is not see-through, and comes away from the bone easily.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: ساوا ڌاڻا ڇڻڪيو، باهه بند ڪريو ۽ پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ پلوسو کي ڍڪي گهٽ ۾ گهٽ 30 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle green coriander, turn off the fire and before serving leave the pulusu covered for at least 30 minutes.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: هلائڻ بدران پين کي گهمايو ته مڇي سڄي رهي.
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Instead of stirring, swirl the pan so the fish stays whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: ٿلهن ٽڪرن واري سخت گوشت جي مڇي چونڊيو؛ سنها فليٽ ڊگهي پچاءَ ۾ ڀڄي پون ٿا.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose firm-fleshed fish with thick pieces; thin fillets break apart in long cooking.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وچولي تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو. گهٽ تکي پلوسو لاءِ 1½ وڏا چمچا وجهو، يا آنڌرا جي عام تکاڻ لاءِ پورا 2 وڏا چمچا.
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a less hot pulusu add 1½ big spoons, or for the usual Andhra heat a full 2 big spoons.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: مڇي وجهڻ کان اڳ املي جو شوربو چڱيءَ طرح اٻاريو؛ مڇي پوڻ کان پوءِ ان کي گهڻو دير پچائي نٿو سگهجي، نه ته ڀڄي پوندي.
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding the fish; after the fish goes in it cannot be cooked for long, otherwise it will break apart.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر: وڌيڪ تکي پلوسو لاءِ شوربي ۾ سنّم بدران 1 وڏو چمچو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر وجهو. تيجا تمام تکو آهي؛ پڪ نه هجي ته 2 ننڍن چمچن سان شروع ڪريو.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu add 1 big spoon Teja chilli powder in the gravy instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if not sure start with 2 small spoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: رويّالا پلوسو: 400 g صاف ڪيل جهينگا وٺو ۽ رڳو 5–6 منٽ پچايو، جيستائين گلابي ٿي ڪُنڊ ٿي وڃن.
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala Pulusu: take 400 g cleaned prawns and cook only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: ماميڊيڪايا پلوسو: اونهاري ۾ گوداوريءَ جا گهر ڪچي انب جا ٽڪرا وجهن ٿا ۽ املي گهٽ وجهن ٿا.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya Pulusu: in summer Godavari homes add pieces of raw mango and add less tamarind.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: گرم ٻاڦ ۾ پچيل چانورن ۽ ڪتريل بصرن سان پيش ڪريو. گوداوريءَ جا ڪيترا گهر ان کي ٻئي ڏينهن پيش ڪن ٿا، جڏهن ذائقا ٺهي ويهن ٿا.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours settle in.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: بچيل سالڻ فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 2 ڏينهن اندر کائو. پين ۾ هلڪي باهه تي، هلائڻ کان سواءِ ٻيهر گرم ڪريو.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Keep the leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat in a pan on low fire, without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: چيپلا پلوسو لاءِ ڪهڙي مڇي سڀ کان سٺي آهي؟
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: ٿلهن ٽڪرن ۾ ڪٽيل سخت گوشت واري درياهي يا سمنڊ جي مڇي: روهو (بوچا)، مرل (ڪورامينو)، ڪتلا يا سير مڇي. ننڍيون ڪنڊن واريون مڇيون به ٺيڪ آهن پر آهستگيءَ سان سنڀالڻيون پون ٿيون.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: Firm-fleshed river or sea fish cut in thick pieces: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Small bony fish are also fine but have to be handled gently.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: چيپلا پلوسو ٻئي ڏينهن وڌيڪ سٺو ڇو لڳندو آهي؟
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: رکڻ سان مڇيءَ کي املي ۽ مرچ جو شوربو جذب ڪرڻ جو وقت ملي ٿو، ۽ کٽاڻ ۽ تکاڻ برابر ٿي وڃن ٿيون. انهيءَ ڪري ڪيترا گهر ان کي صبح جو رات جي ماني يا ٻئي ڏينهن لاءِ پچائين ٿا.
seg.566bd302c316.back: Keeping gives the fish time to absorb the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat become even. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for the night meal or for the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: سالڻ ۾ مڇيءَ کي ڀڄڻ کان ڪيئن بچائجي؟
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: How to save the fish from breaking in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: ٿلها ٽڪرا وٺو، شوربي اٻرڻ کان پوءِ ئي وجهو، باهه هلڪي رکو ۽ چمچي سان هلائڻ بدران پين کي گهمايو.
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Take thick pieces, add them only after the gravy boils, keep the fire low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.t: 500 g مڇيءَ لاءِ ڪيتري املي گهرجي؟
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind is needed for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: لڳ ڀڳ 40 g، ليمي جيڏو گولو، 2 ڪپ ڪوسي پاڻيءَ ۾ پسايل. ٽماٽو يا ڪچو انب وجهو ته ٿوري گهٽ وجهو.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups lukewarm water. If you add tomato or raw mango add a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: چيپلا پلوسو · آنڌرا مڇيءَ جي سالڻ جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: Chepala Pulusu · Andhra fish curry recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: چيپلا پلوسو. گوداوري طرز جو مڇيءَ جو سالڻ: کٽي املي جي شوربي ۾ بصرن، اسان جي هيڊ ۽ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر سان پچايل مڇي. 4 ماڻهن لاءِ، صلاحن ۽ سوالن جوابن سان.
seg.03c44db05afe.back: Chepala Pulusu. Godavari-style fish curry: fish cooked in sour tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and questions-answers.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: آنڌرا چيپلا پلوسو (آنڌرا املي واري مڇيءَ جو سالڻ) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra tamarind fish curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: آنڌرا چيپلا پلوسو: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6071ab339825.t: ¼ ننڍو چمچو ميٿي جا داڻا

seg.6750578e7aac.t: گنٽور جو مشهور کاڌو · 4 ماڻهن لاءِ
seg.6750578e7aac.back: Famous food of Guntur · for 4 people

seg.a6f8caae0640.t: گونگورا مانسم ⟦1⟧(گونگورا پتن سان ٻڪريءَ جو گوشت)⟦/1⟧
seg.a6f8caae0640.back: Gongura Mamsam ⟦1⟧(goat meat with gongura leaves)⟦/1⟧

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: گونگورا مانسم ٻڪريءَ جو گوشت آهي جيڪو گونگورا سان پچايو ويندو آهي، اهو کٽو پن جنهن کي آنڌرا، ۽ سڀ کان وڌيڪ گنٽور، پنهنجو سمجهي ٿو. گوشت مرچ ۽ هيڊ سان نرم پچايو ويندو آهي، پوءِ گونگورا سان هلڪي باهه تي پچايو ويندو آهي، جيڪا تري گهري ۽ کٽي پيسٽ بڻجي چڪي هوندي آهي، جيستائين سالڻ ٿلهو ٿئي ۽ تيل مٿي اچي.
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura Mamsam is goat meat that is cooked with gongura, that sour leaf which Andhra, and most of all Guntur, considers its own. The meat is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then cooked on low fire with the gongura, which, fried, has already become a deep and sour paste, until the curry becomes thick and oil comes up.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: گونگورا جي تيز کٽاڻ کي سنڀالڻ لاءِ سخت تکاڻ گهرجي، ۽ اها اسان جي تيجا مرچ پائوڊر مان اچي ٿي، گنٽور جي تمام تکي مرچ، ۽ ساڻ اسان جو هيڊ پائوڊر. چانورن سان 4 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To handle the sharp sourness of gongura strong heat is needed, and it comes from our Teja chilli powder, the very hot chilli of Guntur, and along with it our turmeric powder. With rice for 4 people.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: ٻڪريءَ جو گوشت تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ سان پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ پچايو، پوءِ بصر جي مصالحي ۽ تريل گونگورا پتن سان هلڪي باهه تي پچايو جيستائين ٿلهو ٿئي ۽ تيل مٿي تري.
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the goat meat in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then cook on low fire with the onion masala and fried gongura leaves until it becomes thick and oil floats up.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g ٻڪريءَ جو گوشت ⟦1⟧هڏين سميت سالڻ لاءِ ڪٽيل، ڌوئي پاڻي ڪڍيل⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g goat meat ⟦1⟧cut for curry with bones, washed and water drained⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 ڪپ گونگورا پتا ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 2 ڳڀا (150 g)، ڏانڊين تان لاٿل، ڌوئي چڱيءَ طرح پاڻي ڪڍيل⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), taken off the stems, washed and water drained well⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.t: 4 وڏا چمچا تيل ⟦1⟧عام طور مونگ پَليءَ جو تيل⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: گوشت پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ وجهو، تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر، ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ ۽ لوڻ سان، چڱيءَ طرح ملايو ۽ 15 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو.
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the meat in the pressure cooker, with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: گوشت کي تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ، ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ، لوڻ ۽ پاڻيءَ سان پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ پچايو. 1½ ڪپ پاڻي وجهو ۽ وچولي باهه تي 5–6 سيٽيون ڏيو، پوءِ دٻاءُ پاڻمرادو لهڻ ڏيو.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the meat in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups water and on medium fire give 5–6 whistles, then let the pressure drop by itself.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: ڪُڪر کولي هڪ ٽڪرو ڏسو: گوشت تڏهن تيار آهي جڏهن نرم هجي ۽ چمچي سان هڏيءَ کان آسانيءَ سان الڳ ٿئي. نه ته 1–2 سيٽيون ٻيون ڏيو.
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and look at a piece: the meat is ready when it is soft and separates easily from the bone with a spoon. Otherwise give 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: جيستائين گوشت پچي، هڪ پين ۾ وچولي باهه تي 1 وڏو چمچو تيل گرم ڪريو.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the meat cooks, heat 1 big spoon oil in a pan on medium fire.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: گونگورا کي ساون مرچن سان ٿوري تيل ۾ ايستائين تريو جو ڳري گهري پيسٽ بڻجي وڃي. ان ۾ 8–10 منٽ لڳن ٿا؛ گهڻو هلائيندا رهو ۽ پتا مُرجهائجن ته چمچي جي پٺيءَ سان چِٿيو.
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with green chillies in a little oil until it melts into a deep paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; keep stirring a lot and when the leaves wilt mash with the back of a spoon.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: ڳري ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وچولي باهه تي 4 وڏا چمچا تيل گرم ڪريو ۽ لونگ، الائچي ۽ دارچيني وجهو.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: Heat 4 big spoons oil in a heavy kadhai on medium fire and add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: بصرن کي سڄن مصالحن سان سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو. بصرن سان ڪڙي پتا وجهو، ۽ 10–12 منٽ ڏيو، گهڻو هلائيندا رهو.
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onions with the whole spices until golden. Add curry leaves with the onions, and give 10–12 minutes, keeping stirring a lot.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: ڌاڻا پائوڊر ملايو ۽ 30 سيڪنڊ تريو. گوشت ۽ ان جو شوربو وجهو، پوءِ گونگورا.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Mix in coriander powder and fry 30 seconds. Add the meat and its stock, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: ٿلهو ٿيڻ ۽ تيل مٿي ترڻ تائين هلڪي باهه تي پچايو. باهه هلڪي رکو، وچ وچ ۾ هلايو، ۽ 12–15 منٽ ڏيو. گونگورا جي کٽاڻ پوڻ کان پوءِ هاڻي چکو ۽ لوڻ ٺيڪ ڪريو.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Cook on low fire until thick and oil floats up. Keep the fire low, stir now and then, and give 12–15 minutes. After the gongura's sourness goes in, now taste and adjust the salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: گرم مصالحو ملايو. 2 منٽ ٻيا پچايو، پوءِ باهه بند ڪريو ۽ پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ 10 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Mix in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then turn off the fire and leave 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: گونگورا وجهڻ کان پوءِ چکو؛ ان جي کٽاڻ هر ڳڀي ۾ مختلف هوندي آهي.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding the gongura; its sourness is different in every bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر تمام تکو آهي. وچولي تکاڻ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو وجهو، يا سنّم مرچ پائوڊر؛ پر بلڪل نه ڪڍو، نه ته گونگورا ڦڪو ۽ کٽو لڳندو.
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat add 1 small spoon, or Sannam chilli powder; but do not take it out entirely, otherwise the gongura will taste flat and sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: گونگورا لاءِ ايلومينيم جو پين نه وٺو؛ ان جي کٽاڻ ڌاتوءَ سان ملي سالڻ کي ڪارو ڪري ٿي. اسٽيل يا لوهه جو ڳرو برتن وٺو.
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not take an aluminium pan for gongura; its sourness mixes with the metal and makes the curry black. Take a heavy steel or iron vessel.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: جيڪڏهن گونگورا تمام کٽو هجي، ته توازن لاءِ مصالحي ۾ 1 بصر وڌيڪ وجهو.
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is very sour, for balance add 1 more onion to the masala.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: گونگورا ڪڪڙ: 750 g هڏين سميت ڪڪڙ وٺو، پريشر ڪُڪر نه وٺو ۽ گونگورا وجهڻ کان اڳ ان کي مصالحي ۾ ڍڪي 20–25 منٽ پچايو، جيستائين هڏيءَ جي ويجهو ڪو گلابي رنگ نه رهي.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura Kodi: take 750 g chicken with bones, do not take the pressure cooker and before adding gongura cook it covered in the masala 20–25 minutes, until no pink colour remains near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: گونگورا رويّالو: 500 g صاف ڪيل جهينگا وٺو، بصرن کان پوءِ وجهو ۽ 5–6 منٽ پچايو، بس جيستائين گلابي ٿي ڪُنڊ ٿي وڃن، پوءِ گونگورا وجهو.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura Royyalu: take 500 g cleaned prawns, add after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: ڳاڙهي مرچ وارو گونگورا: 6 سُڪل ڳاڙها مرچ گونگورا سان گڏ تريو ۽ گڏ پيهيو، وڌيڪ گهري ۽ تيز سالڻ لاءِ.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Red-chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies together with the gongura and grind together, for a deeper and sharper curry.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: گرم پيش ڪريو ٻاڦ ۾ پچيل چانورن ۽ هڪ چمچي گيهه سان، يا جوننا روٽيءَ سان. پاسي ۾ سادو ڪچو بصر گنٽور جو طريقو آهي.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. Plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: فرج ۾ ڍڪي 3 ڏينهن تائين رکو؛ ٻيهر ايترو گرم ڪريو جو اندر تائين ٻاڦ نڪري. اڪثر کٽن سالڻن وانگر، اهو ٻئي ڏينهن وڌيڪ سٺو لڳي ٿو.
seg.a4e072616940.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 3 days; reheat so hot that steam comes out right to the inside. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.t: گونگورا کي انگريزيءَ ۾ ڇا چئبو آهي؟
seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: گونگورا سورل پن آهن، جن کي روزيل يا ريڊ سورل به چئبو آهي (مراٺيءَ ۾ امباڙي، هنديءَ ۾ پٽوا). پن کٽا هوندا آهن ۽ پچي گهري پيسٽ بڻجي وڃن ٿا.
seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura are sorrel leaves, which are also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, patwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and on cooking become a deep paste.
