seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: ڇا گونگورا پتن بدران گونگورا جو اچار وجهي سگهجي ٿو؟
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can gongura pickle be added instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: ها، مجبوريءَ ۾. تريل پتن بدران 3–4 وڏا چمچا گونگورا جو اچار ملايو ۽ لوڻ ۽ مرچ پائوڊر گهٽ ڪريو، ڇو ته اچار ۾ ٻئي اڳ ۾ ئي هوندا آهن.
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, out of necessity. Instead of fried leaves mix in 3–4 big spoons gongura pickle and reduce the salt and chilli powder, because the pickle already has both.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: گونگورا مانسم لاءِ گوشت کي پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ ڪيترو پچائجي؟
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long to cook the meat in the pressure cooker for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: هڏين سميت سالڻ لاءِ ڪٽيل گوشت لاءِ وچولي باهه تي لڳ ڀڳ 5–6 سيٽيون. گوشت تڏهن تيار آهي جڏهن هڏيءَ کان آسانيءَ سان الڳ ٿئي؛ وڏي ڄمار جي ٻڪريءَ جي گوشت کي 1–2 سيٽيون وڌيڪ گهرجن.
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For meat cut for curry with bones about 5–6 whistles on medium fire. The meat is ready when it separates easily from the bone; older goat meat needs 1–2 more whistles.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: گونگورا مٽن گهٽ تکو ڪيئن ٺاهجي؟
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How to make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر وجهو يا ان جي جاءِ تي سنّم مرچ پائوڊر، ۽ 2 ساوا مرچ وجهو. ڪجهه تکاڻ رکو، ڇو ته اها گونگورا جي کٽاڻ کي برابر ڪري ٿي.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Add 1 small spoon Teja chilli powder or in its place Sannam chilli powder, and add 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, because it balances the sourness of the gongura.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: گونگورا مانسم. گنٽور واري طريقي سان گونگورا مٽن: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ۽ هيڊ پائوڊر سان پچايل گوشت، پوءِ کٽن سورل پتن سان ٿلهو ٿيڻ تائين هلڪي باهه تي پچايل.
seg.df5186f8f459.back: Gongura Mamsam. Gongura mutton the Guntur way: meat cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked on low fire with sour sorrel leaves until thick.

seg.ba26416f3fd1.t: گونگورا مانسم (گونگورا پتن سان ٻڪريءَ جو گوشت) · 1acrefarms
seg.ba26416f3fd1.back: Gongura Mamsam (goat meat with gongura leaves) · 1acrefarms

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: گونگورا مانسم: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.91eb7853c772.t: گونگورا پچّڙي ⟦1⟧(آنڌرا سورل پتن جي چٽڻي)⟦/1⟧

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: گونگورا پچّڙي اها چٽڻي آهي جنهن لاءِ آنڌرا سڀ کان وڌيڪ مشهور آهي: کٽا گونگورا (سورل) پتا تيل ۾ ڳاري، ڀُڳل مصالحن، ٿوم ۽ ڳاڙهي مرچ سان پيٺا ويندا آهن. گنٽور ۽ پلناڊو ڀرسان اها لڳ ڀڳ هر روز دسترخوان تي هوندي آهي، گرم چانورن ۾ هڪ چمچي گيهه سان ملائي، پاسي ۾ ڪتريل بصر سان.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura Pachadi is the chutney for which Andhra is most famous: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves are melted in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the dining spread almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ان کي گهرو ڳاڙهو رنگ ۽ اها تيز تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو جيڪا پتن جي کٽاڻ جو مقابلو ڪري ٿي. هيءَ ترڪيب لڳ ڀڳ 1½ ڪپ ٺاهي ٿي، 6 ماڻهن لاءِ ڪافي.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that sharp heat which stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: ڪل وقت ۾ پيهڻ کان اڳ پتن ۽ مصالحن کي ٿڌو ڪرڻ شامل آهي.
seg.1689d390a49e.back: The total time includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: گونگورا پتا تيل ۾ ايستائين تريو جو گهرا ۽ ڳريل ٿي وڃن، پوءِ ڀُڳل ڌاڻن، ميٿي، ٿوم، تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ سان پيهيو. آخر ۾ رائي ۽ دال جو تڙڪو ڏيو.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry gongura leaves in oil until they become deep and melted, then grind with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. At the end give a tempering of mustard and dal.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 ڪپ گونگورا پتا ⟦1⟧2 وڏن ڳڀن مان لاٿل، لڳ ڀڳ 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧taken from 2 big bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.t: 1 وڏو چمچو ترن جو تيل ⟦1⟧جنجلي تيل، پتن کي ترڻ لاءِ⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 big spoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ ننڍو چمچو ميٿي جا داڻا ⟦1⟧مينٿولو؛ هن کان وڌيڪ نه، نه ته پچّڙي ڪڙي ٿيندي⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ small spoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi will be bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 ننڍا چمچا تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧تمام تکو؛ گهٽ تکي پچّڙيءَ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 small spoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a less hot pachadi 1 small spoon⟦/1⟧

seg.7e344ce94138.t: ¾ ننڍو چمچو لوڻ ⟦1⟧يا ذائقي موجب⟦/1⟧
seg.7e344ce94138.back: ¾ small spoon salt ⟦1⟧or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: گونگورا پتا ڏانڊين تان لاهيو ۽ 2–3 دفعا پاڻي بدلائي ڌوئو. انهن کي ڪپڙي تي پکيڙيو ۽ دٻائي بلڪل سُڪا ڪريو؛ پتن تي رهيل پاڻي تيل ۾ ڇٽڪي ٿو ۽ پچّڙيءَ جي رکڻ جو عرصو گهٽائي ٿو.
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Take the gongura leaves off the stems and wash changing water 2–3 times. Spread them on a cloth and press them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and reduces the keeping time of the pachadi.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: ڌاڻا، زيرو ۽ ميٿي خوشبو اچڻ تائين ڀُڃيو؛ ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو. سُڪو پين هلڪي باهه تي وٺو ۽ لڳاتار هلائيندا رهو: ميٿي هڪ درجو گهري ٿئي، لڳ ڀڳ 2 منٽ، پر ناسي نه.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast coriander, cumin and fenugreek until aroma comes; let cool. Take a dry pan on low fire and keep stirring continuously: the fenugreek should become one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: گونگورا پتن کي 1 وڏي چمچي تيل ۾ ايستائين تريو جو مُرجهائجي گهرا ۽ ڳريل ٿي وڃن، 6–8 منٽ. ويڪرو پين وچولي باهه تي وٺو ۽ گهڻو هلايو؛ پتا جلدي سُسن ٿا، سائي مان ڦڪي زيتوني-ناسي رنگ جا ٿين ٿا، ۽ انهن جو لڳ ڀڳ سمورو پاڻي سُڪي وڃي ٿو.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 big spoon oil until they wilt and become deep and melted, 6–8 minutes. Take a wide pan on medium fire and stir a lot; the leaves quickly shrink, turn from green to a dull olive-brown colour, and almost all their water dries up.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: پتا هڪ ٿالهيءَ ۾ پکيڙيو ۽ پوري طرح ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو، لڳ ڀڳ 10 منٽ.
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool fully, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: مصالحا ٿوم، مرچ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ سان پيهيو، پوءِ پتا وجهي ٿورو ٿورو پيهيو. پهريان ڀُڳل مصالحا، 6 ٿوم جون تريون، تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ ٿلهي پائوڊر ۾ پيهيو.
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and grind little by little. First grind the roasted spices, 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: ٿڌا ٿيل پتا وجهو ۽ پاڻيءَ کان سواءِ 3–4 دفعا ننڍا جهٽڪا ڏئي ٿلهي پيسٽ ٺاهيو. آنڌرا جا ڪيترا گهر ان بدران پٿر جي اُکريءَ (رولو) ۾ ڪُٽيندا آهن.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and without water, giving 3–4 short pulses, make a coarse paste. Many Andhra homes instead pound it in a stone mortar (rolu).

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: چکو: اها کٽي، تکي ۽ چڱي لوڻياٺي هجڻ گهرجي. جيڪڏهن کٽاڻ تمام تيز لڳي ته هڪ چپٽي لوڻ وڌيڪ وجهو.
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and quite salty. If the sourness feels very sharp add one more pinch of salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: باقي تيل ۾ رائي، داليون، ڳاڙها مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتن جو تڙڪو ڏيو؛ ملايو. ننڍي پين ۾ 2 وڏا چمچا ترن جو تيل گرم ڪريو، رائي تڙڪڻ ڏيو، چڻن ۽ ماش جي دال سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو، پوءِ ڳاڙها مرچ، ڪُٽيل ٿوم، ڪڙي پتا ۽ هينگ ڪجهه سيڪنڊن لاءِ وجهو. پچّڙيءَ مٿان وجهو ۽ چڱيءَ طرح ملايو.
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: Give a tempering of mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the remaining oil; mix. Heat 2 big spoons sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard crackle, fry chana and urad dal until golden, then add red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour over the pachadi and mix well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: ٿي سگهي ته پچّڙيءَ کي 30 منٽ رکو، ته ذائقا گڏجي وڃن، پوءِ چمچي سان صاف، سُڪي شيشي جي جار ۾ وجهو.
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible keep the pachadi 30 minutes, so the flavours come together, then with a spoon put it in a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: ترڻ کان اڳ پتا پوري طرح سُڪايو ته پچّڙي وڌيڪ عرصو رهي.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi lasts longer.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر تمام تکو آهي. گهٽ تکي پچّڙيءَ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو وجهو، يا اڌ تيجا ۽ اڌ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر.
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a less hot pachadi add 1 small spoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: ميٿي ¼ ننڍي چمچي تائين رکو ۽ رڳو هڪ درجو گهري ڀُڃيو؛ وڌيڪ يا گهري ڀُڃڻ سان پچّڙي ڪڙي ٿئي ٿي.
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep fenugreek up to ¼ small spoon and roast only one shade darker; more or darker roasting makes the pachadi bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: ننڍا جهٽڪا ڏيو، سنهو نه پيهيو: گونگورا پچّڙي ٿلهي هجڻ گهرجي، پتن جا ٽڪرا نظر اچن.
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Give short pulses, do not grind fine: gongura pachadi should be coarse, pieces of leaves should be visible.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: تيل ۾ ڪنجوسي نه ڪريو؛ مٿان تيل جي تهه پچّڙيءَ کي رکڻ ۾ مدد ڪري ٿي.
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not be stingy with oil; the layer of oil on top helps keep the pachadi.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: بصر سان: پيش ڪرڻ کان ٿورو اڳ هڪ حصي ۾ 1 ننڍو سنهو ڪٽيل بصر ملايو، ۽ ساڳئي ڏينهن کائو.
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: shortly before serving mix 1 small thinly cut onion into one portion, and eat the same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: سڄا ڳاڙها مرچ: مرچ پائوڊر بدران 12–15 سُڪل ڳاڙها مرچ ٿوري تيل ۾ تري مصالحن سان پيهيو.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chillies: instead of chilli powder fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: ساوي مرچ وارو گونگورا: پتن سان 6–8 ساوا مرچ تريو ۽ مرچ پائوڊر 1 ننڍو چمچو ڪريو، وڌيڪ تيز ۽ ساوي تکاڻ لاءِ.
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green-chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and make the chilli powder 1 small spoon, for a sharper and green heat.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: گرم چانورن ۾ گيهه سان هڪ چمچو ملايو ۽ پاسي ۾ ڪتريل ڪچي بصر سان کائو. ڊوسا، اِڊليءَ سان ۽ ڪنهن به آنڌرا ٿالهيءَ سان پاسي طور به سٺي لڳي ٿي.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also tastes good with dosa, idli and as a side with any Andhra thali.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: صاف، سُڪي شيشي جي جار ۾ فرج ۾ 2 هفتن تائين رکو، هميشه سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو. مٿان تيل جي سنهي تهه رکڻ ۾ مدد ڪري ٿي.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks, always use a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps keeping.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.t: گونگورا کي انگريزيءَ ۾ ڇا سڏيو ويندو آهي؟
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: گونگورا روزيل ٻوٽي جو پن آهي، جيڪو اڪثر سورل پتن يا ريڊ سورل جي نالي سان وڪامي ٿو. هندي ۽ مراٺي ڳالهائيندڙ علائقن ۾ ان کي امباڙي چيو ويندو آهي.
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, which is often sold by the name sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi and Marathi speaking regions it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: گونگورا پچّڙي گهٽ کٽي ڪيئن ڪجي؟
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How to make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: ٿورو وڌيڪ لوڻ ۽ مرچ وجهو، يا 1 ننڍو چمچو ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ ملايو. پتن کي چڱيءَ طرح ڳاري ترڻ سان به انهن جي کٽاڻ نرم ٿئي ٿي.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or mix in 1 small spoon grated jaggery. Melting and frying the leaves well also softens their sourness.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.t: منهنجي گونگورا پچّڙي ڪڙي ڇو آهي؟
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: عام طور گهڻي ميٿي، يا تمام گهري ڀُڳل ميٿي. ان کي ¼ ننڍي چمچي تائين رکو ۽ جڏهن هڪ درجو گهري ٿئي ته ڀُڃڻ بند ڪريو.
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted very dark. Keep it up to ¼ small spoon and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.t: گونگورا پچّڙي ڪيترو عرصو رهي ٿي؟
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How long does gongura pachadi last?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: فرج ۾ سُڪي شيشي جي جار ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 2 هفتا، جيڪڏهن پتا چڱيءَ طرح سُڪايل هجن ۽ توهان هميشه سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو. فرج کان ٻاهر، 2–3 ڏينهن اندر کائو.
seg.693b158b80df.back: In the fridge in a dry glass jar about 2 weeks, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat within 2–3 days.

seg.2202d49bd92b.t: گونگورا پچّڙي · گونگورا پچّڙيءَ جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: گونگورا پچّڙي. گنٽور واري طريقي سان گونگورا پچّڙي: ڳاري تريل سورل پتا، ڀُڳل مصالحن، ٿوم ۽ تيجا مرچ پائوڊر سان پيٺل، پوءِ تڙڪو ڏنل. 6 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: Gongura Pachadi. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: melted fried sorrel leaves, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.0f19ba49c232.t: گونگورا پچّڙي (آنڌرا سورل پتن جي چٽڻي) · 1acrefarms

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: گونگورا پچّڙي: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.d8fb97ac630c.t: هفتي جي عام ڏينهن جو سالڻ · 4 ماڻهن لاءِ

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: ڪوڊي گڊو پلوسو ⟦1⟧(املي جي شوربي ۾ آنڌرا آنن جو سالڻ)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.da3ef9f002aa.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · ڪوڊي گڊو پلوسو · آنن جو سالڻ

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: ڪوڊي گڊو پلوسو آنڌرا جو آنن وارو سالڻ آهي جيڪو ڪيترا گهر تڏهن ٺاهيندا آهن جڏهن گهر ۾ گوشت نه هجي: سخت اٻاريل آنا املي ۽ آهستي تريل بصرن جي کٽي شوربي ۾ هلڪي باهه تي پچايا ويندا آهن. اهو اتر هندستان جي آنن جي سالڻ کان پتلو ۽ وڌيڪ کٽو هوندو آهي، ۽ گهڻن گرم چانورن ۾ ملائي کائڻ لاءِ ٺهندو آهي.
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu is Andhra's egg curry which many homes make when there is no meat at home: hard-boiled eggs are cooked on low fire in a sour gravy of tamarind and slowly fried onions. It is thinner and more sour than North India's egg curry, and is made for mixing into lots of hot rice and eating.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: اسان جو سنّم مرچ پائوڊر پلوسو کي ڳاڙهو رنگ ۽ هڪجيتري وچولي تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو، ۽ اسان جو هيڊ پائوڊر (پسوپو) سونهري بنياد ڏئي ٿو. ٿورو ڳڙ کٽاڻ کي نرم ڪري ٿو.
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and an even medium heat, and our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden base. A little jaggery softens the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: آنا اٻاريو ۽ چيرا ڏيو. بصر تريو، هيڊ، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ۽ املي جو پاڻي وجهو، هلڪي باهه تي پچايو، پوءِ آنن کي شوربي ۾ ٿلهو ٿيڻ تائين پچايو.
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and give slits. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, cook on low fire, then cook the eggs in the gravy until it becomes thick.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.t: هڪ چپٽي هيڊ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧آنا ترڻ لاءِ (مرضي)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g املي ⟦1⟧ليمي جيڏو گولو، 1½ ڪپ ڪوسي پاڻيءَ ۾ پسايل⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 وڏا چمچا تيل ⟦1⟧مونگ پَليءَ يا ترن جو تيل⟦/1⟧
seg.d56c07ca17af.back: 3 big spoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut or sesame oil⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 ننڍا چمچا سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧وچولي تکاڻ؛ گهٽ تکي لاءِ 1½ ننڍا چمچا⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 small spoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for less hot 1½ small spoons⟦/1⟧

seg.49259e7b204d.back: 1 small spoon salt ⟦1⟧or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: املي کي ڪوسي پاڻيءَ ۾ 15 منٽ پسايو. چڱيءَ طرح نچوڙيو، ڇاڻيو ۽ املي جو پاڻي رکو؛ ريشا ۽ ٻج اڇلائي ڇڏيو.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in lukewarm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away the fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: آنا 10 منٽ اٻاريو، ڇليو ۽ هر هڪ تي 3–4 هلڪا چيرا ڏيو. انهن کي ڪمري جي گرميءَ واري پاڻيءَ ۾ رکي شروع ڪريو، اٻرڻ کان 10 منٽ ڳڻيو، پوءِ ڇلڻ کان اڳ پاڻيءَ ۾ ٿڌا ڪريو. زردي اندر تائين سخت ۽ هلڪي پيلي هجڻ گهرجي.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and give 3–4 light slits on each. Start by putting them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool in water before peeling. The yolk should be hard right to the inside and light yellow.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: مرضي: 1 ننڍو چمچو تيل هيڊ جي چپٽيءَ سان گرم ڪريو ۽ آنن کي ان ۾ 2 منٽ ڦيرايو جيستائين هلڪا ڦوٽا پون. پاسي تي رکو.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: Optional: heat 1 small spoon oil with the pinch of turmeric and turn the eggs in it for 2 minutes until light blisters appear. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: باقي تيل ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وچولي باهه تي گرم ڪريو. ميٿي وجهو ۽ هلڪي ناسي ٿيڻ ڏيو؛ گهري ٿئي ته ڪڙي ٿي وڃي ٿي.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil in a kadhai on medium fire. Add fenugreek and let it become light brown; if it becomes dark it turns bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: رائي، ڪڙي پتا ۽ بصر تيل ۾ نرم ۽ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو. پهريان رائي وجهو ۽ تڙڪڻ ڏيو، پوءِ ڪڙي پتا، ساوا مرچ ۽ هينگ، پوءِ بصر لڳ ڀڳ 8 منٽن لاءِ.
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard, curry leaves and onions in the oil until soft and golden. First add mustard and let it crackle, then curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then onions for about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: باهه هلڪي ڪريو. هيڊ، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ وجهو، پوءِ املي جو پاڻي؛ 10 منٽ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو. ڌاڻا پائوڊر مرچ پائوڊر سان گڏ ملايو ته پهريان ڪجهه سيڪنڊ تري.
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Lower the fire. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; cook 10 minutes on low fire. Mix coriander powder together with the chilli powder so it fries first for a few seconds.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: املي جي ڪچي بوءِ ختم ٿي وڃي ۽ شوربو چمڪدار لڳي. جيڪڏهن جلدي ٿلهو ٿئي ته ½ ڪپ پاڻي وجهو.
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of the tamarind should go away and the gravy look glossy. If it thickens quickly add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: آنا آهستي وجهو ۽ 5 منٽ ٻيا هلڪي باهه تي پچايو جيستائين شوربو ٿلهو ٿئي. وچ وچ ۾ چمچي سان شوربو آنن مٿان وجهو.
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Add the eggs gently and cook 5 more minutes on low fire until the gravy becomes thick. Now and then spoon gravy over the eggs.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: ڳڙ ملايو، چکو ۽ لوڻ يا کٽاڻ ٺيڪ ڪريو، ۽ ساوا ڌاڻا ڇڻڪيو.
seg.299781c49104.back: Mix in jaggery, taste and adjust salt or sourness, and sprinkle green coriander.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: باهه بند ڪريو ۽ پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ پلوسو کي 10 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو ته آنا شوربو جذب ڪن.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Turn off the fire and before serving leave the pulusu 10 minutes so the eggs absorb the gravy.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.t: چيرن مان کٽو شوربو آنن اندر وڃي ٿو.
seg.feebbb94999b.back: Through the slits the sour gravy goes inside the eggs.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: اٻاريل آنن کي ڇلڻ کان اڳ پاڻيءَ ۾ ٿڌو ڪريو؛ کل صاف لهي ٿي.
seg.98394356bb39.back: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shell comes off cleanly.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وچولي تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو؛ وڌيڪ تکي پلوسو لاءِ ان سان گڏ ½ ننڍو چمچو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر وجهو.
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ small spoon Teja chilli powder along with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: پلوسو رکڻ کان پوءِ وڌيڪ سٺو لڳي ٿو، ۽ ٻئي ڏينهن اڃا به وڌيڪ، ڇو ته آنا املي جذب ڪن ٿا.
seg.fc1643db807e.back: Pulusu tastes better after keeping, and even more the next day, because the eggs absorb the tamarind.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: ٽماٽو: بصرن کان پوءِ 1 ڪٽيل ٽماٽو وجهو، نرم ۽ گهٽ کٽي شوربي لاءِ.
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: after the onions add 1 cut tomato, for a softer and less sour gravy.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: تر: آخري 5 منٽن ۾ 1 وڏو چمچو ڀُڳل ترن جو پائوڊر ملايو، ٿلهي ۽ ميوي جهڙي شوربي لاءِ.
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: in the last 5 minutes mix in 1 big spoon roasted sesame powder, for a thicker and nutty gravy.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: ماميڊيڪايا: اونهاري ۾ اڌ املي بدران ڪچي انب جا ڪجهه ٽڪرا شوربي ۾ پچايو.
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer, instead of half the tamarind, cook a few pieces of raw mango in the gravy.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: گرم پيش ڪريو ٻاڦ ۾ پچيل چانورن ۽ هڪ چمچي گيهه سان، پاسي ۾ ڪُرڪُري ڀاڄي يا اپّڊالو سان. چپاتي يا ڊوسا سان به سٺو لڳي ٿو.
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp vegetable or appadalu on the side. It also goes well with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: بچيل سالڻ فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 2 ڏينهن اندر کائو. پلوسو کي پين ۾ ٿورو پاڻي وجهي هلڪي باهه تي گرم ڪريو.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Keep leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan with a little water on low fire.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: آنن جي سالڻ لاءِ آنا ڪيترو اٻارجن؟
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long to boil eggs for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: پاڻي اٻرڻ کان لڳ ڀڳ 10 منٽ. آنا شوربي ۾ وجهڻ کان اڳ زردي اندر تائين سخت ۽ هلڪي پيلي هجي، وچ ۾ پاڻياٺي نه.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from the water boiling. Before adding the eggs to the gravy the yolk should be hard right to the inside and light yellow, not watery in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.t: پلوسو لاءِ آنن تي چيرا ڇو ڏبا آهن؟
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why are slits given on eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: هلڪن چيرن مان املي جو شوربو آني جي اڇي حصي ۾ جذب ٿئي ٿو. انهن کان سواءِ شوربو مٿاڇري تي رهي ٿو ۽ آنو ڦڪو لڳي ٿو.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: Through light slits the tamarind gravy is absorbed into the white part of the egg. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes flat.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How to reduce the sourness of the pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: ڪجهه منٽ وڌيڪ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو، هڪ ننڍو چمچو ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڳڙ وجهو، يا ٿورو پاڻي ملايو. ٻئي دفعي املي جو ننڍو گولو وٺو.
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Cook a few minutes more on low fire, add a small spoon of grated jaggery, or mix in a little water. Next time take a smaller ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: آنن جي پلوسو ۽ آنن جي سالڻ ۾ ڪهڙو فرق آهي؟
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: پلوسو پتلو، کٽو املي وارو شوربو آهي جيڪو چانورن سان ملائڻ لاءِ ٺهي ٿو. عام آنن جو سالڻ اڪثر بصر ۽ ٽماٽي تي ٺهي ٿو، املي کان سواءِ ۽ ٿلهي مصالحي سان.
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, sour tamarind gravy that is made for mixing with rice. Ordinary egg curry is often made on onion and tomato, without tamarind and with thick masala.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: ڪوڊي گڊو پلوسو · آنن جي پلوسو جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu · egg pulusu recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: ڪوڊي گڊو پلوسو. ڪوڊي گڊو پلوسو، آنڌرا جو آنن وارو سالڻ: اٻاريل آنا کٽي املي-بصر جي شوربي ۾ هلڪي باهه تي پچايل، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ۽ هيڊ سان رنگيل. 4 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu. Kodi Guddu Pulusu, Andhra's egg curry: boiled eggs cooked on low fire in sour tamarind-onion gravy, coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.t: ڪوڊي گڊو پلوسو (املي جي شوربي ۾ آنڌرا آنن جو سالڻ) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.583485fac40c.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.583485fac40c.t: ڪوڊي گڊو پلوسو: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.583485fac40c.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.t: گتّي ونڪايا ڪورا ⟦1⟧(آنڌرا ڀريل وانگڻن جو سالڻ)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra stuffed brinjal curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: گتّي ونڪايا ڪورا ڀريل وانگڻن جو اهو سالڻ آهي جيڪو آنڌرا جا گهر آچر جي منجهند، شادين ۽ مهمانن اچڻ تي ٺاهيندا آهن. ننڍا، گول جامني وانگڻ چيري، ڀُڳل مونگ پَلي، ترن ۽ ناريل جي مصالحي سان ڀريا ويندا آهن، ۽ تيل ۾ آهستي ايستائين پچايا ويندا آهن جو نرم ٿي وڃن ۽ مصالحو انهن سان چنبڙي وڃي.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura is that curry of stuffed brinjals which Andhra homes make on Sunday afternoon, at weddings and when guests come. Small, round purple brinjals are slit and filled with a masala of roasted groundnut, sesame and coconut, and are cooked slowly in oil until they become soft and the masala sticks to them.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: اسان جو سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ڀرت کي ڳاڙهو رنگ ۽ وچولي تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو، ۽ هيڊ پائوڊر ان کي پورو ڪري ٿو. گرم چانورن يا چپاتيءَ سان پيش ڪريو. هيءَ ترڪيب 4 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder completes it. Serve with hot rice or chapati. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: مونگ پَلي، تر، سُڪو ناريل ۽ ڌاڻا ڀُڃيو، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ سان پيهيو، ننڍا وانگڻ ڀريو ۽ تيل ۾ نرم ٿيڻ تائين آهستي پچايو.
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast groundnut, sesame, dry coconut and coriander, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff the small brinjals and cook slowly in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 وڏا چمچا مونگ پَلي ⟦1⟧ڪچي، کل سان يا کل کان سواءِ⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 big spoons groundnut ⟦1⟧raw, with skin or without skin⟦/1⟧

seg.8be0f88d515d.t: 3 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل سُڪو ناريل ⟦1⟧ڪوپرا⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 ننڍا چمچا سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧وڌيڪ تکي سالڻ لاءِ 1 وڏي چمچي تائين⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 small spoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧for a hotter curry up to 1 big spoon⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.t: 12 ننڍا وانگڻ ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 500 g، ننڍا گول جامني⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple⟦/1⟧

seg.014a7ac99345.t: 4 وڏا چمچا تيل ⟦1⟧مونگ پَليءَ جو تيل⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.t: 2 وڏا چمچا ساوا ڌاڻا ⟦1⟧ڪٽيل، آخر ۾ وجهڻ لاءِ⟦/1⟧
seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 big spoons green coriander ⟦1⟧cut, for adding at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: مونگ پَلي، تر، ناريل ۽ ڌاڻا سُڪا ڀُڃيو؛ مصالحن سان پيهيو. پهريان مونگ پَلي وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي 3–4 منٽ ڀُڃيو، پوءِ ڌاڻا، زيرو ۽ تر 1 منٽ لاءِ وجهو، ۽ آخري 30 سيڪنڊن ۾ ناريل، جيستائين هلڪو سونهري ٿئي. ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو.
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Dry-roast groundnut, sesame, coconut and coriander; grind with the spices. First roast the groundnut on medium-low fire 3–4 minutes, then add coriander, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and in the last 30 seconds the coconut, until light golden. Let cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: مڪسر ۾ ڀُڳل مصالحو ٿوم، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر، لوڻ ۽ املي سان پاڻيءَ کان سواءِ ٿلهي پائوڊر ۾ پيهيو. دٻائڻ سان اهو ڳنڍ ٿيڻ گهرجي.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In a mixer grind the roasted masala with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind without water to a coarse powder. On pressing it should form a lump.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: وانگڻ ڌوئو ۽ سائي ٽوپي ٿوري ڪتريو، ڏانڊي رهڻ ڏيو.
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, let the stem remain.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: هر وانگڻ کي هيٺان کان صليب جي شڪل ۾ چيرو، ڏانڊي رهڻ ڏيو، ۽ ڀرت ڀريو. لڳ ڀڳ ٽي چوٿائي مٿي تائين ڪٽيو ته چارئي حصا مٿان جُڙيل رهن. هر هڪ کي ڪٽيندي ئي لوڻ واري پاڻيءَ جي پيالي ۾ وجهو، پوءِ پاڻي ڪڍي ڇڏيو.
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Slit each brinjal from below in the shape of a cross, let the stem remain, and fill the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters up so that the four parts stay joined at the top. Put each one as soon as it is cut into a bowl of salt water, then drain the water.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: هر وانگڻ ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 1 ڀريل ننڍو چمچو ڀرت دٻائي ڀريو. بچيل ڀرت پاسي تي رکو.
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press about 1 heaped small spoon of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: ويڪري، ڳري پين ۾ وچولي باهه تي تيل گرم ڪريو. رائي وجهو ۽ جڏهن تڙڪي، ته ڪڙي پتا ۽ بصر، جيڪڏهن وجهو ٿا. بصر نرم ٿيڻ تائين تريو، لڳ ڀڳ 3 منٽ.
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: Heat oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium fire. Add mustard and when it crackles, curry leaves and onion, if you are adding it. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: ڀريل وانگڻ پين ۾ هڪ تهه ۾ رکو.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Place the stuffed brinjals in the pan in one layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: وانگڻن کي گرم تيل ۾ ڍڪي هلڪي باهه تي پچايو، هر 4–5 منٽن بعد آهستي ڦيرايو. چمچو يا چمٽو استعمال ڪريو ته ڀرت اندر رهي، ۽ 15–18 منٽ پچايو، جيستائين کل تي گهنج پون.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals in the hot oil covered on low fire, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays inside, and cook 15–18 minutes, until wrinkles appear on the skin.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: بچيل ڀرت ½ ڪپ پاڻيءَ سان وجهو؛ وانگڻ نرم ٿيڻ تائين هلڪي باهه تي پچايو. ڍڪي هلڪي باهه تي 8–10 منٽ ٻيا پچايو، جيستائين مصالحو ٿلهو ٿئي ۽ پاسن تي تيل نظر اچي.
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; cook on low fire until the brinjals are soft. Cook covered on low fire 8–10 more minutes, until the masala becomes thick and oil appears at the sides.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: پچڻ جي جانچ ڪريو: سڀ کان ٿلهي وانگڻ مان ڇري بنا رڪاوٽ جي لنگهي وڃي. ساوا ڌاڻا ڇڻڪيو ۽ باهه بند ڪريو.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check doneness: a knife passes without obstruction through the thickest brinjal. Sprinkle green coriander and turn off the fire.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: ڏانڊيون رهڻ ڏيو ته وانگڻ پچڻ ۽ ڦيرائڻ وقت جُڙيل رهن.
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Let the stems remain so the brinjals stay joined while cooking and turning.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: هڪ جيڏا ننڍا، چمڪدار وانگڻ چونڊيو، ته هڪجيترا پچن؛ وڏا وچ ۾ سخت رهجي وڃن ٿا.
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose same-sized small, shiny brinjals, so they cook evenly; big ones stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: مونگ پَلي ۽ تر وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي ڀُڃيو؛ سڙيل تر سڄي مصالحي کي ڪڙو ڪري ٿو.
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast groundnut and sesame on medium-low fire; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: گهٽ تکي سالڻ لاءِ 1½ ننڍا چمچا سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وجهو؛ وڌيڪ تکاڻ لاءِ 1 وڏي چمچي تائين.
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a less hot curry add 1½ small spoons Sannam chilli powder; for more heat up to 1 big spoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: بصر جي مصالحي سان: نرم ۽ ٿوري مٺي شوربي لاءِ 1 ننڍو بصر ڀرت ۾ پيهيو.
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a softer and slightly sweet gravy grind 1 small onion into the stuffing.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: ناريل کان سواءِ: ناريل نه وجهو ۽ مونگ پَلي ۽ تر 1 وڏو چمچو وڌيڪ وجهو.
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: do not add coconut and add 1 big spoon more of groundnut and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: شوربي وارو طريقو: چانورن ۾ ملائڻ لاءِ پتلي سالڻ لاءِ آخري قدم ۾ ½ ڪپ بدران 1 ڪپ پاڻي وجهو.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: Gravy way: for a thinner curry for mixing into rice add 1 cup water instead of ½ cup in the last step.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: گرم پيش ڪريو ٻاڦ ۾ پچيل چانورن ۽ هڪ چمچي گيهه سان، يا چپاتي يا جوننا روٽيءَ سان.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 2 ڏينهن اندر کائو. ٿورو پاڻي وجهي هلڪي باهه تي گرم ڪريو.
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat on low fire adding a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: گتّي ونڪايا لاءِ ڪهڙا وانگڻ سڀ کان سٺا آهن؟
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: آني جيڏا ننڍا، گول جامني وانگڻ، چمڪدار کل ۽ سائي ڏانڊيءَ وارا. اهي ايتري وقت ۾ پچي وڃن ٿا جيترو مصالحو وٺي ٿو ۽ ڀرت چڱيءَ طرح سنڀالين ٿا.
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Egg-sized small, round purple brinjals, with shiny skin and green stem. They get cooked in as much time as the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.t: ڪيئن خبر پوي ته وانگڻ پچي ويا آهن؟
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How to know that the brinjals are cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: کل تي گهنج پون ٿا ۽ نرم ٿئي ٿي، ۽ سڀ کان ٿلهي وانگڻ مان ڇري بنا رڪاوٽ جي لنگهي ٿي. اڌ پچيل وانگڻ وچ ۾ سخت ۽ اسپنج جهڙا لڳن ٿا.
seg.c65656faa952.back: Wrinkles appear on the skin and it becomes soft, and a knife passes without obstruction through the thickest brinjal. Half-cooked brinjals feel hard and sponge-like in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: ڇا ناريل کان سواءِ گتّي ونڪايا ٺاهي سگهجي ٿي؟
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can gutti vankaya be made without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: ها. ناريل بدران 1 وڏو چمچو وڌيڪ مونگ پَلي ۽ 1 وڏو چمچو وڌيڪ تر وجهو؛ مصالحو وڌيڪ ميوي جهڙو لڳندو.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of coconut add 1 big spoon more groundnut and 1 big spoon more sesame; the masala will taste more nutty.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.t: منهنجا وانگڻ ٽٽي ڇو پون ٿا؟
seg.534e126ba995.back: Why do my brinjals break apart?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: ڏانڊي لاٿي وئي هئي يا صليب جو چيرو آخر تائين ڪٽيو ويو هو. ڏانڊي رهڻ ڏيو، چيرو مٿي کان چوٿائي اڳ بند ڪريو ۽ آهستي ڦيرايو.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stem was taken off or the cross slit was cut all the way to the end. Let the stem remain, stop the slit a quarter before the top and turn gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: گتّي ونڪايا ڪورا · گتّي ونڪايا ڪورا جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura · Gutti Vankaya Kura recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: گتّي ونڪايا ڪورا. ڀُڳل مونگ پَلي، ترن ۽ ناريل سان ڀريل ننڍا وانگڻ، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ۽ هيڊ پائوڊر سان پيٺل، پوءِ تيل ۾ آهستي پچايل.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted groundnut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked slowly in oil.

seg.e6d2d516a538.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.t: گتّي ونڪايا ڪورا (آنڌرا ڀريل وانگڻن جو سالڻ) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra stuffed brinjal curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.edfa611d692c.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.edfa611d692c.t: گتّي ونڪايا ڪورا: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.edfa611d692c.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6338aa32f352.t: 3 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل سُڪو ناريل

seg.5fd655ec9c39.t: چانهه وقت جو هلڪو ناشتو · 4 ماڻهن لاءِ

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: جيڊي پپّو پڪوڙي اهي ڪاجو پڪوڙا آهن جيڪي آنڌرا جا مٺائيءَ جا دڪان ۽ گهر چانهه جي وقت، ڏڻن ۽ مهمانن لاءِ تريندا آهن: سڄا ڪاجو ٻيسڻ ۽ چانورن جي اٽي جي سنهي، مصالحيدار تهه ۾، ڪُرڪُرا ٿيڻ تائين تريل. بصر کان سواءِ ٺهڻ ڪري اهي جار ۾ ڪيترا ڏينهن رهن ٿا، تنهنڪري ڪيترا گهر ديوالي ۽ سنڪرانتيءَ جي مهمانن لاءِ هڪ کيپ تريندا آهن.
seg.111c74722b7d.back: JD Pappu Pakodi are those cashew pakoras which Andhra sweet shops and homes fry at tea time, for festivals and for guests: whole cashews fried in a thin, spiced coating of gram flour and rice flour until crisp. Because they are made without onion they last many days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti guests.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: اسان جي جيڊي پپّو پيڪ جا سڄا ڪاجو تهه اندر ڪُرڪُرا رهن ٿا، ۽ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وچولي تکاڻ ۽ گرم ڳاڙهو رنگ ڏئي ٿو. هيءَ ترڪيب 4 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews of our JD Pappu pack stay crisp inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: ڪل وقت ۾ پڪوڙين جي ٿڌي ۽ ڪُرڪُري ٿيڻ جا 5 منٽ شامل آهن.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: The total time includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and become crisp.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: سڄن ڪاجو کي ٻيسڻ، چانورن جي اٽي، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر، لوڻ ۽ هڪ چمچي گرم تيل سان ملايو، بس ايترو پاڻي ڇڻڪيو جو تهه چڙهي، ۽ سونهري ۽ ڪُرڪُرا ٿيڻ تائين گهڻي تيل ۾ تريو.
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Mix whole cashews with gram flour, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle just enough water for the coating to stick, and fry in deep oil until golden and crisp.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 ڪپ سڄا ڪاجو ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 150 g؛ تمام وڏا هجن ته اڌ ڪريو⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; if very big halve them⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ ڪپ ٻيسڻ ⟦1⟧چڻن جو اٽو، لڳ ڀڳ 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup gram flour ⟦1⟧chickpea flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 وڏا چمچا چانورن جو اٽو ⟦1⟧وڌيڪ ڪُرڪُري تهه لاءِ⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 big spoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧وچولي تکاڻ؛ وڌيڪ تکي پڪوڙيءَ لاءِ ½ ننڍو چمچو ٻيو⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 small spoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for a hotter pakodi ½ small spoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.40a2a51a64aa.t: ½ ننڍو چمچو لوڻ ⟦1⟧يا ذائقي موجب⟦/1⟧
seg.40a2a51a64aa.back: ½ small spoon salt ⟦1⟧or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 وڏو چمچو گرم تيل ⟦1⟧ترڻ واري تيل مان ورتل⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 big spoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧
seg.a24adfc46507.t: 2–3 وڏا چمچا پاڻي ⟦1⟧ٿورو ٿورو ڪري ڇڻڪيل⟦/1⟧
seg.a24adfc46507.back: 2–3 big spoons water ⟦1⟧sprinkled little by little⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.t: گهڻي تيل ۾ ترڻ لاءِ تيل ⟦1⟧عام طور مونگ پَليءَ جو تيل⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.back: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: ڪاجو ڌوئو ۽ چڱيءَ طرح پاڻي ڪڍو؛ ٿورو آلو مٿاڇرو اٽي کي چنبڙڻ ۾ مدد ڪري ٿو.
seg.8423a6481648.back: Wash the cashews and drain the water well; a slightly wet surface helps the flour stick.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وچولي باهه تي ترڻ لاءِ تيل گرم ڪريو.
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat oil for frying in a kadhai on medium fire.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: ٻيسڻ، چانورن جو اٽو، مرچ پائوڊر، لوڻ، ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ ۽ ڪڙي پتا ملايو. ويڪرو پيالو وٺو، ۽ ساڳئي وقت ساوا مرچ، ساوا ڌاڻا ۽ هينگ وجهو.
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix gram flour, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Take a wide bowl, and at the same time add green chillies, green coriander and asafoetida.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 وڏو چمچو گرم تيل مکيو، ڪاجو وجهو ۽ ايترو پاڻي ڇڻڪيو جو اٽو بس انهن تي چڙهي وڃي. ڪڙهائيءَ مان گرم تيل احتياط سان چمچي ۾ کڻو ۽ پهريان آڱرين جي چوٽين سان اٽي ۾ مکيو، پوءِ ڪاجو وجهو ۽ 1 وڏو چمچو ڪري پاڻي ڇڻڪيو، اُڇاليندا رهو، جيستائين اٽو هر ڪاجوءَ سان چنبڙي وڃي. مصالحو آلن ڀورن جهڙو لڳي، گهول جهڙو نه.
seg.346911fb291b.back: Rub in 1 big spoon hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle just enough water that the flour just coats them. Carefully take hot oil from the kadhai in a spoon and first rub it into the flour with the fingertips, then add the cashews and sprinkle water 1 big spoon at a time, tossing, until the flour sticks to every cashew. The masala should look like wet crumbs, not like batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: تيل ڏسو: مصالحي جي هڪ چپٽي وجهڻ تي 2–3 سيڪنڊن ۾ هڪجيترن ٻُڙٻُڙن سان مٿي اچي. جيڪڏهن هڪدم ناسي ٿي وڃي، ته تيل گهڻو گرم آهي.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Check the oil: on adding a pinch of the masala it should come up in 2–3 seconds with even bubbles. If it turns brown at once, the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: ننڍا ننڍا گُڇا وچولي گرم تيل ۾ وجهو. هڪ ڀيري 3–4 اٽي چڙهيل ڪاجو آڱرين سان کڻو ۽ ڍلا ڪري تيل ۾ ڇڏيو، ڪڙهائي ڀريو نه.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Drop small small clusters into medium-hot oil. At a time pick up 3–4 flour-coated cashews with the fingers and drop them loosely into the oil, do not crowd the kadhai.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: ڦيرائيندي سونهري ۽ ڪُرڪُرا ٿيڻ تائين تريو، 5–6 منٽ؛ ڪاغذ تي تيل نچوڙيو. تيار ٿيڻ تي پڪوڙين جي چوڌاري ٻُڙٻُڙا ننڍا ۽ آهستي ٿي وڃن ٿا.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Fry turning until golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain the oil on paper. When ready the bubbles around the pakodi become small and slow.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: باقي به ساڳيءَ طرح کيپن ۾ تريو، هر کيپ کان پوءِ تيل کي ٻيهر گرم ٿيڻ ڏيو.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the rest the same way in batches, letting the oil heat again after each batch.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: پڪوڙين کي ڪاغذ تي 5 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو؛ ٿڌيون ٿيڻ سان وڌيڪ ڪُرڪُريون ٿين ٿيون. وڻي ته مٿان هڪ چپٽي لوڻ يا مرچ پائوڊر ڇڻڪيو.
seg.8ab193492427.back: Leave the pakodi on paper 5 minutes; on cooling they become crisper. If you like sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: گهول ٿلهو ۽ سُڪو رکو، پتلو نه، نه ته پڪوڙي نرم ٿي ويندي.
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the batter thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi will become soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: وچولي باهه تي تريو: ڪاجو جلدي ناسي ٿين ٿا، ۽ تيز باهه تي اندر ڪاجو سيڪجڻ کان اڳ ئي تهه جو رنگ بدلجي وڃي ٿو.
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium fire: cashews brown quickly, and on high fire the coating changes colour even before the cashew inside gets roasted.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: اٽي ۾ مکيل گرم تيل جو چمچو پڪوڙيءَ کي هلڪي ۽ ڪُرڪُري ڪري ٿو.
seg.76602f605fc8.back: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وچولي تکاڻ ۽ سٺو ڳاڙهو رنگ ڏئي ٿو؛ ٻارن لاءِ ½ ننڍو چمچو وجهو.
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a nice red colour; for children add ½ small spoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: وڌيڪ تکي: اڌ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر بدران تيجا مرچ پائوڊر وجهو، جيڪو گهڻو تکو آهي.
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: instead of half the Sannam chilli powder add Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: بصر سان: نرم ۽ مٺي پڪوڙيءَ لاءِ ڪاجو سان 1 ننڍو سنهو ڪتريل بصر وجهو، ۽ ساڳئي ڏينهن کائو.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for a softer and sweet pakodi add 1 small thinly sliced onion with the cashews, and eat the same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: پودينو: ساون ڌاڻن سان گڏ 2 وڏا چمچا ڪٽيل پودينو وجهو.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: add 2 big spoons cut mint together with the green coriander.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: شام جي چانهه يا فلٽر ڪافيءَ سان ڪوسيون پيش ڪريو. لنچ باڪس ۾ يا چانورن ۽ پپّو جي ماني سان پاسي ۾ به سٺيون لڳن ٿيون.
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve lukewarm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go well in a lunch box or on the side with a rice and pappu meal.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: پوري طرح ٿڌيون ٿيڻ کان پوءِ هوا بند جار ۾ ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي رکو ۽ 4–5 ڏينهن اندر کائو. جيڪڏهن نرم ٿي وڃن، ته سُڪي پين ۾ هلڪي باهه تي 2–3 منٽ گرم ڪريو.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After cooling fully keep in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they become soft, heat in a dry pan on low fire for 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: منهنجي ڪاجو پڪوڙي نرم ڇو ٿي وئي؟
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi become soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: اٽي ۾ گهڻو پاڻي، يا هلڪي باهه تي ترڻ. مصالحو آلن ڀورن جهڙو رکو ۽ وچولي باهه تي تريو جيستائين ٻُڙٻُڙا آهستي ٿين.
seg.346050614d3a.back: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low fire. Keep the masala like wet crumbs and fry on medium fire until the bubbles become slow.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.t: ڇا پڪوڙي ٺاهڻ کان اڳ ڪاجو پسائجن؟
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Should cashews be soaked before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: پسائڻ جي ضرورت ناهي. اٽو چنبڙڻ لاءِ جلدي ڌوئڻ ڪافي آهي؛ گهڻي دير پسايل ڪاجو پنهنجي ڪُرڪُرائپ وڃائي ويهن ٿا.
seg.e6e487728264.back: No need to soak. A quick wash is enough for the flour to stick; cashews soaked too long lose their crispness.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: ڇا چانورن جي اٽي کان سواءِ ڪاجو پڪوڙي ٺاهي سگهجي ٿي؟
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can cashew pakodi be made without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: ها. 2 وڏا چمچا وڌيڪ ٻيسڻ، يا 1 وڏو چمچو ڪارن فلور وجهو. چانورن جو اٽو سڀ کان ڪُرڪُري تهه ڏئي ٿو، تنهنڪري ان کان سواءِ پڪوڙي ٿوري نرم ٿيندي.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Add 2 big spoons more gram flour, or 1 big spoon corn flour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so without it the pakodi will be a little softer.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: ڪاجو پڪوڙي ڪيترو عرصو ڪُرڪُري رهي ٿي؟
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: هوا بند جار ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 4–5 ڏينهن، بشرطيڪ جار ۾ وجهڻ کان اڳ پوري طرح ٿڌي ٿئي.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: In an airtight jar about 4–5 days, provided it cools fully before putting in the jar.

seg.60df05d4b9d3.t: جيڊي پپّو پڪوڙي · ڪاجو پڪوڙيءَ جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.60df05d4b9d3.back: JD Pappu Pakodi · cashew pakodi recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: جيڊي پپّو پڪوڙي. اسان جي جيڊي پپّو پيڪ جي سڄن ڪاجو، ٻيسڻ، چانورن جي اٽي ۽ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر سان ڪُرڪُري ڪاجو پڪوڙي. قدم بقدم طريقو، صلاحون ۽ سوال جواب.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: JD Pappu Pakodi. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our JD Pappu pack, gram flour, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step by step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: جيڊي پپّو پڪوڙي: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: JD Pappu Pakodi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.f99e3a7cfd38.t: جيڊي پپّو اپما ⟦1⟧(ڪاجو ۽ سوجيءَ جي اپما)⟦/1⟧
seg.f99e3a7cfd38.back: JD Pappu Upma ⟦1⟧(cashew and semolina upma)⟦/1⟧

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: اپما آنڌرا جو روزانو ٽفن آهي: سوجي بصر، ساون مرچن ۽ ڪڙي پتن واري مصالحيدار پاڻيءَ ۾ نرم پچائي ويندي آهي. جيڊي پپّو اپما ان جو سينگاريل روپ آهي، گيهه ۾ سونهري تريل ڪاجو جي چڱي مُٺ سان، جيئن مهمانن، ڏڻن جي صبحن ۽ شادين لاءِ ٺهندي آهي، اڪثر پيسرٽّو سان يا هڪ چمچي کنڊ سان پيش ڪئي ويندي آهي.
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's daily tiffin: semolina is cooked soft in spiced water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. JD Pappu Upma is its decorated form, with a good fistful of cashews fried golden in ghee, as it is made for guests, festival mornings and weddings, often served with pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: اسان جا جيڊي پپّو ڪاجو سڄا ۽ سادا آهن، تنهنڪري هڪجيترا تريا وڃن ٿا ۽ نرم سوجيءَ ۾ ڪُرڪُرا رهن ٿا. اها لڳ ڀڳ 25 منٽن ۾ دسترخوان تي هوندي آهي. هيءَ ترڪيب 3 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our JD Pappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crisp in the soft semolina. It is on the dining spread in about 25 minutes. This recipe is for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: سوجي ڀُڃيو، ڪاجو گيهه ۾ تريو، پوءِ تڙڪو ڏئي بصر ۽ مرچ نرم ڪريو. لوڻ سان پاڻي اٻاريو، سوجي ملايو، ڍڪيو ۽ آخر ۾ ڪاجو وجهو.
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast the semolina, fry cashews in ghee, then give a tempering and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, mix in the semolina, cover and at the end add the cashews.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 ڪپ بمبئي سوجي ⟦1⟧وچولي سوجي (سوجي)، لڳ ڀڳ 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧for a firm upma 2 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ ڪپ ڪاجو ⟦1⟧سڄا يا اڌ ڪيل، لڳ ڀڳ 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 وڏا چمچا گيهه ⟦1⟧يا 2 وڏا چمچا تيل ۽ 1 وڏو چمچو گيهه⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 big spoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 big spoons oil and 1 big spoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2 ساوا مرچ ⟦1⟧چيريل؛ وڌيڪ تکي اپما لاءِ 3⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; for a hotter upma 3⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: بصر، ادرڪ ۽ ساوا ڌاڻا ڪٽيو، ساوا مرچ چيريو، ۽ پاڻي ماپي رکو.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Cut the onion, ginger and green coriander, slit the green chillies, and keep the water measured.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: سوجي سُڪي پين ۾ ايستائين ڀُڃيو جو سيڪيل خوشبو اچي، لڳ ڀڳ 5 منٽ. ان کي هلڪي رنگ جي رکو. وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي لڳاتار هلائيندا رهو، پوءِ ٿالهيءَ ۾ لاهيو.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast the semolina in a dry pan until a toasted aroma comes, about 5 minutes. Keep it light in colour. On medium-low fire keep stirring continuously, then take it off onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: ويڪري، ڳري پين ۾ وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي گيهه گرم ڪريو.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: Heat ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low fire.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: ڪاجو گيهه ۾ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو؛ ڪڍي رکو. ان ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 1–2 منٽ لڳن ٿا؛ گيهه پين ۾ رهڻ ڏيو.
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry the cashews in the ghee until golden; take out and keep. This takes about 1–2 minutes; let the ghee stay in the pan.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: رائي، دالين ۽ ڪڙي پتن جو تڙڪو ڏيو. بصر ۽ مرچ نرم ڪريو، پاڻي ۽ لوڻ وجهو، ۽ اٻاريو. ڪڙي پتا وجهڻ کان اڳ رائي تڙڪڻ ڏيو ۽ داليون هلڪيون سونهريون ٿيڻ ڏيو، پوءِ بصر سان ادرڪ وجهو ۽ 3–4 منٽ پچايو جيستائين بصر نرم ٿئي.
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Give a tempering of mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Before adding curry leaves let the mustard crackle and let the dals become light golden, then add ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion is soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: پاڻي اٻرڻ تي چکو؛ اهو ٿورو لوڻياٺو لڳي، ڇو ته سوجي لوڻ جذب ڪندي.
seg.be01d433ae80.back: When the water boils taste it; it should taste a little salty, because the semolina will absorb salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: باهه هلڪي ڪريو. هلائيندي سوجي سنهي ڌار ۾ وجهو. هلڪي باهه تي 3 منٽ ڍڪيو؛ مٿان ڪاجو وجهو.
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Lower the fire. While stirring pour the semolina in a thin stream. Cover on low fire for 3 minutes; add cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: ڪاجو وجهڻ کان اڳ اپما ڏسو: سوجي نرم هجي، ڪو سخت داڻو نه هجي، ۽ اپما پين جي پاسن کان الڳ ٿئي. جيڪڏهن اڃا داڻيدار هجي، ته 2 وڏا چمچا گرم پاڻي ڇڻڪيو، ڍڪيو ۽ 1 منٽ ٻيو پچايو.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Look at the upma before adding the cashews: the semolina should be soft, with no hard grain, and the upma should come away from the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle 2 big spoons hot water, cover and cook 1 more minute.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: گيهه جو ٻيو چمچو ۽ ساوا ڌاڻا، جيڪڏهن وجهو ٿا، گهڻن ڪاجو سان گڏ ملايو.
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: Mix the second spoon of ghee and the green coriander, if you are adding it, together with most of the cashews.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: گرم پيش ڪريو، باقي ڪاجو مٿان رکي.
seg.351e9512c914.back: Serve hot, keeping the remaining cashews on top.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: هلائيندي سوجي سنهي ڌار ۾ وجهو ته ڳنڍيون نه ٺهن.
seg.4643e12d303d.back: While stirring pour the semolina in a thin stream so lumps do not form.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: پهريان سوجي ڀُڃڻ سان هر داڻو الڳ رهي ٿو؛ نه ڀُڃيو ته اپما چيڪي ٿي ويندي.
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: Roasting the semolina first keeps every grain separate; if you do not roast, the upma will become sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: ڪاجو وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي تريو ۽ سونهري ٿيندي ئي ڪڍي وٺو؛ گرم گيهه ۾ اهي ڳاڙها ٿيندا رهن ٿا.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry the cashews on medium-low fire and take them out as soon as they become golden; in hot ghee they keep getting redder.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: رکڻ سان اپما سخت ٿئي ٿي، تنهنڪري ان کي باهه تان تڏهن لاهيو جڏهن توهان جي پسند کان ٿوري نرم هجي.
seg.975560a8a158.back: On keeping upma becomes firm, so take it off the fire when it is a little softer than you like.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: ڀاڄين واري اپما: بصر سان ½ ڪپ ڪٽيل گاجر، ڦريون ۽ مٽر وجهو ۽ پاڻي وجهڻ کان اڳ 3–4 منٽ پچايو.
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: with the onion add ½ cup cut carrot, beans and peas and cook 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: ٽماٽي واري اپما: بصر کان پوءِ 1 ڪٽيل ٽماٽو وجهو ۽ پاڻي وجهڻ کان اڳ نرم ٿيڻ تائين پچايو.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: after the onion add 1 cut tomato and cook until soft before adding water.

seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: گوڌوما راوا اپما: اوتري ئي ڪڻڪ جي سوجي 3 ڪپ پاڻيءَ سان وٺو ۽ ڍڪي 5–6 منٽ پچايو.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma Rava Upma: take the same amount of wheat semolina with 3 cups water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: نيرن جي ٽفن طور گرم پيش ڪريو ناريل جي چٽڻي، الّم پچّڙي يا هڪ چمچي کنڊ سان، يا پيسرٽّو اپما لاءِ پيسرٽّو سان.
seg.01300d94ad36.back: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or with pesarattu for pesarattu upma.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: اپما ٺهڻ کان جلد پوءِ گرم کائڻ سڀ کان سٺي آهي. بچيل اپما فرج ۾ ڍڪي 1 ڏينهن تائين رکو ۽ ٻيهر گرم ڪرڻ کان اڳ پاڻي ڇڻڪيو.
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Upma is best eaten hot soon after it is made. Keep leftover upma covered in the fridge up to 1 day and sprinkle water before reheating.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.t: ڳنڍين کان سواءِ اپما ڪيئن ٺاهجي؟
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How to make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: پاڻي اٻرندو رکو، باهه هلڪي ڪريو ۽ هڪ هٿ سان سوجي سنهي ڌار ۾ وجهو ۽ ٻئي سان هلائيندا رهو.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water boiling, lower the fire and with one hand pour the semolina in a thin stream and with the other keep stirring.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: اپما لاءِ سوجي ۽ پاڻيءَ جو صحيح تناسب ڪهڙو آهي؟
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right ratio of semolina and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: نرم آنڌرا طرز جي اپما لاءِ 1 ڪپ بمبئي سوجيءَ ۾ 2½ ڪپ پاڻي وجهو. سخت ۽ وڌيڪ الڳ داڻن واري اپما لاءِ 2 ڪپ.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For soft Andhra-style upma add 2½ cups water to 1 cup Bombay rava. For a firm and more separate-grained upma 2 cups.

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: سوجي ڀُڳل نه هئي، يا گهڻو پاڻي پيو. سوجي سيڪيل خوشبو اچڻ تائين ڀُڃيو، ۽ هر ڪپ لاءِ لڳ ڀڳ 2½ ڪپ پاڻي رکو.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The semolina was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the semolina until a toasted aroma comes, and keep about 2½ cups water per cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When should cashews be added to upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: پهريان انهن کي گيهه ۾ تري ڪڍي رکو، پوءِ آخر ۾ ملايو. جلدي وجهو ته اپما ۾ نرم ٿي ويندا.
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry them in ghee and take out and keep, then mix in at the end. If added early they will become soft in the upma.

seg.6cb14eaca16a.t: جيڊي پپّو اپما · جيڊي پپّو اپما جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.6cb14eaca16a.back: JD Pappu Upma · JD Pappu Upma recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: جيڊي پپّو اپما. گيهه ۾ سونهري تريل جيڊي پپّو ڪاجو سان آنڌرا سوجي اپما، نرم ۽ جلدي ٺهندڙ صبح جو ٽفن. قدم بقدم طريقو، صلاحون ۽ سوال جواب. 3 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.8b57b24af158.back: JD Pappu Upma. Andhra semolina upma with JD Pappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quickly made morning tiffin. Step by step method, tips and questions-answers. For 3 people.

seg.5eecbe415597.t: جيڊي پپّو اپما (ڪاجو ۽ سوجيءَ جي اپما) · 1acrefarms
seg.5eecbe415597.back: JD Pappu Upma (cashew and semolina upma) · 1acrefarms

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: جيڊي پپّو اپما: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.661f01591624.back: JD Pappu Upma: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.fa4ee77ca2bb.t: آنڌرا جي تريل ڀاڄي · 4 ماڻهن لاءِ

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
