seg.992a8475993f.t: ڪوڊي ويپوڊو آنڌرا جو سُڪو تريل ڪڪڙ آهي: ڪڪڙ جا ننڍا ٽڪرا پنهنجي ئي رس ۾ پچائي، پوءِ ڪڙي پتن، ساون مرچن ۽ هينئر ئي ڀُڳل مصالحي سان تيل ۾ چڱيءَ طرح تريا ويندا آهن جيستائين گهرا ۽ مصالحي سان چنبڙيل ٿي وڃن. هي آنڌرا جي شادين ۾ شروعاتي کاڌو آهي ۽ گهر ۾ رسم چانورن يا پپّو سان پاسي ۾ رکيو ويندو آهي.
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi Vepudu is Andhra's dry fried chicken: small pieces of chicken are cooked in their own juice, then fried well in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and just-now roasted masala until they become deep and coated with masala. This is a starter dish at Andhra weddings and at home it is kept on the side with rasam rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: اسان جو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ان کي گهرو ڳاڙهو رنگ ۽ اها تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو جنهن لاءِ آنڌرا جون تريل ڀاڄيون مشهور آهن، اسان جو هيڊ پائوڊر مصالحي ۾ پوي ٿو، ۽ اسان جا سڄا ڪاجو جا داڻا، سونهري تريل، آخر ۾ پون ٿا. پاسي جي کاڌي طور 4 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that heat for which Andhra fried dishes are famous, our turmeric powder goes into the masala, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. As a side dish for 4 people.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: ڪڪڙ کي تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر، ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ ۽ ليمي ۾ رکو، ان جي پنهنجي رس ۾ پچايو، پوءِ ڪڙي پتن، ساون مرچن، ڀُڳل مصالحي ۽ ڪاجو سان سُڪو تريو.
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Keep the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juice, then dry-fry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g هڏين کان سواءِ ڪڪڙ ⟦1⟧1 انچ جي ٽڪرن ۾ ڪٽيل؛ يا 600 g هڏين سميت ننڍا ٽڪرا⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut in 1 inch pieces; or 600 g small pieces with bones⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.t: 15 ڪاجو ⟦1⟧سڄا ڪاجو جا داڻا؛ وڏا هجن ته اڌ ڪريو⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; if big halve them⟦/1⟧

seg.e43b68ea429f.t: 2 ٽاريون ڪڙي پتا ⟦1⟧پتا لاٿل، لڳ ڀڳ 30⟦/1⟧
seg.e43b68ea429f.back: 2 sprigs curry leaves ⟦1⟧leaves taken off, about 30⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: ڪڪڙ کي ڪپڙي سان دٻائي سُڪو ڪريو ته مصالحو چنبڙي.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Press the chicken dry with a cloth so the masala sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: ڪڪڙ کي تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ، ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ، ليمي جي رس ۽ لوڻ ۾ 30 منٽ رکو. هٿن سان چڱيءَ طرح ملايو ته هر ٽڪري تي مصالحو چڙهي.
seg.075327f4deca.back: Keep the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt for 30 minutes. Mix well with the hands so the masala coats every piece.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: ان وچ ۾، ڌاڻا، زيرو، سونف، لونگ ۽ دارچيني ننڍي پين ۾ هلڪي باهه تي سُڪا ڀُڃيو جيستائين خوشبو اچي ۽ رنگ هڪ درجو گهرو ٿئي، لڳ ڀڳ 2 منٽ. ٿڌو ڪري ٿلهي پائوڊر ۾ پيهيو. هي ترڻ وارو مصالحو آهي.
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile, dry-roast coriander, cumin, fennel, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low fire until aroma comes and the colour becomes one shade deeper, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the frying masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: ڪڪڙ کي پاڻيءَ کان سواءِ ڳري ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وجهو، ڍڪيو ۽ وچولي باهه تي رکو.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken without water in a heavy kadhai, cover and keep on medium fire.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: ان کي ڍڪي پنهنجي رس ۾ ايستائين پچايو جو ڪو گلابي رنگ نه رهي، لڳ ڀڳ 12 منٽ. هڪ ٻه دفعا هلايو؛ پچڻ وقت ڪڪڙ پاڻي ڇڏي ٿو.
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook it covered in its own juice until no pink colour remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; while cooking the chicken releases water.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: ڍڪ لاهيو ۽ تيز باهه تي هلائيندي پچايو جيستائين پاڻي لڳ ڀڳ سُڪي وڃي، 3–4 منٽ. ڪڪڙ ٿالهيءَ ۾ لاهيو ۽ ڪڙهائي صاف ڪريو.
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Remove the lid and cook on high fire while stirring until the water almost dries up, 3–4 minutes. Take the chicken out onto a plate and clean the kadhai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.t: ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وچولي باهه تي تيل گرم ڪريو.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat oil in the kadhai on medium fire.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: ڪاجو تيل ۾ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو؛ ڪڍي رکو. انهن ۾ هڪ منٽ کان به گهٽ لڳي ٿو، تنهنڪري لڳاتار هلايو ۽ سوراخن واري چمچي سان ڪڍو.
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take out and keep. They take even less than a minute, so stir continuously and take out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: بصر، جيڪڏهن وجهو ٿا، وجهو ۽ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو. ساوا مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا تريو. پري بيهو؛ پتا تڙڪن ۽ ڇٽڪن ٿا.
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: Add the onion, if you are adding it, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and splutter.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: ڪڪڙ ۽ ترڻ وارو مصالحو وجهو. تيز باهه تي سُڪو ۽ گهرو ٿيڻ تائين تريو، پوءِ ڪاجو ملايو. 6–8 منٽ اُڇاليندا رهو، جيستائين مصالحو ٽڪرن سان چنبڙي ۽ ڪنارا گهرا ۽ ڪُرڪُرا ٿين.
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken and the frying masala. Fry on high fire until dry and deep, then mix in the cashews. Keep tossing 6–8 minutes, until the masala sticks to the pieces and the edges become deep and crisp.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: چکو، ضرورت هجي ته لوڻ وجهو، ساوا ڌاڻا ڇڻڪيو ۽ گرم پيش ڪريو.
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste, add salt if needed, sprinkle green coriander and serve hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: آخر ۾ تيز باهه تي تريو ته مصالحو هر ٽڪري سان چنبڙي.
seg.349c72ce839a.back: At the end fry on high fire so the masala sticks to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر تمام تکو آهي. وچولي تکاڻ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو وجهو، يا ڳاڙهي رنگ ۽ گهٽ تکاڻ لاءِ ان جي جاءِ تي سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وجهو.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat add 1 small spoon, or for red colour and less heat add Sannam chilli powder in its place.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: ٽڪرا ننڍا ۽ هڪجيڏا ڪٽيو ته ساڳئي وقت پچن ۽ ترڻ ۾ چڱا ڪُرڪُرا ٿين.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and same-sized so they cook at the same time and become well crisp in frying.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: ترڻ وارو مصالحو پچائڻ کان ٿورو اڳ پيهيو؛ ڀُڳل مصالحي جي خوشبو سٺي ويپوڊو جي روح آهي.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the frying masala shortly before cooking; the aroma of roasted masala is the soul of good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: هڏين سميت: 600 g هڏين وارا ننڍا ٽڪرا وٺو ۽ انهن کي پنهنجي رس ۾ 18–20 منٽ پچايو، جيستائين هڏيءَ جي ويجهو ڪو گلابي رنگ نه رهي.
seg.62d6684e446e.back: With bones: take 600 g small pieces with bones and cook them in their own juice 18–20 minutes, until no pink colour remains near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: ڪوبّري ويپوڊو: مصالحي سان گڏ 3 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل سُڪو ناريل وجهو ۽ ناسي ٿيڻ تائين اُڇاليو.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari Vepudu: together with the masala add 3 big spoons grated dry coconut and toss until brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: مٽن ويپوڊو: 500 g هڏين کان سواءِ ٻڪريءَ جو گوشت مصالحي ۽ ½ ڪپ پاڻيءَ سان پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ 5–6 سيٽين تائين پچايو، پوءِ ساڳيءَ طرح تريو.
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton Vepudu: cook 500 g boneless goat meat with the masala and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker for 5–6 whistles, then fry the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: گرم پيش ڪريو رسم چانورن، پپّو ۽ چانورن يا سانڀر چانورن سان پاسي ۾، يا اڪيلو شروعاتي کاڌي طور ڪتريل بصر ۽ ليمي جي ڦارن سان.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve hot with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice on the side, or alone as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: فرج ۾ ڍڪي 2 ڏينهن تائين رکو. گرم پين ۾ تيل جا ڪجهه ڦڙا وجهي ايترو ٻيهر گرم ڪريو جو اندر تائين ٻاڦ نڪري؛ اهو ٻيهر ڪُرڪُرو ٿي وڃي ٿو.
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil so hot that steam comes out right to the inside; it becomes crisp again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: آنڌرا ۾ تريل ڪڪڙ ۽ ڪڪڙ جي سالڻ ۾ ڪهڙو فرق آهي؟
seg.551573b4b443.back: What is the difference between fried chicken and chicken curry in Andhra?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: ويپوڊو سُڪو هوندو آهي: ڪڪڙ پنهنجي رس ۾ پچائي، پوءِ ايترو تريو ويندو آهي جو مصالحو ان تي چڙهي وڃي ۽ شوربو نه رهي. ڪوڊي ڪورا چانورن لاءِ بصر-ٽماٽي جي شوربي وارو سالڻ آهي.
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juice, then fried so much that the masala coats it and no gravy remains. Kodi Kura is a curry with onion-tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: ويپوڊو لاءِ هڏين کان سواءِ ڪڪڙ وٺجي يا هڏين سميت؟
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: For vepudu should boneless chicken be taken or with bones?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: ٻئي ٺيڪ آهن. هڏين کان سواءِ جلدي پچي ٿو ۽ وڌيڪ ڪُرڪُرو ٿئي ٿو؛ هڏين سميت ننڍن ٽڪرن ۾ ذائقو وڌيڪ آهي پر انهن کي پنهنجي رس ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 8 منٽ وڌيڪ گهرجن.
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both are fine. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crisper; with bones, in small pieces, the taste is more but they need about 8 minutes more in their own juice.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: سڀ کان ٿلهي ٽڪري کي ڪٽي ڏسو. ڪڪڙ تڏهن پچيل آهي جڏهن وچ ۾ (يا هڏيءَ جي ويجهو) ڪو گلابي رنگ نه رهي ۽ رس صاف نڪري.
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut and look at the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice comes out clear.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: ڪوڊي ويپوڊو گهٽ تکو ڪيئن ٺاهجي؟
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How to make Kodi Vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر وجهو، يا ان جي جاءِ تي سنّم مرچ پائوڊر، ۽ رڳو 2 ساوا مرچ چيريو. ڪاجو ۽ ڪڙي پتا ذائقو ڀريل رکن ٿا.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Add 1 small spoon Teja chilli powder, or in its place Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. Cashews and curry leaves keep the taste full.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: ڪوڊي ويپوڊو · ڪوڊي ويپوڊو (آنڌرا تريل ڪڪڙ) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: Kodi Vepudu · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra fried chicken) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: ڪوڊي ويپوڊو. آنڌرا جو تريل ڪڪڙ: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ۽ هيڊ پائوڊر ۾ رکيل ڪڪڙ، ڪڙي پتن، ساون مرچن، ڀُڳل مصالحي ۽ اسان جي ڪاجو سان سُڪو تريل.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: Kodi Vepudu. Andhra's fried chicken: chicken kept in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, dry-fried with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: ڪوڊي ويپوڊو: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.264a0c99ef27.t: ٽفن باڪس جا چانور · 4 ماڻهن لاءِ

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: نمّڪايا پليهورا آنڌرا جي گهرن جا چمڪندڙ پيلا ليمي وارا چانور آهن: پچيل چانور مونگ پَلي، چڻن جي دال، ماش جي دال، رائي، ساون مرچن ۽ ڪڙي پتن جي تڙڪندڙ تڙڪي سان ملايا ويندا آهن، پوءِ ليمي جي رس سان کٽا ڪيا ويندا آهن. اهي ريل جي سفرن، اسڪول جي ٽفن باڪسن ۽ مندر جي ڏينهن لاءِ ٻڌا ويندا آهن، ۽ ڏڻن ۽ پوڄائن لاءِ وڏي مقدار ۾ ٺهندا آهن.
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora is the shining yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice is mixed with a crackling tempering of groundnut, chana dal, urad dal, mustard, green chillies and curry leaves, then made sour with lemon juice. It is packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and is made in large quantity for festivals and pujas.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: اسان جو هيڊ پائوڊر ڪجهه سيڪنڊن لاءِ گرم تيل ۾ پوي ٿو، جيڪو هر داڻي کي هڪجيترو سونهري پيلو ڪري ٿو ۽ ان جي ڪچاڻ ختم ڪري ٿو. هيءَ ترڪيب 4 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into hot oil for a few seconds, which makes every grain evenly golden yellow and removes its rawness. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: ڪل وقت ۾ چانور پچائڻ ۽ 15 منٽ رکڻ شامل آهي ته ذائقا ٺهي ويهن.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: The total time includes cooking the rice and keeping 15 minutes so the flavours settle in.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: مونگ پَلي، داليون، رائي، مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا تيل ۾ تريو، هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ هينگ وجهو، پوءِ ٿڌن چانورن، لوڻ ۽ ليمي جي رس سان ملايو.
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry groundnut, dals, mustard, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and asafoetida, then mix with cool rice, salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 ڪپ چانور ⟦1⟧سونا مسوري، لڳ ڀڳ 200 g؛ پچڻ کان پوءِ لڳ ڀڳ 3 ڪپ ٿين ٿا⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori, about 200 g; after cooking becomes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 ڪپ پچيل چانور ⟦1⟧ٿورا سخت پچيل، داڻا الڳ⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 وڏا چمچا ليمي جي رس ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 2 ليمن مان؛ ذائقي موجب وڌيڪ⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 big spoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; more according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.t: 3 وڏا چمچا تيل ⟦1⟧عام طور مونگ پَليءَ جو تيل⟦/1⟧

seg.ad3af06df4e4.t: ¼ ڪپ مونگ پَلي ⟦1⟧ڪچي، کل سان⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: چانور ڌوئو ۽ 2 ڪپ پاڻيءَ سان بس پچڻ تائين پچايو، ته داڻا الڳ رهن. توهان کي لڳ ڀڳ 3 ڪپ پچيل چانور گهرجن.
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook with 2 cups water just until cooked, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups cooked rice.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: پچيل چانور ٿالهيءَ ۾ ٿڌا ٿيڻ لاءِ پکيڙيو؛ لوڻ وجهو. ڪانٽي سان ڦلائي لڳ ڀڳ 10 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو جيستائين ڪوسا ٿين، گرم نه، ته ملائڻ وقت داڻا نه ٽٽن.
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add salt. Fluff with a fork and leave about 10 minutes until lukewarm, not hot, so the grains do not break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: تيل گرم ڪريو؛ مونگ پَلي، داليون، رائي، مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا تريو. وچولي باهه تي پهريان مونگ پَلي لڳ ڀڳ 2 منٽ تريو جيستائين تڙڪي ۽ کل گهري ٿئي.
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat oil; fry groundnut, dals, mustard, chillies and curry leaves. On medium fire first fry the groundnut about 2 minutes until it crackles and the skin becomes darker.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: چڻن ۽ ماش جي دال وجهو ۽ هلڪي سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو، لڳ ڀڳ 1 منٽ.
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add chana and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: رائي وجهو ۽ تڙڪڻ ڏيو، پوءِ سُڪل ڳاڙها مرچ، ساوا مرچ، ادرڪ ۽ ڪڙي پتا وجهي ڪجهه سيڪنڊ تريو جيستائين پتا ڪُرڪُرا ٿين.
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add mustard and let it crackle, then add dried red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves become crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ هينگ ملايو؛ باهه بند ڪريو. رڳو 5–10 سيڪنڊ هلايو ته هيڊ گرم تيل ۾ پچي پر سڙي نه.
seg.6e856356980b.back: Mix in turmeric powder and asafoetida; turn off the fire. Stir only 5–10 seconds so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil but does not burn.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: چانورن مٿان وجهو، ليمي جي رس وجهو ۽ آهستي ملايو. آڱريون يا سڌو چمچو استعمال ڪريو ۽ چانور هيٺان کان کڻو ته هر داڻو پيلو ٿئي پر ڳري نه.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour over the rice, add lemon juice and mix gently. Use fingers or a flat spoon and lift the rice from below so every grain becomes yellow but does not go mushy.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: چکو ۽ ضرورت هجي ته وڌيڪ لوڻ يا ليمي جي رس وجهو. چانور صاف کٽا ۽ لوڻياٺا لڳن، ڇو ته رکڻ سان ذائقو نرم ٿئي ٿو.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and if needed add more salt or lemon juice. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, because on keeping the taste softens.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ پليهورا کي ڍڪي 15 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو ته چانور ليمو ۽ تڙڪو جذب ڪن.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Before serving leave the pulihora covered 15 minutes so the rice absorbs the lemon and tempering.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: ليمي جي رس باهه کان پري وجهو ته تيز رهي. پچايل ليمي جي رس ڪڙي ٿي وڃي ٿي.
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add the lemon juice away from the fire so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice becomes bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: چانور ٿورا سخت پچايو ۽ ملائڻ کان اڳ ٿڌا ٿيڻ ڏيو؛ گرم، نرم چانور پيسٽ جهڙا ٿي وڃن ٿا.
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice a little firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice becomes paste-like.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: هيڊ پائوڊر تيل ۾ رڳو ڪجهه سيڪنڊ رکو؛ سڙيل هيڊ گهرو رنگ ۽ ڪڙو ذائقو ڏئي ٿي.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep turmeric powder in the oil only a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and bitter taste.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: صبح جا بچيل چانور سٺا ٿين ٿا، ڇو ته داڻا اڳ ۾ ئي سخت ۽ الڳ هوندا آهن.
seg.747474140bbf.back: Leftover rice from the morning is good, because the grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: ڪاجو: ڏڻ واري پليهورا لاءِ مونگ پَليءَ سان 10 اڌ ڪاجو تريو.
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for festival pulihora fry 10 cashew halves with the groundnut.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: ماميڊيڪايا پليهورا: ليمي جي رس بدران تڙڪي سان 1 ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪچو انب ملايو.
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya Pulihora: instead of lemon juice mix 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: ڪدوڪش ٿيل ناريل: نرم چانورن لاءِ ليمي جي رس سان گڏ 2 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل ناريل وجهو.
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for softer rice add 2 big spoons grated coconut together with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي ڏهي، اچار يا اپّڊم سان پيش ڪريو. هي ٽفن باڪس ۽ سفر جا مشهور چانور آهن.
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or appadam. This is the famous rice of tiffin boxes and journeys.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: هي ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي لڳ ڀڳ 6 ڪلاڪ چڱا رهن ٿا، انهيءَ ڪري سفر ۾ کڻبا آهن. بچيل فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ هڪ ڏينهن اندر کائو.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: This stays good about 6 hours at room temperature, that is why it is carried on journeys. Keep leftover covered in the fridge and eat within a day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: منهنجا ليمي وارا چانور ڪڙا ڇو لڳن ٿا؟
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: يا ته ليمي جي رس پچي وئي يا هيڊ تيل ۾ سڙي وئي. هيڊ وجهڻ کان اڳ چُلهه بند ڪريو، ۽ ليمي جي رس رڳو چانورن ۾، باهه کان پري، وجهو.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Turn off the stove before adding turmeric, and add the lemon juice only into the rice, away from the fire.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: پليهورا ۽ ليمي وارن چانورن ۾ ڪهڙو فرق آهي؟
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: پليهورا کٽن چانورن جو تيلگو نالو آهي. چنتاپنڊو پليهورا املي جي پيسٽ سان کٽي ٿئي ٿي؛ نمّڪايا پليهورا ليمي واري قسم آهي، جلدي ٺهي ٿي ۽ رنگ ۾ هلڪي آهي.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name for sour rice. Chintapandu pulihora is sour with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon kind, is made quickly and is lighter in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: ليمي وارن چانورن کي ڳرڻ کان ڪيئن بچائجي؟
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: How to save lemon rice from going mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: گهٽ پاڻيءَ سان چانور ٿورا سخت پچايو، ٿالهيءَ ۾ ٿڌا ڪريو، ۽ دٻائڻ بدران هيٺان کان کڻي آهستي ملايو.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool on a plate, and mix gently lifting from below instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.t: 3 ڪپ چانورن لاءِ ڪيتري ليمي جي رس؟
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: لڳ ڀڳ 3 وڏا چمچا، 2 وچولن ليمن جي رس. آهستي وجهو ۽ چکو، ڇو ته ليمن جي کٽاڻ مختلف هوندي آهي.
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 big spoons, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly and taste, because the sourness of lemons varies.

seg.0251508f9c8b.t: نمّڪايا پليهورا · ليمي وارن چانورن جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: نمّڪايا پليهورا. آنڌرا جا ليمي وارا چانور: ٿڌا چانور مونگ پَلي ۽ دال جي تڙڪي، اسان جي هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ ليمي جي رس سان مليل. قدم بقدم طريقو، صلاحون ۽ سوال جواب.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora. Andhra's lemon rice: cool rice mixed with groundnut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step by step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: نمّڪايا پليهورا: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.48837dc15c7d.t: لنچ باڪس جا چانور · 4 ماڻهن لاءِ

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: پسوپو انّم سادا چانور آهن جيڪي هيڊ سان چمڪندڙ پيلا ڪري رائي، چڻن جي دال، ڪڙي پتن ۽ ساون مرچن جي تڙڪندڙ تڙڪي ۾ ملايا ويندا آهن، ۽ مٿان تريل ڪاجو. آنڌرا جا گهر انهن کي لنچ باڪس، هفتي جي جلدي ماني ۽ پوڄا جي ڏينهن پرساد طور ٺاهيندا آهن، اڪثر صبح جي بچيل چانورن سان.
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu Annam is plain rice which, made shining yellow with turmeric, is mixed into a crackling tempering of mustard, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for the lunch box, the quick weekday meal and as prasad on puja day, often with leftover rice from the morning.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: اسان جو پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر (ڪونڊا پسوپو) چانورن کي گهرو پيلو رنگ ۽ مٽيءَ جهڙي هيڊ جي خوشبو ڏئي ٿو، تنهنڪري 4 ماڻهن لاءِ اڌ ننڍو چمچو ڪافي آهي. ساڳئي تيل ۾ تريل سڄا ڪاجو (جيڊي پپّو) ڪُرڪُرائپ آڻين ٿا.
seg.510252086556.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice a deep yellow colour and an earth-like turmeric aroma, so for 4 people half a small spoon is enough. Whole cashews (JD Pappu) fried in the same oil bring crunch.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: ڪل وقت ۾ پچيل چانورن کي ٿڌو ٿيڻ جا لڳ ڀڳ 15 منٽ شامل آهن.
seg.38badedc8d11.back: The total time includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: چانور پچايو ۽ ٿڌا ٿيڻ ڏيو. ڪاجو، رائي، چڻن جي دال، مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا تيل ۾ تريو، پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر وجهو ۽ چانور ملايو.
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and mix in the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 ڪپ چانور ⟦1⟧سونا مسوري، لڳ ڀڳ 200 g؛ پچڻ کان پوءِ لڳ ڀڳ 3 ڪپ ٿين ٿا⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori, about 200 g; after cooking becomes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ ننڍو چمچو پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧ڪونڊا پسوپو⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ small spoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 big spoon ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧mixed in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.afe3b0737680.t: ⟦1⟧هيڊ پائوڊر⟦/1⟧ سان به سٺو ٿئي ٿو.
seg.afe3b0737680.back: It also goes well with ⟦1⟧turmeric powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.t: چانور 2–3 دفعا پاڻي بدلائي ڌوئو ۽ پاڻي ڪڍي ڇڏيو.
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice changing water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: چانور ايئن پچايو جو داڻا الڳ رهن، پوءِ ٿڌا ٿيڻ لاءِ ٿالهيءَ ۾ پکيڙيو. ديڳڙي يا پريشر ڪُڪر (2 سيٽيون) ۾ 1 ڪپ چانورن لاءِ 2 ڪپ پاڻي وجهو، ۽ پکيڙڻ کان اڳ ڪانٽي سان ڦلايو.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice so that the grains stay separate, then spread on a plate to cool. In a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles) add 2 cups water for 1 cup rice, and fluff with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: چانورن کي لڳ ڀڳ 15 منٽ ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو جيستائين بس ڪوسا رهن. مٿان لوڻ ڇڻڪيو.
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes until just lukewarm. Sprinkle salt on top.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: ويڪري ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وچولي باهه تي تيل گرم ڪريو.
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat oil in a wide kadhai on medium fire.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: ڪاجو تيل ۾ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو؛ ڪڍي رکو. رائي ۽ چڻن جي دال وجهو. ڪاجو ٿالهيءَ ۾ رکو؛ اهي لڳ ڀڳ 1 منٽ ۾ سونهري ٿين ٿا.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take out and keep. Add mustard and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they become golden in about 1 minute.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: رائي تڙڪي ته ماش جي دال ۽ سُڪل ڳاڙها مرچ وجهو ۽ هلايو.
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: When the mustard crackles add urad dal and dried red chillies and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: دال سونهري ٿئي ته مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا وجهو، پوءِ هلڪي باهه تي هيڊ. ڪڙي پتن سان ادرڪ ۽ هينگ وجهو، ۽ هيڊ کي رڳو 5–10 سيڪنڊ هلايو.
seg.2688182af66a.back: When the dal becomes golden add chillies and curry leaves, then on low fire the turmeric. With the curry leaves add ginger and asafoetida, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: هڪدم باهه بند ڪريو ته هيڊ نه سڙي.
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Immediately turn off the fire so the turmeric does not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: چانور، ڪاجو ۽ لوڻ وجهو ۽ هڪجيترا پيلا ٿيڻ تائين آهستي ملايو. سڌو چمچو وٺو ۽ دٻائڻ بدران کڻي ورائي ملايو، ته داڻا سڄا رهن.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add rice, cashews and salt and mix gently until evenly yellow. Take a flat spoon and mix by lifting and turning instead of pressing, so the grains stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: لوڻ چکو، جيڪڏهن وجهو ٿا ته گيهه ملايو، ڍڪيو ۽ پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ 5 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو ته چانور تڙڪو جذب ڪن.
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste the salt, if you are adding it mix in the ghee, cover and before serving leave 5 minutes so the rice absorbs the tempering.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: پهريان چانور ٿڌا ٿيڻ لاءِ پکيڙيو ته داڻا نه ٽٽن.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: First spread the rice to cool so the grains do not break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: هيڊ هلڪي باهه تي وجهو ۽ رڳو ڪجهه سيڪنڊ هلايو؛ سڙيل هيڊ چانورن کي ڪڙو ڪري ٿي.
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add the turmeric on low fire and stir only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر گهڻو رنگ ڏئي ٿو؛ 1 ڪپ چانورن لاءِ ½ ننڍي چمچي سان شروع ڪريو ۽ گهرو پيلو گهرجي ته ئي هڪ چپٽي وڌيڪ وجهو.
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder gives a lot of colour; for 1 cup rice start with ½ small spoon and only if deep yellow is wanted add one pinch more.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: صبح جا بچيل چانور سٺا ٿين ٿا، بشرطيڪ داڻا الڳ هجن.
seg.505872469eb9.back: Leftover rice from the morning is good, provided the grains are separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: هيڊ پائوڊر: اسان جو روزانو پسوپو هيڊ پائوڊر به ساڳيءَ طرح ڪم ڪري ٿو؛ اوترو ئي ½ ننڍو چمچو وجهو.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also works the same way; add the same ½ small spoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: مونگ پَلي: وڌيڪ ڪُرڪُرائپ لاءِ ڪاجو کان اڳ 2 وڏا چمچا ڪچي مونگ پَلي تيل ۾ تريو.
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Groundnut: for more crunch fry 2 big spoons raw groundnut in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: ليمو: کٽن، پليهورا جهڙن چانورن لاءِ چانورن ۾ اڌ ليمي جي رس نچوڙيو.
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for sour, pulihora-like rice squeeze half a lemon's juice into the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: ناريل: چانورن سان گڏ 2 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل ناريل ملايو.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: mix 2 big spoons grated coconut together with the rice.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: ڪوسا يا ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي ڏهي، اپّڊالو يا سُڪي پٽاٽي جي ڀاڄيءَ سان پيش ڪريو. لنچ باڪس ۽ سفر لاءِ به چڱا ٻڌجن ٿا.
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve lukewarm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato vegetable. They also pack well for lunch box and journeys.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: ساڳئي ڏينهن کائڻ سڀ کان سٺو. بچيل فرج ۾ ڍڪي 1 ڏينهن تائين رکو ۽ ٿورو پاڻي ڇڻڪي گرم ڪريو.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Eating the same day is best. Keep leftover covered in the fridge up to 1 day and heat sprinkling a little water.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: چانور ايئن پچايو جو داڻا الڳ رهن ۽ ٿڌا ٿيڻ ڏيو. ڪاجو، رائي، چڻن جي دال، مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا تيل ۾ تريو، هيڊ هلڪي باهه تي ڪجهه سيڪنڊن لاءِ وجهو، پوءِ لوڻ سان چانور ملايو.
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low fire for a few seconds, then mix in the rice with salt.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: هيڊ وارن چانورن ۾ ڪيترو هيڊ پائوڊر پوي ٿو؟
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 ڪپ ڪچن چانورن (لڳ ڀڳ 3 ڪپ پچيل) لاءِ لڳ ڀڳ ½ ننڍو چمچو. پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر گهڻو رنگ ڏئي ٿو، تنهنڪري گهٽ سان شروع ڪريو ۽ ضرورت هجي ته هڪ چپٽي وڌيڪ وجهو.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: For 1 cup raw rice (about 3 cups cooked) about ½ small spoon. Hill turmeric powder gives a lot of colour, so start with less and if needed add one pinch more.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.t: منهنجا هيڊ وارا چانور ڪڙا ڇو آهن؟
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: هيڊ گرم تيل ۾ سڙي وئي، يا گهڻي پئجي وئي. هلڪي باهه تي وجهو، رڳو ڪجهه سيڪنڊ هلايو ۽ چانور وجهڻ کان اڳ باهه بند ڪريو.
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burnt in hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low fire, stir only a few seconds and turn off the fire before adding the rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: ڇا بچيل چانورن سان پسوپو انّم ٺاهي سگهجي ٿو؟
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can pasupu annam be made with leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: ها. الڳ داڻن وارا بچيل چانور سٺا ٿين ٿا. تڙڪي ۾ ملائڻ کان اڳ ڳنڍيون آڱرين سان ڀڃي ڇڏيو.
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains is good. Break the lumps with the fingers before mixing into the tempering.

seg.42238d687a8f.t: پسوپو انّم · پسوپو انّم جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: پسوپو انّم. پسوپو انّم، آنڌرا جا هيڊ وارا چانور: پچيل چانور رائي، چڻن جي دال ۽ ڪڙي پتن جي تڙڪي ۾ پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ تريل ڪاجو سان مليل. 4 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.720281a9dc26.back: Pasupu Annam. Pasupu Annam, Andhra's turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed in a tempering of mustard, chana dal and curry leaves with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: پسوپو انّم: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ ننڍو چمچو پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر
seg.ed1a4a430aee.back: ½ small spoon hill turmeric powder

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: راگي جاوا راگيءَ جي اٽي جي پاڻيءَ ۾ پچايل پتلي رٻ آهي، جيڪا آنڌرا ۽ رايلسيما جي ڪيترن گهرن ۾ روزانو پيئبي آهي. لوڻياٺي قسم لسيءَ سان ٺهي ٿي؛ هيءَ مٺي کير سان پتلي ڪري ڳڙ سان مٺي ڪئي وڃي ٿي، ۽ نيرن يا شام جو اسٽيل جي ٽمبلر مان ڪوسي پيئبي آهي.
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi Java is a thin porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, which is drunk daily in many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty kind is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is thinned with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and is drunk lukewarm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: اسان جو تاٽي بيلّم تاڙ جو ڳڙ راگيءَ جي مٽيءَ جهڙي ذائقي سان ٺهي ٿو ۽ جاوا کي ٽافي جهڙو ناسي رنگ ڏئي ٿو. شروع کان آخر تائين لڳ ڀڳ 15 منٽ لڳن ٿا. هيءَ ترڪيب 2 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery goes with the earth-like taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. From start to end it takes about 15 minutes. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: ڪل وقت ۾ ڳڙ وجهڻ کان اڳ 2 منٽ رکڻ شامل آهي.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: The total time includes keeping 2 minutes before adding the jaggery.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: راگيءَ جو اٽو پاڻيءَ ۾ ڦيڻيو، اٻرندڙ پاڻيءَ ۾ ٿلهو ۽ چمڪدار ٿيڻ تائين پچايو، پوءِ کير وجهو. باهه کان پري تاڙ جو ڳڙ ۽ الائچي ملايو.
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Whisk the ragi flour in water, cook in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add milk. Away from the fire mix in palm jaggery and cardamom.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ ڪپ راگيءَ جو اٽو ⟦1⟧فنگر مليٽ جو اٽو، لڳ ڀڳ 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 ڪپ پاڻي ⟦1⟧1 ڪپ اٽو ملائڻ لاءِ، 1 ڪپ اٻارڻ لاءِ⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup for mixing the flour, 1 cup for boiling⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 30 g؛ وڌيڪ مٺو وڻي ته هڪ چمچو ٻيو⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 big spoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; if you like it sweeter one more spoon⟦/1⟧

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.t: راگيءَ جو اٽو هڪ پيالي ۾ وجهو.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: راگيءَ جو اٽو 1 ڪپ پاڻيءَ ۾ سنئون ٿيڻ تائين ڦيڻيو، ڪا ڳنڍ نه رهي. ڦيڻڻي يا ڪانٽو استعمال ڪريو ۽ ڳنڍيون پيالي جي پاسي تي ڀڃو.
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk the ragi flour in 1 cup water until smooth, no lump should remain. Use a whisk or fork and break the lumps on the side of the bowl.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: باقي 1 ڪپ پاڻي ڳري تري واري پين ۾ وجهو ۽ وچولي باهه تي رکو.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Put the remaining 1 cup water in a heavy-bottomed pan and keep on medium fire.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: ٻيو ڪپ پاڻي اٻاريو، راگي وجهو ۽ هلڪي باهه تي ٿلهو ۽ چمڪدار ٿيڻ تائين هلايو، 6–8 منٽ. وجهڻ کان اڳ مصالحو هڪ دفعو ٻيهر هلايو، ڇو ته اٽو پيالي جي تري ۾ ويهي ٿو.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the second cup of water, add the ragi and stir on low fire until thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Before adding stir the mixture once more, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: لڳاتار هلائيندا رهو. جاوا تڏهن پچي آهي جڏهن ڦڪي گلابي-ناسي مان گهري، چمڪدار ناسي ٿئي ۽ چمچي جي پٺيءَ تي چڙهي.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring continuously. The java is cooked when from a pale pink-brown it becomes a deep, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: کير وجهو ۽ 2 منٽ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو. باهه بند ڪري 2 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو. پچڻ دوران هڪ ٻه دفعا هلايو ته تري ۾ نه چنبڙي.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add the milk and cook 2 minutes on low fire. Turn off the fire and leave 2 minutes. While cooking stir once or twice so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: جيستائين جاوا رکي، تاڙ جو ڳڙ سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو ته جلدي ڳري.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java rests, grate the palm jaggery finely so it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ ۽ الائچي ملايو. ڪوسي پيش ڪريو. ڳڙ پوري طرح ڳرڻ تائين هلايو، پوءِ چکو ۽ ضرورت هجي ته ٿورو ٻيو وجهو.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Mix in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve lukewarm. Stir until the jaggery melts fully, then taste and if needed add a little more.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: ٽمبلرن يا پيالن ۾ وجهو. پيئڻ لاءِ گهڻي ٿلهي هجي ته ڪجهه چمچا ڪوسو کير ملايو.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into tumblers or cups. If too thick for drinking mix in a few spoons of lukewarm milk.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: هميشه راگيءَ جو اٽو پهريان پاڻيءَ ۾ ملايو؛ سڌو اٻرندڙ پاڻيءَ ۾ وڌل اٽو اهڙيون ڳنڍيون ٺاهي ٿو جيڪي نٿيون ٽٽن.
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always mix the ragi flour into water first; flour added directly to boiling water makes lumps that do not break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: پچائڻ ۾ جلدي نه ڪريو؛ اڌ پچيل راگي ڪچي ۽ اٽي جهڙي لڳي ٿي.
seg.966098732312.back: Do not hurry the cooking; half-cooked ragi tastes raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: ٽمبلر مان پيئڻ لاءِ پتلي جاوا لاءِ 2 وڏا چمچا راگيءَ جو اٽو وجهو؛ چمچي سان کائڻ واري رٻ لاءِ ⅓ ڪپ.
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: For a thin java to drink from a tumbler add 2 big spoons ragi flour; for a porridge to eat with a spoon ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: سُڪن ميون سان: آخر ۾ ڪجهه ڪٽيل ڪاجو يا بادام ۽ هڪ چمچو ڪشمش ملايو.
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With dry fruits: at the end mix in some cut cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: کير کان سواءِ: راگي 2½ ڪپ پاڻيءَ ۾ پچايو ۽ ٻُڙٻُڙ بند ٿئي ته ڳڙ ملايو، پتلي ۽ گهري جاوا لاءِ.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and when the bubbling stops mix in jaggery, for a thinner and deeper java.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: نيرن لاءِ اسٽيل جي ٽمبلر يا پيالي ۾ ڪوسي پيش ڪريو، يا شام جو مشروب طور ڪجهه بسڪيٽن يا مُرُڪلو سان. ڪجهه ماڻهو اونهاري ۾ ٿڌي پسند ڪن ٿا.
seg.639ea388ead3.back: For breakfast serve lukewarm in a steel tumbler or cup, or as an evening drink with some biscuits or murukulu. Some people like it cold in summer.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: جنهن ڏينهن ٺهي ان ڏينهن پيئڻ سڀ کان سٺو. بچيل فرج ۾ ڍڪي 1 ڏينهن تائين رکو ۽ ٻيهر گرم ڪرڻ وقت باهه کان پري ٿورو ڪوسو کير ملايو.
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Drinking it the day it is made is best. Keep leftover covered in the fridge up to 1 day and when reheating mix in a little lukewarm milk away from the fire.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: ڳنڍين کان سواءِ راگي جاوا ڪيئن ٺاهجي؟
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How to make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: پهريان راگيءَ جو اٽو ڪمري جي گرميءَ واري پاڻيءَ ۾ سنئون ٿيڻ تائين ڦيڻيو، پوءِ لڳاتار هلائيندي اٻرندڙ پاڻيءَ ۾ وجهو.
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk the ragi flour in room-temperature water until smooth, then add into boiling water while stirring continuously.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: ڪيئن خبر پوي ته راگي جاوا پچي وئي آهي؟
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How to know that the ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: اها گهري ۽ چمڪدار ٿئي ٿي، ايتري ٿلهي ٿئي ٿي جو چمچي جي پٺيءَ تي چڙهي، ۽ اٽي جهڙو ذائقو نٿو رهي. هلڪي باهه تي لڳ ڀڳ 6–8 منٽ لڳن ٿا.
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes deep and glossy, becomes so thick that it coats the back of the spoon, and no floury taste remains. On low fire it takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: ڇا راگي جاوا ۾ تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهي سگهجي ٿو؟
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can palm jaggery be added to ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: ها. تاڙ جو ڳڙ (تاٽي بيلّم) سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو ۽ چُلهه بند ڪرڻ کان پوءِ ملايو، ته کير نه ڦاٽي. اهو گهرو رنگ ۽ ٿوري دونهين جهڙي مٺاڻ ڏئي ٿو.
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Grate palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and mix in after turning off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deep colour and slightly smoke-like sweetness.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: راگي جاوا ۽ راگي مالٽ ۾ ڪهڙو فرق آهي؟
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: اهو ساڳيو مشروب آهي، نالا مختلف. راگي جاوا تيلگو نالو آهي؛ دڪانن ۽ مينيو ۾ ان کي اڪثر راگي مالٽ چيو ويندو آهي.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: It is the same drink, different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; in shops and menus it is often called ragi malt.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: راگي جاوا · مٺي راگي جاوا جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: Ragi Java · sweet ragi java recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: راگي جاوا. آنڌرا واري طريقي سان مٺي راگي جاوا: راگيءَ جو اٽو پاڻيءَ ۾ چمڪدار ٿيڻ تائين پچايل، کير سان پتلو ۽ تاٽي بيلّم تاڙ جي ڳڙ سان مٺو ڪيل. طريقو ۽ صلاحون.
seg.708e3c523d72.back: Ragi Java. Sweet ragi java the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: راگي جاوا: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.8ee2205b2e8b.t: 3 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: اِگورو آنڌرا جو اهو طريقو آهي جنهن ۾ گوشت يا جهينگا ٿلهي بصر واري مصالحي ۾ لڳ ڀڳ سُڪي ٿيڻ تائين پچايا ويندا آهن، ته مصالحا هر ٽڪري سان چنبڙي وڃن. رويّالا اِگورو ساحلي ضلعن جو کاڌو آهي، نيلور کان گوداوري ۽ سري ڪاڪولم تائين، جتي پٺتي پاڻين ۽ سمنڊ جا جهينگا آچر جي منجهند چانورن سان کائبا آهن.
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is that Andhra method in which meat or prawns are cooked in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices stick to every piece. Royyala Iguru is a dish of the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari and Srikakulam, where prawns of the backwaters and sea are eaten with rice on Sunday afternoon.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: اسان جو پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر (ڪونڊا پسوپو) پهريان جهينگن تي ۽ پوءِ مصالحي ۾ پوي ٿو. تيجا مرچ پائوڊر اهو گهرو ڳاڙهو رنگ ۽ سخت تکاڻ آڻي ٿو جيڪا ساحلي گهر پسند ڪن ٿا، تنهنڪري ان کي پنهنجي دسترخوان موجب گهٽ وڌ ڪريو.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) goes first on the prawns and then into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings that deep red colour and strong heat which coastal homes like, so adjust it up or down according to your own dining table.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: تياريءَ ۾ جهينگا صاف ڪرڻ ۽ هيڊ سان 10 منٽ رکڻ شامل آهي.
seg.885826f68de3.back: The preparation includes cleaning the prawns and keeping them 10 minutes with turmeric.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: جهينگن تي هيڊ ۽ لوڻ مکيو. بصر ۽ ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ تريو، تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ۽ ڌاڻا پائوڊر وجهو، پوءِ جهينگن کي مصالحي ۾ ايستائين پچايو جو مصالحو انهن تي چڙهي وڃي.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt on the prawns. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala coats them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g جهينگا ⟦1⟧وچولي سائيز جا، کل لاٿل ۽ ڪاري رڳ ڪڍيل، صاف ڪرڻ کان پوءِ توريل⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shell removed and black vein taken out, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ ننڍو چمچو لوڻ ⟦1⟧ٻن حصن ۾، يا ذائقي موجب⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ small spoon salt ⟦1⟧in two parts, or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.8c4c1b789de7.t: 3 وڏا چمچا تيل ⟦1⟧عام طور مونگ پَليءَ جو تيل⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ ننڍو چمچو پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧ڪونڊا پسوپو؛ ¼ ننڍو چمچو جهينگن لاءِ، ¼ ننڍو چمچو مصالحي لاءِ⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ small spoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ small spoon for the prawns, ¼ small spoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ ننڍا چمچا تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧تمام تکو؛ وچولي تکاڻ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو، هلڪي لاءِ ½ ننڍو چمچو⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ small spoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat 1 small spoon, for mild ½ small spoon⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: جهينگن جي کل لاهيو ۽ ڪاري رڳ ڪڍو، چڱيءَ طرح ڌوئو ۽ ڇاڻيءَ ۾ پاڻي نچوڙيو.
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the shell of the prawns and take out the black vein, wash well and squeeze the water out in a strainer.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: جهينگن تي اڌ هيڊ ۽ ٿورو لوڻ مکيو؛ 10 منٽ پاسي تي رکو. ¼ ننڍو چمچو هيڊ ۽ ¼ ننڍو چمچو لوڻ وٺو.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt on the prawns; keep aside 10 minutes. Take ¼ small spoon turmeric and ¼ small spoon salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: ڳري ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وچولي باهه تي تيل گرم ڪريو ۽ رائي وجهو. جڏهن تڙڪي، ته ساوا مرچ ۽ ڪڙي پتا وجهو.
seg.9e027c56020d.back: Heat oil in a heavy kadhai on medium fire and add mustard. When it crackles, add green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: بصر تيل ۾ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو، پوءِ ادرڪ-ٿوم جي پيسٽ ايستائين جو پچيل خوشبو اچي. بصرن ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 8–10 منٽ لڳن ٿا؛ پيسٽ ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 1 منٽ، جيستائين ڪچي بوءِ وڃي.
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry the onions in oil until golden, then the ginger-garlic paste until a cooked aroma comes. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: جيڪڏهن ٽماٽو وجهو ٿا، ته هاڻي وجهو ۽ نرم ۽ ڳريل ٿيڻ تائين پچايو، لڳ ڀڳ 4 منٽ.
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If you are adding tomato, add it now and cook until soft and melted, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: باهه هلڪي ڪريو. باقي هيڊ، تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ۽ ڌاڻا پائوڊر وجهو؛ 1 منٽ تريو. باقي لوڻ وجهو ۽ هلايو ته مصالحا تري ۾ نه چنبڙن.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Lower the fire. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: پاڻي وجهو ۽ مصالحي کي وچولي باهه تي ايستائين پچايو جو ڪنارن تي تيل الڳ ٿيڻ لڳي، لڳ ڀڳ 3–4 منٽ.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Add water and cook the masala on medium fire until oil begins to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: جهينگا وجهو ۽ ڪُنڊ ٿيڻ ۽ گلابي ٿيڻ تائين پچايو، 5–6 منٽ. آخر ۾ گرم مصالحو وجهو. وچولي-تيز باهه تي گهڻو هلايو ته مصالحو سُڪي ۽ جهينگن تي چڙهي.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook until they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. At the end add garam masala. On medium-high fire stir a lot so the masala dries and coats the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: پچڻ جي جانچ ڪريو: جهينگا تڏهن پچيل آهن جڏهن اندر تائين گلابي ٿي وڃن ۽ آرپار نظر نه اچن، ۽ ڍلي C جي شڪل ۾ ڪُنڊ ٿي وڃن. پڪ نه هجي ته هڪ کي ڪٽي ڏسو؛ وچ ۾ ڪو ڀورو، آرپار نظر ايندڙ حصو نه هجي.
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check doneness: the prawns are cooked when they turn pink all the way inside and are not see-through, and curl into a loose C shape. If unsure, cut one and look; there should be no grey, see-through part in the centre.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: لوڻ چکو، ساوا ڌاڻا ڇڻڪيو ۽ باهه بند ڪريو. جهينگا پچڻ کان پوءِ پچائيندا نه رهو، نه ته رٻڙ جهڙا ٿي ويندا.
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste the salt, sprinkle green coriander and turn off the fire. After the prawns are cooked do not keep cooking, otherwise they will become rubber-like.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: تيجا تمام تکو آهي: 1½ ننڍا چمچا اهڙو تکو اِگورو ٺاهين ٿا جهڙو ساحلي گهر پسند ڪن ٿا؛ وچولي تکاڻ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو، يا هلڪي لاءِ ½ ننڍو چمچو وجهو.
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: 1½ small spoons make an iguru as hot as coastal homes like; for medium heat add 1 small spoon, or for mild ½ small spoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: بصر چڱيءَ طرح سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو؛ اِگورو جو رنگ ۽ ٿولهه چڱن ناسي بصرن مان اچي ٿي.
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the onions well until golden; the iguru's colour and thickness come from well-browned onions.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: جهينگا جلدي پچن ٿا. ڍلي C شڪل جو مطلب تيار؛ سخت O جو مطلب گهڻا پچيل ۽ چٻاٽيدار.
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. A loose C shape means ready; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: ڌوئڻ کان پوءِ جهينگا دٻائي سُڪا ڪريو ته پاڻيءَ ۾ ٻاڦ ٿيڻ بدران مصالحي ۾ ترجن.
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing press the prawns dry so that instead of steaming in water they fry in the masala.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: گونگورا رويّالو: جهينگن سان ½ ڪپ گونگورا پتا، ٿوري تيل ۾ مُرجهايل ۽ چِٿيل، ملايو.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura Royyalu: mix with the prawns ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted and mashed in a little oil.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: ناريل: نرم ۽ ڀريل مصالحي لاءِ آخري 2 منٽن ۾ 2 وڏا چمچا ڪدوڪش ٿيل ناريل يا 3 وڏا چمچا ٿلهو ناريل جو کير وجهو.
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a soft and fuller masala in the last 2 minutes add 2 big spoons grated coconut or 3 big spoons thick coconut milk.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: شوربي وارو طريقو: چانورن مٿان وجهڻ لاءِ پتلي رويّالا ڪورا لاءِ جهينگن کان پوءِ ¾ ڪپ پاڻي وجهو.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: Gravy way: for a thinner royyala kura for pouring over rice add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: گرم پيش ڪريو ٻاڦ ۾ پچيل چانورن ۽ هڪ چمچي گيهه سان، يا رسم يا سانڀر چانورن سان. چپاتيءَ سان به سٺو لڳي ٿو.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: بچيل فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 1 ڏينهن اندر کائو. پين ۾ هلڪي باهه تي گرم ڪريو؛ گهڻي دير ٻيهر گرم ڪرڻ سان جهينگا سخت ٿي وڃن ٿا.
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Keep leftover covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan on low fire; reheating too long makes the prawns hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.t: ڪيئن خبر پوي ته جهينگا پچي ويا آهن؟
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How to know that the prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: اهي اندر تائين گلابي ٿي وڃن ٿا ۽ آرپار نظر نٿا اچن، ۽ ڍلي C جي شڪل ۾ ڪُنڊ ٿي وڃن ٿا، عام طور گرم مصالحي ۾ 5–6 منٽن ۾. وچ ۾ ڀورو، آرپار نظر ايندڙ حصو هجي ته ٿورو وڌيڪ پچائڻ گهرجي.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They turn pink all the way inside and are not see-through, and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. If there is a grey, see-through part in the centre, cook a little longer.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: اِگورو بصر جي مصالحي ۾ ٿلهو ۽ لڳ ڀڳ سُڪو ٿيڻ تائين پچايو ويندو آهي، مصالحو جهينگن سان چنبڙيل. ويپوڊو تريل ڀاڄي آهي، جنهن ۾ بصر جو شوربو گهٽ يا بلڪل نه، جهينگا ڪنارن تان ڪُرڪُرا ٿيڻ تائين پچايا وڃن ٿا.
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, the masala sticking to the prawns. Vepudu is a fried dish, in which with little or no onion gravy the prawns are cooked until crisp at the edges.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: رويّالا اِگورو گهٽ تکو ڪيئن ٺاهجي؟
seg.d248a2970455.back: How to make Royyala Iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: وچولي تکاڻ لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر يا هلڪي لاءِ ½ ننڍو چمچو وجهو، ۽ ساوا مرچ نه وجهو. آخر ۾ هڪ وڏو چمچو ڏهي يا ناريل جو کير به تکاڻ نرم ڪري ٿو.
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: For medium heat add 1 small spoon Teja chilli powder or for mild ½ small spoon, and do not add green chillies. At the end a big spoon of curd or coconut milk also softens the heat.

seg.d024c66a11b8.t: ڇا ڄميل جهينگا استعمال ڪري سگهجن ٿا؟

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: ها. انهن کي فرج ۾ ڳارڻ ڏيو، چڱيءَ طرح پاڻي ڪڍو ۽ هيڊ ۽ لوڻ مکڻ کان اڳ دٻائي سُڪا ڪريو. ڄميل جهينگا وڌيڪ پاڻي ڇڏين ٿا، تنهنڪري مصالحو ٿورو وڌيڪ پچايو.
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Let them thaw in the fridge, drain the water well and press dry before rubbing turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little more.

seg.3120e29b987a.t: رويّالا اِگورو · رويّالا اِگورو جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: رويّالا اِگورو. رويّالا اِگورو، ساحلي آنڌرا جو جهينگن جو روسٽ: پهاڙي هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ تکي تيجا مرچ پائوڊر سان بصر جي مصالحي ۾ پچايل جهينگا. 4 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: Royyala Iguru. Royyala Iguru, coastal Andhra's prawn roast: prawns cooked in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and hot Teja chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: رويّالا اِگورو: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.231bf528146c.t: سنّنڊلو ⟦1⟧(ماش جي دال ۽ ڳڙ جا لڏو)⟦/1⟧

seg.26454413942e.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · سنّنڊلو · ماش جي دال جا لڏو

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: سنّنڊلو آنڌرا جا ماش جي دال جا لڏو آهن: ڌوتل ماش جي دال ميوي جهڙي خوشبو اچڻ تائين ڀُڃي، ڳڙ سان سنهي پيهي، گرم گيهه سان دٻائي گڏ ڪئي ويندي آهي. چاشني پچائڻ جي ضرورت ناهي، تنهنڪري لڳ ڀڳ اڌ ڪلاڪ ۾ ٺهي وڃن ٿا. آنڌرا جا گهر سنڪرانتي ۽ ديواليءَ لاءِ هڪ ڊٻو ٺاهيندا آهن، پرديس ويندڙ مٽن مائٽن لاءِ ٻڌندا آهن، ۽ شام جو چانهه سان مٺائيءَ لاءِ رکندا آهن.
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu are Andhra's urad dal laddus: washed urad dal is roasted until a fruit-like aroma comes, ground fine with jaggery, and pressed together with hot ghee. No need to cook a syrup, so they get made in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a box for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives going abroad, and keep them for sweets with tea in the evening.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: اسان جو تاٽي بيلّم تاڙ جو ڳڙ سنّنڊلو کي گهرو ناسي رنگ ۽ ڀريل، ٿوري دونهين جهڙي مٺاڻ ڏئي ٿو جيڪا ڀُڳل دال سان ٺهي ٿي. هيءَ ترڪيب لڳ ڀڳ 15 لڏو ٺاهي ٿي.
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a full, slightly smoke-like sweetness that goes with the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: ڪل وقت ۾ پيهڻ کان اڳ ڀُڳل دال کي ٿڌو ڪرڻ شامل آهي.
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: The total time includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: ماش جي دال سونهري ٿيڻ تائين ڀُڃيو، ٿڌي ڪري سنهي پيهيو، پوءِ تاڙ جو ڳڙ ۽ الائچي پيهي ملايو. گرم گيهه سان ملائي لڏن جي شڪل ڏيو.
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast the urad dal until golden, cool and grind fine, then grind and mix in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 ڪپ اڇي ماش جي دال ⟦1⟧ڌوتل، کل کان سواءِ (مناپپّو)، لڳ ڀڳ 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧washed, without skin (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 180 g، هلڪو دٻائي ماپيل؛ ٽڪرا پهريان ڪُٽيو يا ڪدوڪش ڪريو⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, measured lightly pressed; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ ڪپ گيهه ⟦1⟧ڳاريل ۽ گرم؛ 1–2 وڏا چمچا وڌيڪ هٿ ۾ رکو⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 big spoons more at hand⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: ماش جي دال مان ننڍا پٿر چونڊي ڪڍو. ان کي نه ڌوئو؛ ڀُڃڻ لاءِ سُڪي رهڻ گهرجي.
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick small stones out of the urad dal. Do not wash it; for roasting it must stay dry.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: دال ڳري پين ۾ هلڪي باهه تي رکو.
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Keep the dal in a heavy pan on low fire.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: ماش جي دال هلڪي باهه تي سونهري ۽ ميوي جهڙي خوشبو اچڻ تائين سُڪي ڀُڃيو، لڳ ڀڳ 10 منٽ. لڳاتار هلائيندا رهو ته هر داڻو هڪجيترو رنگ وٺي؛ سيڪيل خوشبو اچي ۽ داڻو چٻاڙڻ تي ڪڙڪي.
seg.65588a76c883.back: Dry-roast the urad dal on low fire until golden and a fruit-like aroma comes, about 10 minutes. Keep stirring continuously so every grain takes an even colour; a toasted aroma should come and a grain should crack when chewed.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: دال ٿالهيءَ ۾ لاهي پکيڙيو. ٿڌي ڪريو، پوءِ سنهي پائوڊر ۾ پيهيو. ننڍن جهٽڪن ۾ پيهيو ته مڪسر گرم نه ٿئي، ۽ ٿلها ٽڪرا ڇاڻي ٻيهر پيهيو.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Take the dal onto a plate and spread. Cool, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short pulses so the mixer does not get hot, and sieve the coarse bits and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو، يا ٽڪرا اُکريءَ ۾ ڪُٽيو، سخت ڳنڍيون ڀڃي ڇڏيو.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking the hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: مڪسر جي جار ۾ دال جي پائوڊر ۾ ڳڙ ۽ الائچي پائوڊر وجهو. ڳڙ ۽ الائچيءَ کي هڪجيترو ملڻ تائين پيهيو. ڪجهه جهٽڪا ڪافي آهن؛ سڀ ڪجهه ويڪري پيالي ۾ لاهيو.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: In the mixer jar add jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder. Grind until the jaggery and cardamom mix evenly. A few pulses are enough; take everything out into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: ننڍي پين ۾ گيهه ايترو ڳاريو جو گرم ٿئي پر دونهون نه ڪري.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: Melt the ghee in a small pan so it is hot but does not smoke.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: گرم گيهه وجهو، چڱيءَ طرح ملايو ۽ ننڍا گولا دٻائي ٺاهيو. پهريان گهڻو گيهه وجهو، چمچي سان ملايو، پوءِ هٿ لڳائڻ جيترو ٿڌو ٿئي ته هٿن سان ملايو.
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Add the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. First add most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then when it is cool enough to touch mix with the hands.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: ننڍي مُٺ کڻو ۽ مُٺ ۾ سختيءَ سان دٻايو، پوءِ ترين جي وچ ۾ گول ڦيرايو. جيڪڏهن ڀُرڪي، ته پيالي ۾ هڪ چمچو ٻيو گرم گيهه وجهي ملايو.
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a small fistful and press it hard in the fist, then roll round between the palms. If it crumbles, add one more spoon of hot ghee to the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: رکڻ کان اڳ لڏن کي ٿالهيءَ ۾ 15–20 منٽ سخت ٿيڻ ڏيو.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Before storing let the laddus become firm on a plate for 15–20 minutes.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: دال هلڪي باهه تي ڀُڃيو ته سڙڻ کان سواءِ اندر تائين پچي.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast the dal on low fire so it cooks right to the inside without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: دال پوري طرح ٿڌي ٿيڻ کان پوءِ ئي پيهيو؛ ڪوسي دال مڪسر ۾ پيسٽ ٿي وڃي ٿي.
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only after it cools fully; lukewarm dal becomes paste in the mixer.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
