seg.33701abc66f0.t: مصالحو اڃا ڪوسو هجي ته لڏن جي شڪل ڏيو؛ گيهه جي گرميءَ سان سڀ کان سٺو جُڙي ٿو.
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Shape into laddus while the mixture is still lukewarm; with the heat of the ghee it binds best.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: تاڙ جي ڳڙ جا ٽڪرا سختيءَ ۾ مختلف هوندا آهن، تنهنڪري مڪسر ۾ وجهڻ کان اڳ ڪدوڪش ڪريو يا ڪُٽي ننڍا ڪريو.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: Pieces of palm jaggery vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before putting in the mixer.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ: اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ وجهو، رنگ هلڪو ۽ مٺاڻ ڪيريمل جهڙي ٿيندي.
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: add the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery, the colour will be lighter and the sweetness caramel-like.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: کل سان: ڪاري ڌوتل ماش جي دال کل سميت وٺو، وڌيڪ گهرن ۽ داڻيدار سنّنڊلو لاءِ، جيئن ڪجهه ڳوٺاڻا گهر ٺاهين ٿا.
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: take black urad dal with its skin, for darker and grainy sunnundalu, as some village homes make.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: کنڊ سان: ڳڙ بدران ¾ ڪپ پيٺل کنڊ وجهو، هلڪي رنگ ۽ وات ۾ ڳرندڙ لڏن لاءِ.
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: instead of jaggery add ¾ cup ground sugar, for laddus that are light in colour and melt in the mouth.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: شام جو چانهه يا ڪافيءَ سان مٺائيءَ طور پيش ڪريو، يا سنڪرانتي ۽ ديواليءَ جي مٺائيءَ واري ٿالهيءَ ۾.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as a sweet in the evening with tea or coffee, or in the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: هوا بند اسٽيل جي ڊٻي ۾ ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي رکو ۽ 2 هفتن اندر کائو. گرم موسم ۾ فرج ۾ وڌيڪ رهن ٿا؛ کائڻ کان اڳ ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي اچڻ ڏيو.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel box at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In hot weather they last longer in the fridge; before eating let them come to room temperature.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.t: منهنجا سنّنڊلو شڪل ڇو نٿا رکن؟
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why do my sunnundalu not hold shape?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: مصالحي کي وڌيڪ گرم گيهه گهرجي، يا اهو ٿڌو ٿي ويو آهي. هڪ ٻه چمچا گيهه گرم ڪري ملايو ۽ مصالحو ڪوسو هجي تڏهن لڏو ٺاهيو.
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has become cold. Heat one or two spoons of ghee and mix in and make the laddus while the mixture is lukewarm.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.t: ڇا تاڙ جي ڳڙ سان سنّنڊلو ٺاهي سگهجن ٿا؟
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can sunnundalu be made with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: ها. تاڙ جو ڳڙ (تاٽي بيلّم) سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو يا ڪُٽيو ۽ ڪمند جي ڳڙ جيترو ئي وجهو. لڏو گهرا ٿين ٿا ۽ ذائقو گهرو ۽ ٿورو دونهين جهڙو.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Grate or pound palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and add the same amount as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus become darker and the taste deep and slightly smoke-like.

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي هوا بند ڊٻي ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 2 هفتا، ۽ فرج ۾ وڌيڪ. ڪڍڻ لاءِ سُڪو چمچو يا سُڪا هٿ استعمال ڪريو.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: At room temperature in an airtight box about 2 weeks, and longer in the fridge. To take out use a dry spoon or dry hands.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: ماش جي دال کل سان وٺجي يا کل کان سواءِ؟
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should urad dal be taken with skin or without skin?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: آنڌرا ۾ ٻئي ٺهن ٿا. اڇي، کل کان سواءِ ماش جي دال سنوان، هلڪا ناسي لڏو ڏئي ٿي؛ کل واري ڪاري ماش جي دال گهرا ۽ داڻيدار.
seg.b12320430e22.back: In Andhra both are made. White, skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives dark and grainy ones.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: سنّنڊلو. آنڌرا جا سنّنڊلو: ڀُڳل ماش جي دال تاٽي بيلّم تاڙ جي ڳڙ سان پيٺل ۽ گرم گيهه سان لڏن ۾ جُڙيل. قدم بقدم طريقو، صلاحون ۽ سوال جواب.
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: Sunnundalu. Andhra's sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound into laddus with hot ghee. Step by step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.9357798f39be.t: سنّنڊلو (ماش جي دال ۽ ڳڙ جا لڏو) · 1acrefarms

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: سنّنڊلو: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.7940a19ab961.t: 1 ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: ٽماٽا پچّڙي آنڌرا جي رڌڻن جي روزاني چٽڻي آهي: پڪل ٽماٽا ڀُڳل دالين سان تيل ۾ ڳاري، پوءِ مرچ، ٿوم ۽ ٿوري املي سان ٿلها پيٺا ويندا آهن. ڪيترا گهر اڃا به ان کي پٿر جي روٽيءَ ۾ پيهن ٿا ته کهري، چمچي سان کائڻ جهڙي ٿئي، جيتوڻيڪ ننڍن جهٽڪن سان مڪسر به ڪم ڪري ٿو. اها گرم چانورن ۽ گيهه، ڊوسا، اِڊلي ۽ پيسرٽّو سان کائبي آهي.
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato Pachadi is the daily chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes are melted in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it on a stone slab so it is rough, spoonable, although a mixer with short pulses also works. It is eaten with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: اسان جو سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ان کي گهرو ڳاڙهو رنگ ۽ هڪجيتري، وچولي تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو، ۽ ٽماٽن سان ٿورو هيڊ پائوڊر پوي ٿو. هيءَ ترڪيب لڳ ڀڳ 1½ ڪپ ٺاهي ٿي.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and an even, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: ڪل وقت ۾ پيهڻ کان اڳ ٽماٽن کي ٿڌو ٿيڻ جا 5 منٽ شامل آهن.
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: The total time includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: داليون ۽ ميٿي تيل ۾ تريو، ٽماٽا هيڊ ۽ لوڻ سان ڳاري پچايو، پوءِ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر، ٿوم ۽ املي سان ٿلها پيهيو. آخر ۾ رائي ۽ ڪڙي پتن جو تڙڪو ڏيو.
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry dals and fenugreek in oil, cook the tomatoes melted with turmeric and salt, then grind coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 وڏا چمچا تيل ⟦1⟧مونگ پَليءَ يا ترن جو تيل⟦/1⟧
seg.4171dd59d18a.back: 2 big spoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut or sesame oil⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ ننڍو چمچو ميٿي جا داڻا ⟦1⟧ميٿي؛ هن کان وڌيڪ نه، نه ته پچّڙي ڪڙي ٿيندي⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ small spoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧methi; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi will be bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 وچولا ٽماٽا ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 500 g، پڪل ۽ ڳاڙها، ڪٽيل⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, cut⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 ننڍا چمچا سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧وڌيڪ تکي پچّڙيءَ لاءِ 1 وڏي چمچي تائين⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 small spoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧for a hotter pachadi up to 1 big spoon⟦/1⟧

seg.f7c3bb463ff4.t: ٻير جيڏي املي ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 5 g، ٻج ڪڍيل⟦/1⟧

seg.350dec8c6594.t: ½ ننڍو چمچو ماش جي دال

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: ڪڙهائيءَ ۾ وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي 2 وڏا چمچا تيل گرم ڪريو.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 big spoons oil in a kadhai on medium-low fire.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: ماش جي دال، چڻن جي دال ۽ ميٿي تيل ۾ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو؛ ڪڍي رکو. ان ۾ 2–3 منٽ لڳن ٿا؛ لڳاتار هلايو، ڇو ته ميٿي جلدي سڙي ڪڙي ٿي وڃي ٿي.
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in the oil until golden; take out and keep. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir continuously, because fenugreek quickly burns and turns bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: ساڳئي تيل ۾ ڪٽيل ٽماٽا وجهو ۽ وچولي باهه تي هڪ منٽ هلايو.
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In the same oil add the cut tomatoes and stir one minute on medium fire.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: ٽماٽن کي هيڊ ۽ لوڻ سان نرم ٿيڻ ۽ رس سُڪڻ تائين پچايو. پهريان 5 منٽ ڍڪيو، پوءِ کليل پچايو، وچ وچ ۾ هلايو، ڪل لڳ ڀڳ 12–15 منٽ، جيستائين ٽماٽا ڳري وڃن ۽ ڪنارن تي تيل نظر اچي.
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until soft and the juice dries. First cover 5 minutes, then cook open, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes melt and oil appears at the edges.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: باهه بند ڪريو، املي ملايو ته گرميءَ ۾ نرم ٿئي، ۽ سڀ ڪجهه لڳ ڀڳ 5 منٽ ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Turn off the fire, mix in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: پٿر جي روٽيءَ يا مڪسر جي جار ۾ پهريان تريل داليون ۽ ميٿي ٿلهي پائوڊر ۾ پيهيو.
seg.c1820dcae462.back: On the stone slab or in the mixer jar first grind the fried dals and fenugreek to a coarse powder.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: داليون، ٿوم، املي، مرچ پائوڊر ۽ ٽماٽا ٿلها پيهيو. مڪسر ۾ دال جي پائوڊر ۾ ٿوم، مرچ پائوڊر ۽ پچيل ٽماٽا وجهو ۽ پاڻيءَ کان سواءِ 4–5 جهٽڪا ڏيو؛ داڻيدار هجي تڏهن بند ڪريو. جيڪڏهن وجهو ٿا ته ساوا ڌاڻا ملايو.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarse. In the mixer add garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and give 4–5 pulses without water; stop while it is grainy. If you are adding it mix in green coriander.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: چکو ۽ ٺيڪ ڪريو: هڪ چپٽي وڌيڪ لوڻ، يا وڌيڪ تکي گهرجي ته ٿورو ٻيو مرچ پائوڊر جهٽڪي سان ملايو.
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and adjust: one more pinch of salt, or if hotter is wanted mix in a little more chilli powder with a pulse.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: پچّڙي هڪ پيالي ۾ لاهيو. ننڍي پين ۾ 1 وڏو چمچو تيل گرم ڪريو ۽ رائي وجهو؛ تڙڪي ته ماش جي دال وجهو ۽ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Take the pachadi out into a bowl. Heat 1 big spoon oil in a small pan and add mustard; when it crackles add urad dal and fry until golden.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: ڳاڙها مرچ، هينگ ۽ ڪڙي پتا وجهو ۽ ڪجهه سيڪنڊ هلايو.
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: رائي، ڳاڙهن مرچن ۽ ڪڙي پتن جو تڙڪو ڏيو؛ مٿان وجهو. پيش ڪرڻ کان ٿورو اڳ ملايو.
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Give a tempering of mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour on top. Mix shortly before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: ٽماٽا رس سُڪڻ تائين پچايو ته پچّڙي وڌيڪ عرصو رهي ۽ ڪچي نه لڳي.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook the tomatoes until the juice dries so the pachadi lasts longer and does not taste raw.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: پڪل، گهرا ڳاڙها ٽماٽا سڀ کان سٺو رنگ ڏين ٿا؛ جيڪڏهن توهان جا کٽا هجن ته املي اڌ ڪريو.
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: جهٽڪا ڏيو، مڪسر هلائيندا نه رهو: آنڌرا جا گهر ٿلهي پچّڙي پسند ڪن ٿا، ۽ سنهي پيسٽ اها بناوت وڃائي ٿي.
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Give pulses, do not keep running the mixer: Andhra homes like coarse pachadi, and a fine paste loses that texture.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وچولي تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو. 2 ننڍن چمچن سان شروع ڪريو ۽ چکڻ کان پوءِ وڌايو؛ پچّڙي رکڻ سان تکاڻ ٿوري نرم ٿئي ٿي.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 small spoons and increase after tasting; on keeping the pachadi's heat softens a little.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: ساوو مرچ: مرچ پائوڊر بدران 4–5 ساوا مرچ وجهو، دالين سان تريل.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of chilli powder add 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: بصر-ٽماٽو: ٽماٽا وجهڻ کان اڳ 1 ڪتريل بصر نرم ٿيڻ تائين تريو.
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: before adding the tomatoes fry 1 sliced onion until soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: وڌيڪ تکي: سنّم جي 1 ننڍي چمچي بدران 1 ننڍو چمچو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر وجهو؛ تيجا تمام تکو آهي، تنهنڪري آهستي وڌو.
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: instead of 1 small spoon of Sannam add 1 small spoon Teja chilli powder; Teja is very hot, so increase slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: ٿوم کان سواءِ: ٿوم نه وجهو ۽ تڙڪي ۾ هڪ چپٽي وڌيڪ هينگ وجهو.
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: do not add garlic and add one more pinch of asafoetida in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: گرم چانورن ۾ ٿوري گيهه سان هڪ چمچو ملايو، يا ڊوسا، اِڊلي، پيسرٽّو يا اپما سان پيش ڪريو.
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix a spoon into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: صاف، سُڪي شيشي جي جار ۾ فرج ۾ رکو ۽ 4 ڏينهن اندر کائو. هميشه سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو.
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How to make Andhra tomato pachadi?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: ماش جي دال، چڻن جي دال ۽ ميٿي تيل ۾ تريو، ڪٽيل ٽماٽا هيڊ ۽ لوڻ سان رس سُڪڻ تائين پچايو، پوءِ سڀ ڪجهه مرچ پائوڊر، ٿوم ۽ املي سان ٿلهو پيهيو. آخر ۾ رائي، ڳاڙهن مرچن ۽ ڪڙي پتن جو تڙڪو ڏيو.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook cut tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries, then grind everything coarse with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard, red chillies and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.t: منهنجي ٽماٽا پچّڙي ڪڙي ڇو آهي؟
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: عام طور ميٿي سڙي وئي يا گهڻي هئي. 500 g ٽماٽن لاءِ رڳو ¼ ننڍو چمچو وجهو ۽ وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي تريو، سونهري ٿيندي ئي ڪڍي وٺو.
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Usually the fenugreek burnt or there was too much. For 500 g tomatoes add only ¼ small spoon and fry on medium-low fire, taking it out as soon as it becomes golden.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: ڇا املي کان سواءِ ٽماٽا پچّڙي ٺاهي سگهجي ٿي؟
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can tomato pachadi be made without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: ها، جيڪڏهن ٽماٽا ڪافي کٽا هجن. پچائڻ کان پوءِ چکو؛ پڪل، مٺن ٽماٽن کي توازن لاءِ املي جو ننڍو ٽڪرو گهرجي.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if the tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need a small piece of tamarind for balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.t: ٽماٽا پچّڙي ڪيترو عرصو رهي ٿي؟
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How long does tomato pachadi last?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: فرج ۾ صاف، سُڪي جار ۾ لڳ ڀڳ 4 ڏينهن، بشرطيڪ ٽماٽا چڱيءَ طرح ڳاري پچايل هجن ۽ توهان سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو.
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: In the fridge in a clean, dry jar about 4 days, provided the tomatoes were cooked well melted and you use a dry spoon.

seg.4dbd4103e7fb.t: ٽماٽا پچّڙي · ٽماٽا پچّڙيءَ جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: ٽماٽا پچّڙي. آنڌرا ٽماٽا پچّڙي: هيڊ پائوڊر سان ڳاري پچايل ٽماٽا، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر، ٿوم ۽ املي سان ٿلها پيٺل، پوءِ تڙڪو ڏنل.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: Tomato Pachadi. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked melted with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: ٽماٽا پچّڙي: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.61fc2dbd1394.t: ¼ ننڍو چمچو ميٿي جا داڻا

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: ٽماٽا پپّو آنڌرا جي گهرن جي روزاني دال آهي: تور جي دال (ڪنڊي پپّو) ٽماٽن ۽ ساون مرچن سان نرم پچائي، سنئين چِٿي ۽ آخر ۾ ٿوم جو تڙڪو ڏنو ويندو آهي. اها هفتي جي اڪثر ڏينهن پچندي آهي ۽ گرم چانورن، هڪ چمچي گيهه ۽ پاسي ۾ اپّڊم يا اچار سان کائبي آهي.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato Pappu is the daily dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) is cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and at the end given a garlic tempering. It is cooked on most days of the week and is eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and appadam or pickle on the side.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: اسان جو هيڊ پائوڊر دال سان ڪُڪر ۾ پوي ٿو ۽ ان کي گهرو پيلو رنگ ڏئي ٿو. سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ڳاڙهي جهلڪ ۽ هڪجيتري، وچولي تکاڻ ڏئي ٿو جيڪا کٽي ٽماٽي جي پويان رهي ٿي. هيءَ ترڪيب 4 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder gives a red tinge and an even, medium heat that stays behind the sour tomato. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: ڪل وقت ۾ ڪُڪر جي ٻاڦ نڪرڻ جو وقت شامل آهي.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: The total time includes the time for the cooker's steam to come out.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: تور جي دال ٽماٽن، ساون مرچن ۽ هيڊ پائوڊر سان پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ پچايو، سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ سان چِٿيو، ۽ آخر ۾ ٿوم ۽ رائيءَ جو تڙڪو ڏيو.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Cook toor dal in a pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and at the end give a tempering of garlic and mustard.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ ڪپ تور جي دال ⟦1⟧ڪنڊي پپّو، لڳ ڀڳ 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ ننڍو چمچو هيڊ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧ڪُڪر ۾ پوي ٿو⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ small spoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes into the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو سنّم مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧چِٿڻ کان پوءِ پوي ٿو؛ وڌيڪ تکاڻ لاءِ 2 ننڍن چمچن تائين⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 small spoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; for more heat up to 2 small spoons⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.t: 2½ ڪپ پاڻي ⟦1⟧۽ ٺيڪ ڪرڻ لاءِ ½ ڪپ ٻيو⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧and ½ cup more for adjusting⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 وڏو چمچو املي جو پاڻي (مرضي) ⟦1⟧جيڪڏهن ٽماٽا گهڻا کٽا نه هجن⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 big spoon tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: تور جي دال 2–3 دفعا پاڻي بدلائي ڌوئو ۽ پاڻي ڪڍي ڇڏيو.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal changing water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: دال پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ ٽماٽن، ساون مرچن، بصر ۽ 2½ ڪپ پاڻيءَ سان وجهو.
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: دال کي ٽماٽن، ساون مرچن ۽ هيڊ پائوڊر سان 4 سيٽين تائين پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ پچايو. ڍڪڻ بند ڪرڻ کان اڳ هيڊ پائوڊر پاڻيءَ ۾ ملايو، پوءِ وچولي باهه تي پچايو.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Cook the dal in the pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder up to 4 whistles. Before closing the lid mix the turmeric powder into the water, then cook on medium fire.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: دٻاءُ پاڻمرادو لهڻ ڏيو، لڳ ڀڳ 10 منٽ. دال تڏهن تيار آهي جڏهن داڻو ٻن آڱرين ۾ پوري طرح چِٿجي وڃي.
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure drop by itself, about 10 minutes. The dal is ready when a grain mashes fully between two fingers.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: چڱيءَ طرح چِٿيو؛ مرچ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ وجهو. ڪاٺ جو گهوٽڻو (پپّو گتّي) يا ڏوئيءَ جي پٺي استعمال ڪريو ۽ دال گرم هجي تڏهن چِٿيو، جيستائين ٽماٽا ۽ دال هڪ سنئون مرڪب بڻجي وڃن.
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is hot, until the tomatoes and dal become one smooth mixture.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: ٿورو پاڻي وجهي 5 منٽ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو. وهندڙ ٿولهه لاءِ ½ ڪپ تائين پاڻي، ۽ جيڪڏهن وجهو ٿا ته املي جو پاڻي، وجهو، ۽ باهه هلڪي رکو ته تري ۾ نه چنبڙي.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Add a little water and cook 5 minutes on low fire. For a flowing thickness add up to ½ cup water, and the tamarind water if you are adding it, and keep the fire low so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: لوڻ ۽ کٽاڻ چکو، پوءِ ساوا ڌاڻا ملايو ۽ باهه بند ڪريو.
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste the salt and sourness, then mix in green coriander and turn off the fire.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: ننڍي پين ۾ وچولي باهه تي گيهه گرم ڪريو ۽ رائي وجهو؛ تڙڪڻ ڏيو.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: Heat ghee in a small pan on medium fire and add mustard; let it crackle.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: رائي، زيرو، ٿوم ۽ ڪڙي پتا گيهه ۾ تريو؛ مٿان وجهو. رائيءَ کان پوءِ زيرو، ٿوم ۽ سُڪل ڳاڙها مرچ وجهو ۽ ٿوم سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو، پوءِ ڪڙي پتا ۽ هينگ وجهو، ۽ ڇُڻڪندڙ تڙڪو دال مٿان وجهو.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in ghee; pour on top. After the mustard add cumin, garlic and dried red chillies and fry until the garlic is golden, then add curry leaves and asafoetida, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: 2 منٽ ڍڪيو ته تڙڪو دال کي خوشبو ڏئي، پوءِ هلائي گرم پيش ڪريو.
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Cover 2 minutes so the tempering gives aroma to the dal, then stir and serve hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: سنئين پپّو لاءِ دال گرم هجي تڏهن چِٿيو. ٿڌي ٿيڻ کان پوءِ داڻا ڄمي وڃن ٿا ۽ ڳنڍيون رهن ٿيون.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For smooth pappu mash while the dal is hot. After cooling the grains set and lumps remain.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وچولو تکو آهي. 1 ننڍي چمچي سان شروع ڪريو؛ وڌيڪ تکي پپّو لاءِ 2 ننڍن چمچن تائين.
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 small spoon; for a hotter pappu up to 2 small spoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: پڪل، کٽا ڳوٺاڻا ٽماٽا (ناٽو ٽماٽا) سڀ کان سٺو ذائقو ڏين ٿا؛ هلڪن هائبرڊ ٽماٽن سان املي جو پاڻي وجهو.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour village tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best taste; with mild hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: ڪڙي پتا وجهڻ کان اڳ تڙڪي ۾ ٿوم کي سونهري ٿيڻ ڏيو؛ هلڪي رنگ جو ٿوم ڪچو لڳي ٿو.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Before adding curry leaves let the garlic become golden in the tempering; light-coloured garlic tastes raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: تيجا مرچ پائوڊر: وڌيڪ تکي پپّو لاءِ سنّم بدران ½ ننڍو چمچو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر وجهو. تيجا تمام تکو آهي، تنهنڪري 1 ننڍي چمچي کان وڌيڪ نه وجهو.
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu add ½ small spoon Teja chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not add more than 1 small spoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: پالڪورا ٽماٽا پپّو: چِٿڻ کان پوءِ دال ۾ 2 ڪپ ڪٽيل پالڪ وجهو ۽ 5 منٽ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو.
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura Tomato Pappu: after mashing add 2 cups cut spinach to the dal and cook 5 minutes on low fire.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: پيسراپپّو: پيلي مونگ جي دال سان ٺاهيو ۽ رڳو 2 سيٽيون ڏيو.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make with yellow moong dal and give only 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: گرم پيش ڪريو ٻاڦ ۾ پچيل چانورن، هڪ چمچي گيهه ۽ پاسي ۾ اپّڊم يا آوڪايا سان. چپاتيءَ سان به سٺي لڳي ٿي.
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: بچيل فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 2 ڏينهن اندر کائو. ٿڌي ٿيڻ سان دال ٿلهي ٿئي ٿي؛ پيش ڪرڻ کان اڳ ٿورو گرم پاڻي وجهي چڱيءَ طرح گرم ڪريو.
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Keep leftover covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. On cooling the dal becomes thick; before serving add a little hot water and heat well.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ تور جي دال لاءِ ڪيتريون سيٽيون؟
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: وچولي باهه تي لڳ ڀڳ 4 سيٽيون، پوءِ دٻاءُ پاڻمرادو لهڻ ڏيو. پراڻي دال يا چڱيءَ طرح نه ڌوتل دال کي 5 گهرجن.
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: ٽماٽا پپّو ۽ سانڀر ۾ ڪهڙو فرق آهي؟
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: ٽماٽا پپّو ٿلهي، چِٿيل دال آهي، سادي تڙڪي سان ۽ سانڀر پائوڊر يا ڀاڄين کان سواءِ. سانڀر پتلو هوندو آهي، ان ۾ املي، ڀاڄيون ۽ ڀُڳل مصالحي جو پائوڊر پوي ٿو.
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal, with a simple tempering and without sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thin, in it go tamarind, vegetables and roasted spice powder.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: ڇا پريشر ڪُڪر کان سواءِ ٽماٽا پپّو ٺاهي سگهجي ٿي؟
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can tomato pappu be made without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: ها. دال 30 منٽ پسايو ۽ ڍڪيل ديڳڙيءَ ۾ 3½ ڪپ پاڻيءَ سان لڳ ڀڳ 40–45 منٽ پچايو، وچ وچ ۾ هلايو، جيستائين آسانيءَ سان چِٿجي.
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered pot with 3½ cups water about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: منهنجي ٽماٽا پپّو گهڻي کٽي ڇو آهي؟
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: ڪي ٽماٽا تمام کٽا هوندا آهن. دال ڪجهه منٽ وڌيڪ هلڪي باهه تي پچايو ۽ توازن لاءِ هڪ چپٽي ڳڙ يا هڪ چمچو وڌيڪ چِٿيل دال ملايو.
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Cook the dal a few minutes more on low fire and for balance mix in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon more of mashed dal.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.t: ٽماٽا پپّو · آنڌرا ٽماٽي واري دال جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: Tomato Pappu · Andhra tomato dal recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: ٽماٽا پپّو. آنڌرا ٽماٽي واري دال: تور جي دال ٽماٽن ۽ ساون مرچن، اسان جي هيڊ ۽ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر سان نرم پچايل، ۽ ٿوم جو تڙڪو. 4 ماڻهن لاءِ.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: Tomato Pappu. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: ٽماٽا پپّو: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomato Pappu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.87c5b474feae.t: پوڊي · لڳ ڀڳ ¾ ڪپ ٺهي ٿي

seg.ad6a2d550d34.t: ويلّلّي ڪارم ⟦1⟧(آنڌرا ٿوم ۽ مرچ جو پائوڊر)⟦/1⟧
seg.ad6a2d550d34.back: Vellulli Karam ⟦1⟧(Andhra garlic and chilli powder)⟦/1⟧

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney
seg.9078b361da10.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · ويلّلّي ڪارم · ٿوم جي سُڪي چٽڻي

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: ويلّلّي ڪارم ٿوم ۽ مرچ جي اها پوڊي آهي جيڪا آنڌرا جي دسترخوانن تي رکي ويندي آهي: ڳاڙهي مرچ جو پائوڊر گهڻي ٿوم، ڀُڳل ڌاڻن ۽ زيري ۽ لوڻ سان ڪُٽيل. گيهه سان گرم چانورن جي پهرين لپ ۾ ملائي، يا ٿوري تيل سان اِڊلي ۽ ڊوسا مٿان ڇڻڪي، اها مصروف ڏينهن ۾ جلدي ماني ۽ ٽفن باڪسن جي ضروري شيءِ آهي.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli Karam is that garlic and chilli podi which is kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with lots of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin and salt. Mixed into the first morsel of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is an essential thing for quick meals on busy days and for tiffin boxes.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: اسان جو تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ان کي گهرو ڳاڙهو ۽ تمام تکو ڪري ٿو، جيئن گنٽور جا گهر پسند ڪن ٿا. گهٽ تکاڻ لاءِ اڌ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وجهو.
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, as Guntur homes like. For less heat add half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: ڪل وقت ۾ پيهڻ کان اڳ داڻن ۽ ٿوم کي ٿڌو ڪرڻ شامل آهي.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: The total time includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: ڌاڻا ۽ زيرو ڀُڃيو، پيهيو، پوءِ تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، لوڻ ۽ هلڪي گرم ڪيل ٿوم سان ننڍا جهٽڪا ڏئي ٿلهي پوڊي ٺاهيو. گرم چانورن ۽ گيهه، اِڊلي يا ڊوسا سان کائو.
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast coriander and cumin, grind, then with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic make a coarse podi giving short pulses. Eat with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.3bab3b2ef1a6.t: شيون ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ ¾ ڪپ ٺهي ٿي⟦/1⟧

seg.d5a562316d2a.t: 1 ننڍو چمچو تيل ⟦1⟧مونگ پَليءَ جو تيل⟦/1⟧

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25 ٿوم جون تريون ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ ½ ڪپ، ڇليل؛ اندر جي سنهي کل رهي سگهي ٿي⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can remain⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ ڪپ تيجا مرچ پائوڊر ⟦1⟧تمام تکو؛ گهٽ تکي ڪرڻ لاءِ صلاحون ڏسو⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; to make less hot see the tips⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1 ننڍي ٻير جيڏي املي (مرضي) ⟦1⟧سُڪي، ٻج ڪڍيل⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: گيهه يا تيل ⟦1⟧هر حصي لاءِ 1 ننڍو چمچو⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 small spoon per portion⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: ٿوم ڇليو ۽ ڪپڙي سان تريون دٻائي بلڪل سُڪيون ڪريو؛ ڪو به پاڻي پوڊيءَ جي رکڻ جو عرصو گهٽائي ٿو.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and press the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water reduces the keeping time of the podi.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: ڌاڻا ۽ زيرو خوشبو اچڻ تائين سُڪا ڀُڃيو؛ ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو. ننڍو پين وچولي-هلڪي باهه تي وٺو؛ ان ۾ 1–2 منٽ لڳن ٿا، ۽ ڌاڻا هڪ درجو گهرا ٿين، ناسي نه.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Dry-roast coriander and cumin until aroma comes; let cool. Take a small pan on medium-low fire; it takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should become one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: ٿوم کي 1 ننڍي چمچي تيل ۾ 2 منٽ گرم ڪريو. باهه هلڪي رکو ۽ هلايو؛ تريون ڪنارن تان ٿوريون نرم ٿين پر ناسي نه ٿين. ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Warm the garlic in 1 small spoon oil for 2 minutes. Keep the fire low and stir; the cloves should become a little soft at the edges but not turn brown. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: داڻا پائوڊر ۾ پيهيو، پوءِ مرچ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ سان جهٽڪا ڏيو. جيڪڏهن املي وجهو ٿا ته داڻن سان گڏ وجهو، ته هڪجيتري ڀڄي.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the seeds to powder, then give pulses with chilli powder and salt. If you are adding tamarind add it together with the seeds, so it breaks evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: ٿوم وجهو ۽ ننڍن جهٽڪن سان ٿلهو، آلو پائوڊر ٺاهيو. هر 2–3 جهٽڪن کان پوءِ روڪي جار جي پاسن تان لاهيو، ڇو ته ٿوم پاسن تي چنبڙي ٿو.
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and with short pulses make a coarse, moist powder. After every 2–3 pulses stop and scrape down the sides of the jar, because garlic sticks to the sides.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: پٿر جي اُکريءَ ۾ پهريان داڻا ڪُٽيو، پوءِ ٿوم لوڻ سان، ۽ آخر ۾ مرچ پائوڊر ملايو.
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar first pound the seeds, then garlic with salt, and at the end mix in the chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: ٿوري چانورن ۽ گيهه سان هڪ چپٽي چکو، ۽ ضرورت هجي ته لوڻ وجهو.
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: پوڊي 10 منٽ ٿالهيءَ ۾ پکيڙيو ته ٻاڦ نڪري وڃي، پوءِ صاف، سُڪي جار ۾ ڀريو.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam goes out, then fill into a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: تيجا تمام تکو آهي؛ گهٽ تکي پوڊيءَ لاءِ اڌ سنّم وجهو، يا ساڳئي ٿوم سان مرچ پائوڊر 3 وڏا چمچا ڪريو.
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a less hot podi add half Sannam, or with the same garlic make the chilli powder 3 big spoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: ٿوم چڱيءَ طرح سُڪايو ۽ تيل ۾ گرم ڪريو؛ آلو ٿوم پوڊيءَ کي جلدي خراب ڪري ٿو.
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; wet garlic spoils the podi quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: ننڍا جهٽڪا ڏيو، مڪسر هلائيندا نه رهو: گهڻو هلائيندا ته ٿوم پيسٽ بڻجي ويندو.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Give short pulses, do not keep running the mixer: if you run it a lot the garlic will become paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: هڪ ڪپ گرم چانورن ۾ 1 ننڍو چمچو پوڊي ۽ 1 ننڍو چمچو گيهه ملايو؛ ذائقي موجب گهٽ وڌ ڪريو.
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: Mix 1 small spoon podi and 1 small spoon ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust up or down according to taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: دالين سان: داڻن سان گڏ 1 وڏو چمچو چڻن جي دال ۽ 1 وڏو چمچو ماش جي دال سُڪي ڀُڃيو، ميوي جهڙي، ٿوري نرم پوڊيءَ لاءِ.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dals: together with the seeds dry-roast 1 big spoon chana dal and 1 big spoon urad dal, for a nutty, slightly softer podi.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: ڪچو ٿوم: تيز ذائقي لاءِ ٿوم گرم نه ڪريو، ۽ هڪ هفتي اندر کائو.
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste do not warm the garlic, and eat within a week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: وچولي تکاڻ: 2 وڏا چمچا تيجا ۽ 2 وڏا چمچا سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وجهو.
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: add 2 big spoons Teja and 2 big spoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: گرم چانورن ۽ گيهه جي پهرين لپ ۾ ملايو، يا ٿوري تيل يا گيهه سان اِڊلي، ڊوسا يا پيسرٽّو مٿان ڇڻڪيو.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix into the first morsel of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: صاف، سُڪي، هوا بند جار ۾ ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي لڳ ڀڳ 2 هفتا، يا فرج ۾ هڪ مهينو رکو. هميشه سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge a month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: ڌاڻا ۽ زيرو ڀُڃيو، پيهيو، مرچ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ وجهو، پوءِ ڇليل ٿوم جون تريون ننڍن جهٽڪن سان ٿلهي، آلي پائوڊر ۾ ملايو. آنڌرا جا گهر اڪثر ان کي پٿر جي اُکريءَ ۾ ڪُٽيندا آهن.
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast coriander and cumin, grind, add chilli powder and salt, then mix in peeled garlic cloves with short pulses into a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: ٿوم جي پوڊي گهٽ تکي ڪيئن ڪجي؟
seg.727d415cb888.back: How to make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: اڌ تيجا بدران اڌ سنّم مرچ پائوڊر وجهو، يا ڪل 3 وڏا چمچا مرچ پائوڊر وجهو. گهڻي گيهه سان کائڻ به تکاڻ نرم ڪري ٿو.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: Instead of half the Teja add half Sannam chilli powder, or add 3 big spoons chilli powder in total. Eating with lots of ghee also softens the heat.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.t: ويلّلّي ڪارم ڪيترو عرصو رهي ٿو؟
seg.982e854e4417.back: How long does vellulli karam last?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: سُڪي، هوا بند جار ۾ ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي لڳ ڀڳ 2 هفتا، يا فرج ۾ هڪ مهينو. ٿوم چڱيءَ طرح سُڪايو ۽ پهريان تيل ۾ گرم ڪريو ته وڌيڪ عرصو رهي.
seg.a620f29950c0.back: In a dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge a month. Dry the garlic well and first warm it in oil so it lasts longer.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: ڇا مرچ پائوڊر بدران سڄا سُڪل ڳاڙها مرچ وجهي سگهجن ٿا؟
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can whole dried red chillies be added instead of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: ها. لڳ ڀڳ 20 سُڪل ڳاڙها مرچ تيل جي ڪجهه ڦڙن سان ڪُرڪُرا ٿيڻ تائين ڀُڃيو، ٿڌا ڪري ٿوم وجهڻ کان اڳ پيهيو.
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.a2202c094baa.t: ويلّلّي ڪارم · ويلّلّي ڪارم جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: ويلّلّي ڪارم. آنڌرا جي ٿوم ۽ مرچ جي پوڊي: ڀُڳل ڌاڻا ۽ زيرو ٿوم، لوڻ ۽ تيجا مرچ پائوڊر سان ڪُٽيل. گرم چانورن ۽ گيهه، يا اِڊلي ۽ ڊوسا سان ملايو.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: Vellulli Karam. Andhra's garlic and chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.

seg.5a3c1bf438cc.t: ويلّلّي ڪارم (آنڌرا ٿوم ۽ مرچ جو پائوڊر) · 1acrefarms
seg.5a3c1bf438cc.back: Vellulli Karam (Andhra garlic and chilli powder) · 1acrefarms

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: ويلّلّي ڪارم: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: ڪڪڙ تي ڏهي، تيجا مرچ پائوڊر، هيڊ پائوڊر ۽ لوڻ مکيو. 30 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو. ان دوران پيالو ڍڪي فرج ۾ رکو.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt onto the chicken. Leave for 30 minutes. Meanwhile cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g مڇيءَ جا ٽڪرا ⟦1⟧ٿلهن ٽڪرن ۾ ڪٽيل سخت گوشت واري مڇي: روهو، ڪتلا (بوچا)، ڪورامينو (مرل) يا سير مڇي (ونجارم)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish cut into thick pieces: rohu, katla (bocha), koramenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g املي ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ ليمي جيڏا ٻه گولا، 2 ڪپ ڪوسي پاڻيءَ ۾ 15 منٽ پسايل⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups of lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: بچيل سالڻ فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 2 ڏينهن اندر کائو. پين ۾ هلڪي باهه تي، هلائڻ کان سواءِ ايترو ٻيهر گرم ڪريو جو اندر تائين پورو ٻاڦ ڇڏيندڙ گرم ٿي وڃي.
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Keep leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat in a pan on low heat, without stirring, until it is steaming hot all the way through.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: ٿلهن ٽڪرن ۾ ڪٽيل سخت گوشت واري درياهي يا سمنڊ جي مڇي: روهو، ڪتلا (بوچا)، مرل (ڪورامينو) يا سير مڇي. ننڍيون ڪنڊن واريون مڇيون به ٺيڪ آهن پر آهستگيءَ سان سنڀالڻيون پون ٿيون.
seg.379b410c6994.back: Thick pieces of firm-fleshed river or sea fish: rohu, katla (bocha), murrel (koramenu) or seer fish. Small bony fish also work but need to be handled gently.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: بچيل سالڻ فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 2 ڏينهن اندر کائو. پلوسو کي پين ۾ ٿورو پاڻي وجهي ايترو گرم ڪريو جو اندر تائين پورو ٻاڦ ڇڏيندڙ گرم ٿي وڃي.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Keep leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan with a little water until it is steaming hot all the way through.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: مٽن ويپوڊو: 500 g هڏين کان سواءِ ٻڪريءَ جو گوشت مصالحي ۽ ½ ڪپ پاڻيءَ سان پريشر ڪُڪر ۾ 5–6 سيٽين تائين، نرم ٿيڻ تائين پچايو، پوءِ ساڳيءَ طرح تريو.
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: ٻئي ٺيڪ آهن. هڏين کان سواءِ جلدي پچي ٿو ۽ وڌيڪ ڪُرڪُرو ٿئي ٿو؛ هڏين سميت ننڍن ٽڪرن ۾ ذائقو وڌيڪ آهي پر انهن کي پنهنجي رس ۾ 6–8 منٽ وڌيڪ گهرجن.
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and becomes crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes more in their own juices.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: لنچ باڪس يا ننڍي سفر لاءِ ٻڌو ته لڳ ڀڳ 4 ڪلاڪن اندر کائو. بچيل فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ هڪ ڏينهن اندر کائو.
seg.d20a641bec03.back: If packing for a lunch box or a short trip, eat within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: يا ته ليمي جي رس پچي وئي يا هيڊ تيل ۾ سڙي وئي. هيڊ سڀ کان آخر ۾ وجهو، ترت چُلهه بند ڪريو ۽ رڳو 5–10 سيڪنڊ هلايو؛ ليمي جي رس باهه کان پري، چانورن ۾ وجهو.
seg.bc9078e02646.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last of all, switch off the stove immediately and stir only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice away from the heat.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: ٻيو ڪپ پاڻي ڳري تري واري پين ۾ وجهو؛ سنهي پين ۾ راگي تري ۾ لڳي وڃي ٿي.
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Pour the second cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; in a thin pan the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: ڇا راگي جاوا ۾ ڪمند جو ڳڙ وجهي سگهجي ٿو؟
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can sugarcane jaggery be added to ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: ها. اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ڪيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ (چيروڪو بيلّم) وٺو ۽ چُلهه بند ڪرڻ کان پوءِ ملايو، ته کير نه ڦاٽي. اهو هلڪو رنگ ۽ هلڪي، ڪيريمل جهڙي مٺاڻ ڏئي ٿو.
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and mix it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a light, caramel-like sweetness.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: بچيل فرج ۾ ڍڪي رکو ۽ 1 ڏينهن اندر کائو. پين ۾ رڳو ايترو گرم ڪريو جو اندر تائين پورو ٻاڦ ڇڏيندڙ گرم ٿي وڃي؛ ان کان وڌيڪ دير ٻيهر گرم ڪرڻ سان جهينگا سخت ٿي وڃن ٿا.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; reheating longer than that makes the prawns tough.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.t: ڇا ڪمند جي ڳڙ سان سنّنڊلو ٺاهي سگهجن ٿا؟
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can sunnundalu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: ها. ڪمند جو ڳڙ (چيروڪو بيلّم) سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو ۽ تاڙ جي ڳڙ جيترو ئي وجهو. لڏو هلڪي رنگ جا ٿين ٿا ۽ مٺاڻ هلڪي، ڪيريمل جهڙي.
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Finely grate sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus come out lighter in colour and the sweetness is light, caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: ڪچو ٿوم: تيز ذائقي لاءِ ٿوم گرم نه ڪريو؛ فرج ۾ رکو ۽ 3 ڏينهن اندر کائو.
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper flavour do not heat the garlic; keep in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: صاف، سُڪي، هوا بند جار ۾ فرج ۾ رکو ۽ 2 هفتن اندر استعمال ڪريو. هميشه سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو.
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: سُڪي، هوا بند جار ۾ فرج ۾ 2 هفتن تائين. ٿوم چڱيءَ طرح سُڪايو ۽ پهريان تيل ۾ گرم ڪريو، ۽ هميشه سُڪو چمچو استعمال ڪريو.
seg.367798df40e3.back: In a dry, airtight jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Dry the garlic well and heat it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: ها. لڳ ڀڳ 20 سُڪل ڳاڙها مرچ تيل جي ڪجهه ڦڙن ۾ ڪُرڪُرا ٿيڻ تائين ڀُڃيو، ٿڌا ڪري ٿوم وجهڻ کان اڳ پيهيو.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.6a0d4200f978.t: بيلّم اٽوڪولو جي ترڪيب جو ڪارڊ

seg.5e2064c58b7d.t: ڪوبّري انڊلو جي ترڪيب جو ڪارڊ

seg.c473a3556357.t: آنڌرا جي مٺائي · 2 ماڻهن لاءِ · 10 منٽ

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.t: بيلّم اٽوڪولو ⟦1⟧(تاڙ جي ڳڙ وارو مٺو پوها)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(sweet poha with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: بيلّم اٽوڪولو تيلگو گهرن جي 10 منٽن واري مٺائي آهي. هي اهو پوها آهي جيڪو ڪرشناشٽميءَ تي ڪرشن کي ڀيٽا ڪيو ويندو آهي، ڪُچيلا جي تحفي جي ياد ۾، ۽ هي اسڪول کان پوءِ ٻارن لاءِ جلدي ٺهندڙ مٺائي به آهي. پوها رڳو ڌوتو ويندو آهي، پاڻيءَ ۾ ڪڏهن به رڌو نه ويندو آهي، پوءِ ڳڙ جي گرم چاسڻيءَ ۾ هلڪو ملايو ويندو آهي.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. This is that poha which is offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, in memory of Kuchela's gift, and this is also a quickly-made sweet for children after school. The poha is only washed, never cooked in water, then lightly mixed into hot jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: اسان جو تاٽي بيلّم يعني تاڙ جو ڳڙ ان کي گهرو ناسي رنگ ۽ ڀرپور، ٿوري دونهين جهڙي مٺاڻ ڏئي ٿو. هيءَ ترڪيب 2 ماڻهن لاءِ آهي.
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our taati bellam, that is palm jaggery, gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoke-like sweetness. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: تياريءَ ۾ ڌوتل پوهي کي نرم ٿيڻ جا 5 منٽ شامل آهن.
seg.25e28614accb.back: The preparation includes 5 minutes for the washed poha to soften.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: ٿلهي پوهي کي نرم ڪريو، ان کي ناريل ۽ الائچيءَ سان تاڙ جي ڳڙ جي گرم چاسڻيءَ ۾ هلڪو ملايو، ۽ آخر ۾ گيهه وجهو.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Soften the thick poha, mix it lightly with coconut and cardamom into hot palm jaggery syrup, and at the end add ghee.

seg.04f65369bdaa.t: 1 ڪپ ٿلهو پوها ⟦1⟧اٽوڪولو، لڳ ڀڳ 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.t: ½ ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ناريل ⟦1⟧رڳو اڇو حصو⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ ننڍو چمچو الائچي پائوڊر ⟦1⟧يا 2–3 الائچين جا ڪُٽيل داڻا⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ small spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 2–3 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.5f1854fd1277.back: 6–8 cashews, as per wish ⟦1⟧fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: پوها ڇاڻيءَ ۾ وجهو ۽ ڇلڪن جا ٽڪرا چونڊي ڪڍو.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out the pieces of husk.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: پوهي کي ڇاڻيءَ ۾ وهندڙ پاڻيءَ هيٺ ڪجهه سيڪنڊ ڌوئو، پاڻي نيتاري ڇڏيو، ۽ نرم ٿيڻ لاءِ 5 منٽ ڇڏي ڏيو. دٻائڻ تي نرم لڳي، پر آلو نه هجي.
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Wash the poha in the sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain the water, and leave for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not be wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ سنهو ڪدوڪش ڪريو، ۽ سخت ڳوڙها ڀڃي ڇڏيو.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, and break the hard lumps.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: تاڙ جي ڳڙ کي 2 وڏن چمچن پاڻيءَ سان هلڪي باهه تي ڳاريو، پوءِ ڇاڻي ڇڏيو. پين صاف ڪريو ۽ چاسڻي واپس ان ۾ وجهو.
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low flame, then strain it. Clean the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: جيڪڏهن ڪاجو وجهي رهيا آهيو ته انهن کي ٿوري گيهه ۾ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو.
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If you are adding cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: پوها، ناريل ۽ الائچي گرم چاسڻيءَ ۾ وجهو ۽ هلڪي باهه تي 1–2 منٽ هلڪي هٿ سان ملايو، جيستائين پوهي جو هر داڻو چاسڻيءَ سان ڍڪجي وڃي. هٿ هلڪو رکو ته جيئن داڻا نه ڀڄن.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Put the poha, coconut and cardamom into the hot syrup and mix with a light hand on low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every grain of poha is coated in the syrup. Keep the hand light so that the grains do not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: جيئن ئي داڻا چاسڻيءَ سان ڍڪجي وڃن، پين باهه تان لاهي ڇڏيو؛ وڌيڪ پچائڻ سان اهي چٻاڙڻ ۾ رٻڙ جهڙا ٿي ويندا.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: As soon as the grains are coated with syrup, take the pan off the fire; cooking more makes them rubber-like to chew.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: آخر ۾ گيهه ۽ ڪاجو وجهو. گرم يا ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي پيش ڪريو.
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: At the end add ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: ٿلهو پوها وٺو. سنهو پوها چاسڻيءَ ۾ ڳري گپ ٿي وڃي ٿو.
seg.544ea222a497.back: Take thick poha. Thin poha melts in the syrup and becomes mush.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: پوهي کي پاڻيءَ جي پيالي ۾ نه پُسايو؛ جلدي ڌوئڻ ڪافي آهي، نه ته اهو نرم ۽ چنبڙندڙ ٿي ويندو.
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; washing quickly is enough, otherwise it becomes soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: پوها وجهڻ وقت چاسڻي گرم رکو، ٽهڪندڙ نه، ته جيئن سڀني داڻن تي برابر چڙهي.
seg.972f174730fe.back: When adding the poha keep the syrup hot, not boiling, so that it coats all the grains evenly.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: کير سان: وڌيڪ نرم مٺائيءَ لاءِ تيار پوهي تي 2–3 وڏا چمچا گرم کير وجهو.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: for a softer sweet, pour 2–3 big spoons of warm milk over the ready poha.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: تر سان: ناريل سان گڏ 1 وڏو چمچو ڀُڳل تر وجهو.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: add 1 big spoon of roasted sesame along with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: ان کي ڪرشناشٽميءَ تي نئيويديم طور پيش ڪريو، يا اسڪول کان پوءِ ٻارن لاءِ جلدي ٺهندڙ مٺائيءَ طور.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick-to-make sweet for children after school.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: جنهن ڏينهن ٺاهيو ان ئي ڏينهن کائڻ بهتر آهي. بچيل پوها ڍڪي فرج ۾ رکو ۽ ٻئي ڏينهن کائو؛ رکيل پوها سخت ٿيندو وڃي ٿو.
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Eating it on the same day you make it is better. Cover the leftover poha, keep it in the fridge and eat the next day; kept poha keeps getting hard.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.t: بيلّم اٽوڪولو لاءِ ڪهڙو پوها بهتر آهي؟
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: Which poha is better for Bellam Atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: ٿلهو پوها (اٽوڪولو). اهو گرم چاسڻيءَ ۾ پنهنجي شڪل برقرار رکي ٿو؛ سنهو پوها ڳري گپ ٿي وڃي ٿو.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick poha (atukulu). It keeps its shape in hot syrup; thin poha melts and becomes mush.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: ڇا مان بيلّم اٽوڪولو ڪمند جي ڳڙ سان ٺاهي سگهان ٿو؟
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can I make Bellam Atukulu with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: ها. اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ (چيروڪو بيلّم) وجهو. رنگ هلڪو ٿيندو، ۽ مٺاڻ ڪيريمل جهڙي.
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam). The colour will be lighter, and the sweetness caramel-like.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: منهنجو بيلّم اٽوڪولو چنبڙندڙ ڇو آهي؟
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why is my Bellam Atukulu sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: پوها پُسايو ويو هو يا گهڻي دير رڌو ويو. ان کي رڳو ڪجهه سيڪنڊ ڌوئو، ۽ جيئن ئي هر داڻو چاسڻيءَ سان ڍڪجي، پين باهه تان لاهي ڇڏيو.
seg.a6945e480c9a.back: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Wash it for only a few seconds, and as soon as every grain is coated in syrup, take the pan off the flame.

seg.d4c0fab65bf7.src: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.t: هي ڪرشناشٽميءَ تي ڇو ٺاهيو ويندو آهي؟
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.back: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?

seg.51ab1914ac8d.src: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of poha to his friend Krishna as his only gift.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.t: هي ڪُچيلا جي ڪهاڻي ياد ڏياري ٿو، جيڪو پنهنجي دوست ڪرشن وٽ پنهنجي واحد تحفي طور مُٺ ڀري پوها کڻي ويو هو.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.back: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who went to his friend Krishna carrying a handful of poha as his only gift.

seg.f548f5c95f50.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు · بيلّم اٽوڪولو جي ترڪيب | 1acrefarms

seg.5080241b3883.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు. آنڌرا جو بيلّم اٽوڪولو: ٿلهو پوها، تاٽي بيلّم يعني تاڙ جي ڳڙ جي گرم چاسڻيءَ ۾ ناريل، الائچي ۽ گيهه سان ملايل. 10 منٽن جي مٺائي، صلاحن ۽ عام سوالن سان.
seg.5080241b3883.back: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra's Bellam Atukulu: thick poha, mixed in hot syrup of taati bellam, that is palm jaggery, with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and common questions.

seg.4239bed21420.src: Bellam Atukulu (Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery) · 1acrefarms
seg.4239bed21420.t: بيلّم اٽوڪولو (تاڙ جي ڳڙ وارو مٺو پوها) · 1acrefarms
seg.4239bed21420.back: Bellam Atukulu (sweet poha with palm jaggery) · 1acrefarms

seg.8dafb14d8ade.src: Bellam Atukulu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.8dafb14d8ade.t: بيلّم اٽوڪولو: 1acrefarms جو ترڪيب ڪارڊ، شين ۽ طريقي سان
seg.8dafb14d8ade.back: Bellam Atukulu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with things and method
