seg.cf5b9ab6ccf1.t: آنڌرا جي مٺائي · لڳ ڀڳ 14 ٺهن ٿا

seg.753ec27036d4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud Ke Laddu
seg.753ec27036d4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · ڪوبّري انڊلو · ناريل ڳڙ جا لڏو

seg.de7ddbad7bf0.src: Kobbari undalu are the coconut laddus Andhra homes make for festivals, naivedyam and an everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on a low flame until the mix holds together, and the laddus are rolled by hand while still warm.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.t: ڪوبّري انڊلو ناريل جا اهي لڏو آهن جيڪي آنڌرا جي گهرن ۾ ڏڻن، نئيويديم ۽ روزاني مٺائيءَ لاءِ ٺهن ٿا. انهن لاءِ رڳو ناريل، ڳڙ، الائچي ۽ هڪ چمچو گيهه گهرجي. ڳڙ کي ڳاري ڇاڻيو ويندو آهي، ناريل کي ان ۾ هلڪي باهه تي تيستائين رڌو ويندو آهي جيستائين مصالحو جُڙي نه وڃي، ۽ لڏو گرم هوندي ئي هٿ سان ٺاهيا ويندا آهن.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.back: Kobbari Undalu are those coconut laddoos which are made in Andhra homes for festivals, naivedyam and daily sweet. For them only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and one spoon of ghee is needed. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on low fire until the masalo (mixture) binds, and the laddoos are made by hand while still warm.

seg.089fb020d00e.src: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a mellow caramel taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.
seg.089fb020d00e.t: اسان جو چيروڪو بيلّم انهن کي هلڪو سونهري رنگ ۽ نرم، ڪيريمل جهڙو ذائقو ڏئي ٿو. هن ترڪيب سان لڳ ڀڳ 14 لڏو ٺهن ٿا.
seg.089fb020d00e.back: Our cheruku bellam gives them a light golden colour and a soft, caramel-like taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddoos.

seg.d9e7175cce3e.src: Allow another 15 minutes for the laddus to cool before you store them.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.t: رکڻ کان اڳ لڏن کي ٿڌو ٿيڻ لاءِ ٻيا 15 منٽ ڏيو.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.back: Before storing, give the laddoos 15 more minutes to cool.

seg.80b59063a128.src: Melt cane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut till it comes together, add cardamom and ghee, and roll into laddus.
seg.80b59063a128.t: ڪمند جو ڳڙ ڳاريو، ان کي ڪدوڪش ٿيل ناريل سان تيستائين رڌيو جيستائين جُڙي وڃي، الائچي ۽ گيهه وجهو، ۽ لڏو ٺاهيو.
seg.80b59063a128.back: Melt the sugarcane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut until it binds, add cardamom and ghee, and make laddoos.

seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.src: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.t: 2 ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ناريل ⟦1⟧1 وچولو ناريل؛ رڳو اڇو حصو ڪدوڪش ڪريو⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.back: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.fa687abb7dd1.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.t: 1 ڪپ ڪدوڪش ٿيل ڪمند جو ڳڙ ⟦1⟧لڳ ڀڳ 180 g؛ ٽڪرن کي پهريان ڪُٽيو يا ڪدوڪش ڪريو⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.1ca2ce946869.src: 1 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧plus a little for greasing your palms⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.t: 1 وڏو چمچو گيهه ⟦1⟧۽ تريون چِڪڻيون ڪرڻ لاءِ ٿورو وڌيڪ⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.back: 1 big spoon ghee ⟦1⟧and a little more for greasing the palms⟦/1⟧

seg.ccf1a746b971.src: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.t: 10 ڪاجو، مرضيءَ موجب ⟦1⟧ڀڃي گيهه ۾ سونهري تريل⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.back: 10 cashews, as per wish ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.15ef8686cc9e.src: Grate the coconut, leaving out the brown skin so the laddus stay light in colour.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.t: ناريل ڪدوڪش ڪريو، ناسي کل ڇڏي ڏيو ته جيئن لڏن جو رنگ هلڪو رهي.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.back: Grate the coconut, leave out the brown skin so that the laddoos' colour stays light.

seg.00b442d7f507.src: Pound or grate the cane jaggery into small pieces so it melts evenly.
seg.00b442d7f507.t: ڪمند جي ڳڙ کي ڪُٽي يا ڪدوڪش ڪري ننڍا ٽڪرا ڪريو ته جيئن برابر ڳري.
seg.00b442d7f507.back: Pound or grate the sugarcane jaggery into small pieces so that it melts evenly.

seg.c25e0610c714.src: Melt the jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it through a fine sieve. This catches any grit or bits of cane from the block.
seg.c25e0610c714.t: ڳڙ کي 2 وڏن چمچن پاڻيءَ سان هلڪي باهه تي ڳاريو، پوءِ سنهي ڇاڻيءَ مان ڇاڻيو. ان سان ڳڙ جي ڍيلي ۾ موجود ڪا رڙي يا ڪمند جا ذرا ڇاڻيءَ ۾ رهجي وڃن ٿا.
seg.c25e0610c714.back: Melt the jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low fire, then strain through a fine sieve. With this, any grit or bits of cane present in the jaggery lump stay in the sieve.

seg.3eb20f2a7136.src: Return it to the pan, add the coconut and cook on medium-low, stirring, until the mix leaves the sides of the pan and holds together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.t: ان کي واپس پين ۾ وجهو، ناريل وجهو ۽ وچولي کان هلڪي باهه تي هلائيندي رڌيو، جيستائين مصالحو پين جا ڪنارا ڇڏي ڏئي ۽ جُڙي وڃي، 12–15 منٽ. هلائيندا رهو ته جيئن تري ۾ نه لڳي.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.back: Put it back in the pan, add the coconut and cook stirring on medium to low fire, until the masalo (mixture) leaves the sides of the pan and binds, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so that it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.e1985b8e5f9c.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden while the mix cooks.
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.t: جيڪڏهن ڪاجو وجهي رهيا آهيو ته مصالحو رڌجڻ دوران انهن کي ٿوري گيهه ۾ سونهري ٿيڻ تائين تريو.
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.back: If you are adding cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden while the masalo (mixture) is cooking.

seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.src: Stir in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the heat.
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.t: الائچي، گيهه ۽ ڪاجو ملايو. پين باهه تان لاهي ڇڏيو.
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.back: Mix in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the flame.

seg.d4ee96780aba.src: Let it cool till you can handle it, grease your palms with ghee and roll it into small balls. Press each one firmly so it holds together.
seg.d4ee96780aba.t: ايترو ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو جو هٿ لائي سگهو، تريون گيهه سان چِڪڻيون ڪريو ۽ ننڍا گول لڏو ٺاهيو. هر هڪ کي زور سان دٻايو ته جيئن جُڙيل رهي.
seg.d4ee96780aba.back: Let it cool enough that you can touch it, grease the palms with ghee and make small round laddoos. Press each one firmly so that it stays bound.

seg.3753ea8bc7d0.src: Set the laddus on a greased plate and let them cool completely before you store them.
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.t: لڏو گيهه لڳل ٿالهيءَ تي رکو ۽ رکڻ کان اڳ پوري طرح ٿڌو ٿيڻ ڏيو.
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.back: Place the laddoos on a ghee-greased plate and let them cool fully before storing.

seg.fb3de84de9f6.src: If the mix won't hold a shape, cook it 2 minutes more. If it sets too hard, sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk and press again.
seg.fb3de84de9f6.t: جيڪڏهن مصالحو شڪل نه وٺي ته 2 منٽ وڌيڪ رڌيو. جيڪڏهن تمام سخت ٿي وڃي ته هڪ چمچو گرم کير ڇڻڪيو ۽ ٻيهر دٻايو.
seg.fb3de84de9f6.back: If the masalo (mixture) does not take shape, cook 2 more minutes. If it becomes very hard, sprinkle a spoon of warm milk and press again.

seg.71475e1a7345.src: Keep the flame at medium-low; on a high flame the jaggery darkens and the laddus turn hard.
seg.71475e1a7345.t: باهه وچولي کان هلڪي رکو؛ تيز باهه تي ڳڙ جو رنگ گهرو ٿي وڃي ٿو ۽ لڏو سخت ٿي وڃن ٿا.
seg.71475e1a7345.back: Keep the flame medium to low; on high flame the jaggery's colour becomes dark and the laddoos become hard.

seg.46a2e2b2d323.src: Roll the laddus while the mix is still warm; once it cools completely it will not bind.
seg.46a2e2b2d323.t: مصالحو گرم هوندي ئي لڏو ٺاهيو؛ پوري طرح ٿڌو ٿيڻ کان پوءِ اهو نه جُڙندو.
seg.46a2e2b2d323.back: Make the laddoos while the masalo (mixture) is still warm; after cooling fully it will not bind.

seg.b277c024adad.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker laddus with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.b277c024adad.t: تاڙ جو ڳڙ: اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ وجهو، لڏو گهري رنگ جا ۽ ٿوري دونهين جهڙي مٺاڻ وارا ٿيندا.
seg.b277c024adad.back: Palm jaggery: take the same amount of grated palm jaggery, the laddoos will turn out dark-coloured and with a slightly smoke-like sweetness.

seg.7b597df04222.src: Dry coconut: use the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mix comes together faster, so watch it closely.
seg.7b597df04222.t: سُڪو ناريل: اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل سُڪو ناريل (کوپرا) وجهو؛ مصالحو جلدي جُڙي ٿو، تنهنڪري ڌيان سان ڏسندا رهو.
seg.7b597df04222.back: Dry coconut: add the same amount of grated dry coconut (khopra); the masalo (mixture) binds quickly, so keep watching carefully.

seg.676bca051e10.src: Kobbari burfi: spread the cooked mix on a greased plate, let it set a little and cut it into squares instead of rolling laddus.
seg.676bca051e10.t: ڪوبّري برفي: لڏو ٺاهڻ بدران رڌل مصالحو گيهه لڳل ٿالهيءَ تي پکيڙيو، ٿورو ڄمڻ ڏيو ۽ چورس ٽڪرا ڪٽيو.
seg.676bca051e10.back: Kobbari burfi: instead of making laddoos, spread the cooked the masalo (mixture) on a ghee-greased plate, let it set a little and cut square pieces.

seg.80538d77ab41.src: Serve as an everyday sweet, offer them as naivedyam, or add them to the festival sweet plate.
seg.80538d77ab41.t: روزاني مٺائيءَ طور پيش ڪريو، نئيويديم طور ڀيٽا ڪريو، يا ڏڻ جي مٺائيءَ جي ٿالهيءَ ۾ شامل ڪريو.
seg.80538d77ab41.back: Serve as a daily sweet, offer as naivedyam, or include in a festival sweet platter.

seg.6f3252f28ef8.src: Keep in an airtight container and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or within a week if kept in the fridge.
seg.6f3252f28ef8.t: هوا بند ڊٻي ۾ رکو ۽ ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي 3 ڏينهن اندر کائو، يا فرج ۾ رکو ته هڪ هفتي اندر.
seg.6f3252f28ef8.back: Keep in an airtight box and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or if kept in the fridge, within one week.

seg.f232fb960e89.src: Why are my kobbari undalu not holding shape?
seg.f232fb960e89.t: منهنجا ڪوبّري انڊلو شڪل ڇو نٿا وٺن؟
seg.f232fb960e89.back: Why are my Kobbari Undalu not taking shape?

seg.1cf59b528a13.src: The mix needs a little more cooking. Put it back on a low flame for 2 minutes, stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then roll it while it is still warm.
seg.1cf59b528a13.t: مصالحي کي ٿورو وڌيڪ رڌڻ جي ضرورت آهي. ان کي ٻيهر هلڪي باهه تي 2 منٽ هلائيندي رڌيو، جيستائين پين جا ڪنارا ڇڏي ڏئي، پوءِ گرم هوندي ئي لڏو ٺاهيو.
seg.1cf59b528a13.back: The masalo (mixture) needs to be cooked a little more. Cook it again on low fire for 2 minutes stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then make laddoos while still warm.

seg.9371fa8705cd.src: Why did my laddus turn hard?
seg.9371fa8705cd.t: منهنجا لڏو سخت ڇو ٿي ويا؟
seg.9371fa8705cd.back: Why did my laddoos become hard?

seg.ee988ba3472f.src: The jaggery was cooked too long or on too high a flame. Sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Next time, take the pan off the heat as soon as the mix holds together.
seg.ee988ba3472f.t: ڳڙ گهڻي دير يا تمام تيز باهه تي رڌو ويو. هڪ چمچو گرم کير ڇڻڪيو، ملايو ۽ ٻيهر دٻايو. ايندڙ دفعي، جيئن ئي مصالحو جُڙي، پين باهه تان لاهي ڇڏيو.
seg.ee988ba3472f.back: The jaggery was cooked too long or on very high fire. Sprinkle a spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Next time, as soon as the masalo (mixture) binds, take the pan off the fire.

seg.d830316a6adb.src: Can I make kobbari undalu with palm jaggery?
seg.d830316a6adb.t: ڇا مان ڪوبّري انڊلو تاڙ جي ڳڙ سان ٺاهي سگهان ٿو؟
seg.d830316a6adb.back: Can I make Kobbari Undalu with palm jaggery?

seg.813bf680c8a8.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The laddus turn darker, with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.813bf680c8a8.t: ها. اوترو ئي ڪدوڪش ٿيل تاڙ جو ڳڙ (تاٽي بيلّم) وجهو. لڏو گهري رنگ جا ٿيندا، ۽ مٺاڻ ٿوري دونهين جهڙي.
seg.813bf680c8a8.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated palm jaggery (taati bellam). The laddoos will be dark-coloured, and the sweetness will be slightly smoke-like.

seg.ea6121eb3993.src: How long do kobbari undalu keep?
seg.ea6121eb3993.t: ڪوبّري انڊلو ڪيترا ڏينهن هلن ٿا؟
seg.ea6121eb3993.back: How many days do Kobbari Undalu last?

seg.26aba27412dc.src: About 3 days in an airtight container at room temperature, and up to a week in the fridge.
seg.26aba27412dc.t: هوا بند ڊٻي ۾ ڪمري جي گرميءَ تي لڳ ڀڳ 3 ڏينهن، ۽ فرج ۾ هڪ هفتي تائين.
seg.26aba27412dc.back: In an airtight box at room temperature about 3 days, and in the fridge up to one week.
